paper.title: AVCap: Reinforcing Audio-Video Joint Caption with Detail-Aware Reward
paper.abstract: Detailed audio-video joint captioning is essential for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior works are constrained by three main limitations: (1) the scarcity of high-quality public datasets with fine-grained audio-visual joint captions; (2) reinforcement-learning methods that rely on coarse reward signals; and (3) the lack of a benchmark and metric for evaluating detailed audiovisual captions at the atomic level. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVCap-100K, a

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频联合字幕工作存在高质量细粒度数据集稀缺、RL奖励信号粗糙、缺乏原子级细节评测体系三大瓶颈。
summary.importance: 数据贡献+方法创新+Benchmark贡献，构建100K规模细粒度音视频对齐字幕数据集，提出细节感知GRPO优化方法，并推出专用评测基准与指标。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建AVCap-100K数据集，包含100K条时间对齐、细节丰富的音视频字幕；2）提出Detail-Aware GRPO（Da-GRPO），用细粒度细节感知奖励优化字幕生成；3）设计AVCap-Bench评测基准与AVCap-Score原子级细节评测指标。
summary.experiments: 未明确模型参数量，对比开源音视频字幕基线，在多个通用评测集上达到开源SOTA，性能匹配或超过专有闭源模型；在AVCap-Bench上的原子级细节得分显著优于基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-video joint captioning works face three bottlenecks: scarcity of high-quality fine-grained datasets, coarse RL reward signals, and lack of atomic-level detail evaluation systems.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + methodological innovation + benchmark contribution, constructing the first 100K-scale fine-grained temporally aligned audio-video caption dataset, proposing a detail-aware GRPO optimization method, and releasing a dedicated evaluation benchmark and metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Constructs the AVCap-100K dataset with 100K temporally aligned, detail-rich audio-video captions; 2) Proposes Detail-Aware GRPO (Da-GRPO) to optimize caption generation with fine-grained detail-aware rewards; 3) Designs the AVCap-Bench evaluation benchmark and AVCap-Score atomic-level detail evaluation metric.
summary_en.experiments: No explicit parameter count reported; achieves open-source SOTA on multiple general evaluation sets, matching or outperforming closed-source proprietary models; obtains significantly higher atomic-level detail scores than baselines on AVCap-Bench.

recommendation.zh: 关注多模态数据集构建与细粒度RL奖励设计的研究员可扫过数据构造与奖励定义部分，无预训练范式层面的新洞察。
recommendation.en: Researchers focusing on multimodal dataset construction and fine-grained RL reward design can skim the data pipeline and reward definition sections, no new insights at the pretraining paradigm level.

paper.title: GRASP: Reinforcing Language Model Anonymizers with Group Relative Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models can infer sensitive personal attributes, such as age, location, and occupation, from ordinary text, turning everyday writing into a privacy risk. Adversarial anonymization defends against this by rewriting a text with a capable language model that also plays the attacker, but it needs a powerful model at inference time and thus sends private text to a third party, the very exposure anonymization should prevent. Recent work distills this behavior into a small on-device model

summary.core_problem: 在本地小模型匿名化场景中，如何直接优化隐私-效用权衡，而不是只模仿教师模型的离线偏好。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/RL 应用型工作，价值不在匿名化任务本身，而在于展示 GRPO 这类相对策略优化能否替代 DPO 去优化多目标文本重写。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GRASP，让同一个小模型同时扮演匿名器、攻击者和效用评估器，在线自博弈式地产生重写候选，并用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 直接优化隐私与可用性目标，而非仅蒸馏教师选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其对比了 SFT/DPO 蒸馏式匿名器，并在隐私属性推断防御与文本效用保持之间取得更优平衡；但任务是高度应用化的匿名化重写，实验设定对通用 LLM 后训练的外推有限。
summary.authors_note: UC Santa Barbara 与 UCLA 团队；未见可确认的基座模型一线知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to directly optimize the privacy-utility tradeoff for on-device text anonymization, instead of merely imitating an offline teacher with preference learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL application paper. Its value is not the anonymization task itself, but whether GRPO-style relative policy optimization is a better fit than DPO for multi-objective rewriting.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRASP uses a single small model as anonymizer, adversary, and utility judge, generates candidate rewrites through online self-refinement, and applies Group Relative Policy Optimization to directly optimize privacy and utility rather than distilling teacher choices.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, it compares against SFT/DPO-based distilled anonymizers and improves the privacy-utility balance. Still, the task is highly application-specific, so the lessons for general LLM post-training are limited.
summary_en.authors_note: From UC Santa Barbara and UCLA; no clearly identifiable foundation-model marquee authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 把它当一个小型 RL 配方样本看：DPO 不擅长直接优化多目标重写，这点有参考价值；正文不必细读，方法段和主表够了。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small RL recipe case study: DPO is a weak fit for directly optimizing multi-objective rewriting; the method section and main table are enough.

paper.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engine

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 往往依赖外部状态、工具、记忆和执行日志，但什么时候读、写、更新、压缩这些外部 harness，通常靠 prompt 或人工规则。论文要解决的是 harness policy learning：让模型学习运行时如何构造和使用外部状态，而不是只把 harness 当作固定脚手架。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是基座预训练论文，和 LLM 训练的关系主要在 agent RL 和训练信号设计。它的启发在于把“外部状态使用”显式纳入策略学习，并对调用成本建模。对预训练研究的间接价值是：长程任务能力不只来自更长上下文或更多轨迹 SFT，也可能来自模型学会何时把状态外化、何时依赖内部策略、何时复用经验。这对 long-horizon agent post-training、工具使用 RL、记忆增强模型有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL 把复杂的外部执行支持抽象成 BPE workspace：Belief 表示当前环境状态，Progress 表示已完成和待完成子目标，Experience 表示跨 episode 可复用经验。Agent 通过紧凑的 harness meta-actions 与这些状态交互，例如查询 belief、提交 progress、召回 experience、写入新 insight。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 supervised harness fine-tuning，让模型熟悉 BPE action protocol，并从交互轨迹中学习如何外化 belief、progress 和 experience。第二阶段使用 cost-aware GRPO，把 harness action 的成本纳入优化，因为读写外部状态会占用交互预算。奖励包含任务成功、效率、动作多样性、避免重复和动作格式合法性。方法的重点是把 harness 使用从 prompt-time 规则转成 learned runtime policy。
summary.experiments: 论文在 ALFWorld 上实例化 BPE：Belief 对应 world-state tracker，Progress 对应已提交的子目标计划，Experience 对应跨 episode skill bank。结果显示，仅在 prompt 中加入 BPE 已能改善有状态长程任务；经过 SFT 和 GRPO 后，ALFWorld seen split 成功率达到 96.9%，unseen split 达到 86.6%。分析部分提出两个现象。第一是 harness annealing：训练后模型减少频繁、脚手架式的外部调用，转向更选择性的状态访问，说明部分固定模式被内化进策略。第二是 harness evolution：在线 progress 更新和跨 episode experience consolidation 会把外部状态逐渐压缩成更适合当前任务族的支持结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 的 BPE 抽象和 action protocol，再看两阶段训练 recipe，尤其是 cost-aware GRPO 的奖励设计。实验部分关注 ALFWorld 适配方式、seen/unseen 成功率，以及 harness annealing 的调用频率变化。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过环境细节，重点看外部状态如何被表示成可学习动作，以及成本约束如何改变 Agent 的运行时策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses harness policy learning for long-horizon LLM agents. Agents often rely on external state, tools, memories, trackers, and logs, but the policy for when to read, write, update, or consolidate this support is usually hand-designed through prompts or heuristics. EvoHarness-RL trains the model to coordinate with the harness at runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly to agent post-training, RL for tool and memory use, and long-horizon execution. The useful idea is to make external-state access part of the learned policy and to price that access explicitly. For pretraining researchers, it suggests that long-horizon capability may depend not only on longer context or more trajectory imitation, but also on whether models learn when to externalize state, when to rely on internal computation, and when to reuse prior experience.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL abstracts heterogeneous runtime support into a BPE workspace. Belief tracks the current environment state, Progress tracks completed and pending subgoals, and Experience stores reusable cross-episode knowledge. The agent interacts with this workspace through compact harness meta-actions, such as querying belief, committing progress, recalling experience, and writing new insights. Training has two stages. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the model the BPE action protocol and how to extract useful belief, progress, and experience from traces. Cost-aware GRPO then optimizes when to use the harness under an interaction budget. The reward includes task success, efficiency, action diversity, repetition avoidance, and valid action formatting. The main contribution is turning harness use from a prompt-time scaffold into a learned runtime control policy.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is instantiated in ALFWorld. In this environment, Belief is grounded as a world-state tracker, Progress as a committed subgoal plan, and Experience as a cross-episode skill bank for household tasks. Prompt-time BPE already improves stateful long-horizon execution. After SFT and GRPO, the reported success rate reaches 96.9% on the ALFWorld seen split and 86.6% on the unseen split. The analysis highlights two dynamics. Harness annealing means that training reduces frequent scaffold-like calls and shifts the agent toward selective external-state access. Harness evolution means that online progress updates and experience consolidation refine the external workspace into a more compact task-adaptive substrate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the Method section for the BPE abstraction, the action protocol, and the two-stage training recipe. Pay particular attention to the cost-aware GRPO reward, because it determines whether the agent learns selective rather than excessive harness use. In the experiments, focus on the ALFWorld adapter, the seen and unseen success rates, and the analysis of harness annealing. Readers focused on base-model research can skip most environment details and concentrate on the representation of external state as learnable actions and the effect of cost constraints on runtime policy.

recommendation.zh: 用RL学习Agent运行时harness的思路新颖，cost-aware GRPO的设计对后训练RL优化有参考
recommendation.en: RL-learned agent runtime harness is novel; cost-aware GRPO design is relevant for post-training RL research.

paper.title: Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a

summary.core_problem: 现有基于多数投票的无标注RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）方法存在答案token捷径学习问题——模型直接强化高频答案token而非提升推理能力，导致奖励黑客和训练崩溃，同时传统RLVR依赖真值答案标注，成本高昂难以扩展。
summary.importance: 答案跨度梯度掩码的设计思路可迁移至所有基于结果奖励的RL对齐场景，从机制上避免模型走答案捷径；软共识加对比增强的无标注奖励构造方案，降低了RLVR对人工标注的依赖，为大规模推理增强训练提供了低成本路径；通过跟踪答案多样性诊断训练崩溃的方法，可直接用于RL后训练的动态监控体系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OM-GRPO框架，核心包含两个设计：一是答案跨度梯度掩码，在GRPO的梯度更新阶段，对答案区间的token设置零梯度掩码，仅保留思维链推理轨迹部分的梯度，同时保留基于组内答案频率计算的软共识奖励（而非硬多数投票奖励），将优化压力从答案token转移至推理过程本身；二是对比增强奖励（CAR），对同组内的推理轨迹进行两两对比，让模型输出更优轨迹对应的答案，以极低计算成本扩充答案池，提升软奖励的估计可靠性，不需要重新采样完整的长推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 在多个推理基准、三个不同的LLM骨干上测试，OM-GRPO稳定优于此前的无标注RLVR基线，性能与使用真值奖励的训练效果持平；在测试时训练（TTT）场景下，相比多数投票基线提升4.24分，且全程无训练崩溃；诊断实验显示，传统投票法训练过程中答案多样性快速下降，伴随性能暴跌，而OM-GRPO训练期间答案多样性保持稳定，无明显性能退化。
summary.reading_guide: 先查看Introduction部分的失败模式诊断（性能崩溃与答案多样性下降的关联实验），再阅读Method章节的答案掩码实现细节与对比增强奖励的构造逻辑，最后扫读跨骨干、跨场景的泛化实验结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing majority-voting-based label-free RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) methods suffer from answer-token shortcut learning: models directly reinforce high-frequency answer tokens instead of improving reasoning capability, leading to reward hacking and training collapse. Meanwhile, traditional RLVR relies on ground-truth answer annotations, which are prohibitively costly for large-scale deployment.
summary_en.importance: The answer-span gradient masking design can be transferred to all outcome-reward-based RL alignment scenarios to mechanically prevent answer shortcut learning. The soft consensus plus contrastive augmentation scheme for label-free reward construction reduces RLVR's reliance on human annotations, providing a low-cost path for large-scale reasoning-enhanced training. The diagnostic method of tracking answer diversity to detect training collapse can be directly integrated into dynamic monitoring systems for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OM-GRPO (Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization) framework has two core designs. First, answer-span gradient masking: during GRPO gradient updates, tokens in the answer span are masked with zero gradient, while only gradients from the chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning trajectory are retained. A soft consensus reward computed from answer frequency within the group (instead of hard majority voting) is preserved to shift optimization pressure from answer tokens to the reasoning process itself. Second, Contrast-Augmented Reward (CAR): pairwise comparisons are conducted on reasoning trajectories within the same group, prompting the model to output the answer corresponding to the better trajectory, which expands the answer pool at minimal computational cost and improves the reliability of soft reward estimation without resampling full long reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple reasoning benchmarks and three distinct LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms prior label-free RLVR baselines and matches the performance of training with ground-truth rewards. In the Test-Time Training (TTT) scenario, it outperforms the majority voting baseline by 4.24 points without any training collapse. Diagnostic experiments show traditional voting methods suffer from rapid decline in answer diversity accompanied by sharp performance drops during training, while OM-GRPO maintains stable answer diversity with no significant performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the failure mode diagnosis experiments (correlation between performance collapse and answer diversity decline) in the Introduction, then study the implementation details of answer masking and the construction logic of Contrast-Augmented Reward in the Method section, and finally skim the cross-backbone and cross-scenario generalization results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确命中无标签GRPO训练里“抄答案”的常见坑，梯度mask的fix简单实用，读方法部分即可，应在内部RL实验中验证。
recommendation.en: Directly addresses the common answer-cheating failure mode in label-free GRPO; the gradient masking fix is simple and practical, worth verifying in internal RL ablations.

paper.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that r

summary.core_problem: GRPO等RLVR方法将每个正确completion作为独立学习信号，导致重复出现的正确解法形式按采样频率累积正优势，罕见正确解法形式信用不足。
summary.importance: 识别了RLVR中multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration问题，提出了无需辅助模型推理的轻量修正；对理解GRPO训练动态有机制层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO使用确定性Strategy Cues对验证正确的轨迹构建rollout-local分区，按聚类稀有度重新分配正优势；不需要额外辅助模型推理。Judge Partitions下的Credit Redistribution进一步验证了重新分配机制的有效性。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上评测AIME重复采样性能，Cue-GRPO带来提升，高采样预算下增益最大；JP分区实验表明重新分配机制有效。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR methods like GRPO treat each correct completion as an independent learning signal, causing recurring correct solution forms to accumulate positive advantage proportional to sampling frequency while rare correct forms receive insufficient credit.
summary_en.importance: Identifies multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration in RLVR and proposes a lightweight fix without auxiliary-model inference; useful for understanding GRPO training dynamics at a mechanistic level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO uses deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces and redistributes positive advantages according to cluster rarity, requiring no auxiliary model inference. Credit Redistribution under Judge Partitions further validates the redistribution mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on AIME repeated-sampling; Cue-GRPO improves performance with largest gains at high sampling budgets. JP partition experiments confirm the redistribution mechanism.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用集中问题的观察比解法更有价值，高采样预算下偏差加剧这一点对大规模RLVR有参考；只看问题形式化和§3即可。
recommendation.en: The credit-concentration observation is more valuable than the fix; the fact that bias worsens at high sampling budgets matters for large-scale RLVR. Read the formalization and §3 only.

paper.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
paper.abstract: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address thes

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态深度研究Agent仅支持静态图像输入，无法适配连续视频流场景下的长时序多跳推理需求，且存在模态偏见（偏好文本搜索、回避视觉工具调用）和参数知识泄露（依赖内部记忆而非真实工具执行）两个核心瓶颈，同时缺乏适配该场景的训练数据构造管线和严格的评测基准。
summary.importance: 为视频类多模态基座的对齐训练提供了任务设计与数据构造的参考：感知-探索解耦的阶段式工具解锁机制可迁移至多模态Agent的后训练流程，用于缓解模态偏见；针对模态偏见、参数知识泄露的量化诊断方法，可用于通用多模态模型的对齐效果校验；强制双模态依赖的基准构造思路，也能避免评测被模型参数记忆污染。
summary.technical_approach: 将视频建模为关键实体轨迹的时序组合，设计Select_Keyframe（时序选帧）、Crop_Search（空间裁剪搜索）两类定制视觉工具，搭配标准网页搜索工具构成完整动作空间；采用解耦的感知-探索管线加阶段式工具解锁机制，强制Agent先完成跨帧视觉定位再执行网页检索，从训练流程上纠正模态偏见；训练采用两阶段管线：先监督微调，后接GRPO强化学习；同时搭建人机协同标注的VideoDR-Bench，共200个实例，每个问题都必须同时调用视觉搜索与外部知识推理才能解决，从根源上避免参数知识泄露；配套数据引擎产出30K视频定位QA对与7K人工校验的决策轨迹。
summary.experiments: 35B参数模型（Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B）在VideoDR-Bench上准确率达64.0%，超过Claude-4.5-Sonnet的59.0%；30B参数变体准确率59.3%，与专有闭源基线持平；前置诊断实验显示，现有开源模型单任务平均仅调用0.10次视觉工具，同期文本搜索调用达1.27次，GPT-5在几乎零工具调用的情况下仍能达到57%准确率，直接验证了模态偏见与参数知识泄露问题的存在。
summary.reading_guide: 先浏览Introduction部分的两个瓶颈诊断实验（模态偏见、参数知识泄露的量化统计），再查看Method章节的阶段式工具解锁机制与数据引擎构造逻辑，最后扫读VideoDR-Bench的标注规则与准入标准，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal deep research agents only accept static image inputs, failing to support long-horizon multi-hop reasoning in continuous video stream scenarios. They also face two critical bottlenecks: modality bias (preferring textual search over visual tool invocations) and parametric knowledge leakage (relying on internal memory instead of genuine tool execution), alongside a lack of suitable training data pipelines and rigorous evaluation benchmarks for this setting.
summary_en.importance: It provides practical references for alignment training of video-focused multimodal base models: the decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking can be transferred to post-training workflows of multimodal agents to mitigate modality bias; the quantitative diagnostic methods for modality bias and knowledge leakage are applicable to alignment validation of general multimodal models; the benchmark construction logic that enforces cross-modal dependency also prevents evaluation contamination from model parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video is modeled as a temporal composition of key entity trajectories. Two custom visual tools, Select_Keyframe for temporal frame selection and Crop_Search for spatial cropped visual search, are added to the action space alongside standard web search tools. A decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking is implemented to force agents to complete cross-frame visual grounding before web retrieval, correcting modality bias through training workflow design. Training follows a two-stage recipe: supervised fine-tuning first, then Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reinforcement learning. A human-AI collaborative benchmark VideoDR-Bench with 200 instances is built, where every question provably requires both visual search and external knowledge reasoning to eliminate parametric knowledge leakage. The supporting data engine produces 30K video-grounded QA pairs and 7K human-validated decision trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The 35B parameter model (Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B) reaches 64.0% accuracy on VideoDR-Bench, outperforming Claude-4.5-Sonnet which scores 59.0%; the 30B parameter variant achieves 59.3% accuracy, matching proprietary closed-source baselines. Pre-diagnostic experiments show existing open-source models invoke visual tools only 0.10 times per task on average, compared to 1.27 textual search calls, while GPT-5 attains 57% accuracy with nearly zero tool invocations, directly validating the existence of modality bias and parametric knowledge leakage.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the quantitative diagnostic experiments for the two bottlenecks (modality bias, parametric knowledge leakage) in the Introduction, then check the stage-wise tool unlocking mechanism and data engine design logic in the Method section, and finally skim the annotation protocol and admission criteria of VideoDR-Bench. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态智能体从静态图扩展到视频流的代表性工作，GRPO训练策略和阶段工具解锁设计对多模态后训练有参考价值，重点看方法部分。
recommendation.en: Representative work extending multimodal agents from static images to video streams; the GRPO training strategy and stage-wise tool unlocking design offer reference for multimodal post-training, focus on the method section.

paper.title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to deg

summary.core_problem: RSTG 解决的是 RLVR 中 GRPO 学习信号稀疏的问题，尤其是 group 内样本全错时的 negative zero-variance prompts。GRPO 在这种情况下没有相对优势，梯度会消失。直接加入 on-policy distillation 虽然能提供 token-level dense signal，但会带来 teacher-boundedness、样本不适配、token advantage 大量为负和局部前缀误差传播等问题，实际效果可能差于标准 GRPO。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有明确参考价值。它说明 dense teacher signal 不能无差别加入 RL，而应该只在 RL 无法给出有效梯度的位置补信号。这个思想对 RL 数据效率、verifier-based training、reasoning model 的失败样本挖掘都有启发。贡献量级属于方法级改进，不是新训练范式，但抓住了 GRPO+distillation 中一个常见且实际的问题：什么时候应该蒸馏，蒸馏哪些 token，以及如何避免过快贴近 teacher。
summary.technical_approach: RSTG 先把 GRPO、OPD 和 SFT 放到统一 policy-gradient 视角下分析。GRPO 用 group reward 的均值和方差估计 advantage；当组内 reward 相同，advantage 退化。OPD 在学生自己采样的轨迹上最小化 student 到 teacher 的 reverse KL，可写成 token-level advantage，其中 advantage 与 teacher-student log-prob gap 相关。问题是多数学生生成 token 在 teacher 下概率低，负 advantage 过多，会压制探索。RSTG 的处理有三部分。第一，sample selection：只在 student 失败但 teacher 能成功的样本上施加 OPD，重点覆盖 negative zero-variance prompts，并按 teacher mastery 加权。文中指出，仅使用全量数据的 3.63% 做这类 OPD，效果反而优于对所有样本蒸馏。第二，token selection：只更新学生高熵 token 或 teacher-student divergence 较大的 token，减少噪声，也减缓过早收敛到 teacher。第三，auxiliary SFT：在 negative zero-variance prompts 上使用 teacher 预生成的正确轨迹做 SFT，补充全局正向轨迹信号，缓解 OPD 只沿学生错误前缀给局部梯度的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 系列，在数学和代码 benchmark 上验证。相对于 naive GRPO+OPD，RSTG 在数学任务上提升 4.02%，在代码任务上提升 3.05%。文中还报告了几个训练动态层面的现象：选择性 OPD 能缓解 advantage asymmetry；token selection 会减缓向 teacher 的过快收敛；辅助 SFT 可以减少负样本组完全无梯度的问题；RSTG 还避免了 response length 的突然膨胀。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格，无法确认具体模型尺寸、每个 benchmark 的绝对分数和训练 token 数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 naive GRPO+OPD 失败原因的拆解，再看 Preliminaries 中把 OPD 写成 policy-gradient advantage 的推导，这部分决定了后续方法为什么要做 sample/token selection。方法部分重点看三件事：negative zero-variance prompts 的筛选规则、teacher mastery weighting、token-level mask 的定义。实验部分优先看 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 上的主结果、OPD 数据比例 3.63% 的消融、response length 曲线和 advantage distribution。若在做 RLVR recipe，这项工作最值得复用的是“只在 RL 失效处补 teacher signal”的训练调度，而不是简单叠加蒸馏 loss。

summary_en.core_problem: RSTG addresses the loss of learning signal in RLVR with GRPO, especially on negative zero-variance prompts where every sampled response in the group is wrong. In that case, group-relative advantages vanish. On-policy distillation can provide dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but a naive GRPO+OPD objective often performs worse because distillation is not useful for every sample, it can make the student converge too quickly to the teacher, and its token-level advantages are often negative on student-generated trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for the interface between RL post-training and pretraining-style learning signals. It argues that dense teacher supervision should not be applied uniformly; it should be used where RL has no useful gradient. This is relevant to RL data efficiency, verifier-based reasoning training, and failure-driven data construction. The contribution is a targeted recipe rather than a new training paradigm, but it addresses a practical failure mode in GRPO plus distillation: when to distill, which tokens to update, and how to avoid collapsing exploration toward the teacher too early.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSTG first analyzes GRPO, OPD, and SFT under a shared policy-gradient view. GRPO estimates advantages from group rewards; when all rewards in a group are identical, the advantage disappears. OPD minimizes reverse KL from the student to the teacher on student-generated trajectories and can be written as a token-level advantage based on the teacher-student log-probability gap. This dense signal is noisy and asymmetric because many student tokens have low teacher probability, producing mostly negative advantages. RSTG uses three controls. First, sample selection applies OPD only when the student fails and the teacher succeeds, focusing on negative zero-variance prompts and weighting the signal by teacher mastery. The paper reports that using only 3.63% of the full data in this way outperforms standard OPD over all samples. Second, token selection restricts updates to high-entropy student tokens or tokens with large teacher-student divergence, reducing noisy gradients and slowing premature teacher imitation. Third, auxiliary SFT uses teacher-generated correct trajectories on negative zero-variance prompts, adding a global positive trajectory signal that OPD lacks when it conditions on erroneous student prefixes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 model families on mathematical and code benchmarks. Compared with naive GRPO+OPD, RSTG improves math performance by 4.02% and code performance by 3.05%. The reported training dynamics support the method design: selective OPD mitigates advantage asymmetry, token selection slows convergence toward the teacher, auxiliary SFT restores positive learning signals for all-failed groups, and the full recipe avoids abrupt response-length inflation. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact model sizes, per-benchmark absolute scores, and training-token counts cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–30 minutes. Start with the introduction, especially the three failure modes of naive GRPO+OPD. Then read the preliminaries where OPD is rewritten as a policy-gradient objective; this derivation explains why sample and token selection are needed. In the method section, focus on the definition of negative zero-variance prompts, teacher mastery weighting, and the token-level update mask. In the experiments, prioritize the Qwen2.5/Qwen3 main results, the 3.63% data-ratio ablation, response-length curves, and advantage-distribution analysis. For RLVR recipe design, the reusable idea is to inject teacher signals only where RL has failed to produce gradients, rather than simply adding a distillation loss everywhere.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但它把“RL 缺梯度时该不该蒸馏、蒸馏到哪一层粒度”讲得比多数 RLVR 论文更干净；重点看失败分析和 selective guidance 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it is cleaner than most RLVR papers on when distillation should rescue missing RL gradients; read the failure analysis and the selective-guidance design.

paper.title: Latent Thought Credit: Multi-Answer Credit Assignment for Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning allows language models to carry out intermediate reasoning in continuous latent representations rather than fully externalizing it as discrete chains of thought. However, assigning credit to such latent thoughts from answer-only rewards is difficult: a single final answer mixes thought quality with answer-sampling noise. We propose \textbf{Latent Thought Credit (LTC)}, a hierarchical credit-assignment framework for latent reasoning. For each prompt, LTC samples multiple latent t

summary.core_problem: 潜推理将中间推理过程放在连续隐状态而非显式思维链中，导致难以从仅答案的奖励信号为隐式思维分配信用——单个答案的奖励混合了思维质量与答案采样噪声，无法稳定估计单条隐思维的实际效用。
summary.importance: 为潜推理范式的RL训练提供了分层信用分配的可行路径，解决了隐式推理步骤无显式监督时奖励噪声大的核心痛点，对RL预训练、潜推理模型训练有直接的方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LTC（Latent Thought Credit）分层信用分配框架。对每个prompt采样K条隐思维，固定每条思维后的上下文，再从该固定上下文采样M个离散答案，用答案奖励的均值估计该隐思维的期望效用。构造两层优势函数：思维级优势（同一prompt下不同隐思维的奖励对比）用于优化隐思维生成阶段，答案级优势（同一prompt下所有答案的组相对归一化）用于优化答案生成阶段，额外加入优势加权的思维匹配目标，引导当前策略复现高信用的隐思维。隐思维采样采用Gumbel-Softmax松弛得到连续嵌入混合的软token，而非离散token。
summary.experiments: 在推理和STEM基准上验证了LTC的有效性。消融实验显示多答案估计能稳定思维级信用分配，固定上下文诊断实验验证了固定后思维上下文再平均奖励的设计确实降低了估计方差。由于提供的手稿内容不完整，具体性能提升幅度、参数量等细节未披露。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读推荐看第2节方法部分的分层优势函数设计和多答案奖励估计推导，以及第3节的消融实验和固定上下文诊断部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。重点理解固定隐思维后上下文再采样多答案以降低信用估计噪声的逻辑，以及两层优势函数的分工机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Latent reasoning performs intermediate computation in continuous hidden states instead of explicit chain-of-thought tokens, making credit assignment from answer-only rewards challenging: a single answer's reward conflates latent thought quality with answer sampling noise, providing an unstable estimate of a thought's actual utility.
summary_en.importance: Provides a viable hierarchical credit assignment solution for RL training of latent reasoning models, addressing the core pain point of high reward variance when no explicit supervision exists for implicit reasoning steps. Offers direct methodological reference for RL pretrain and latent reasoning paradigm development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Latent Thought Credit (LTC), a hierarchical credit assignment framework. For each prompt, LTC samples K latent thoughts, freezes the post-thought context of each thought, then samples M discrete answers from that fixed context. The mean reward across these M answers estimates the expected utility of the corresponding latent thought. Two levels of advantages are constructed: thought-level advantages (comparing estimated rewards of different thoughts for the same prompt) optimize the latent thought generation phase, while answer-level advantages (group-relative normalization across all answers for the same prompt) optimize the answer generation phase. An advantage-weighted thought matching objective is added to guide the current policy to reproduce high-credit latent thoughts. Latent thoughts are sampled via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation as continuous embedding mixtures rather than discrete tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Effectiveness is validated on reasoning and STEM benchmarks. Ablation studies show multi-answer estimation stabilizes thought-level credit assignment, and fixed-context diagnostics confirm that averaging rewards across multiple answers from a frozen post-thought context reduces estimation variance. Specific performance gains, model sizes, and full experimental details are not available in the provided partial manuscript.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 (hierarchical advantage design and multi-answer reward estimation derivation) and Section 3 (ablation studies and fixed-context diagnostics). Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Key takeaway is the logic behind freezing post-thought context to reduce credit estimation noise, and the division of labor between the two advantage levels.

recommendation.zh: 针对latent reasoning的分层信用分配方案，做隐式推理或RL训练的可重点看§3的多采样信用估计和双阶段优势设计。
recommendation.en: Hierarchical credit assignment for latent reasoning; check §3 multi-sample credit estimation and two-stage advantage design for implicit reasoning RL training.

paper.title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent
paper.abstract: Multi-step search is a fundamental capability for search agents, enabling them to iteratively acquire, refine, and integrate external evidence for complex reasoning QA. However, vanilla GRPO allocates rewards exclusively based on the model's final outputs, yielding outcome-only supervision with no supervisory signals for intermediate reasoning steps. Such sparse supervision easily causes training instability and redundant search behaviors on multi-step search tasks. To mitigate this limitation,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 search-augmented agent 在多步检索场景下的 credit assignment 过于稀疏。标准 GRPO 只根据最终答案给 trajectory 一个 outcome reward，中间每一步 search 是否带来了新证据、是否是必要决策，都没有被单独评估。结果就是训练容易不稳定，策略会出现冗余搜索、无效迭代，甚至 collapse。论文的核心问题因此不是“怎么做更强的搜索 agent”，而是“怎么给多步搜索过程分配更细、更准的训练信号”。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身的直接关系较弱，更接近 post-train / agent RL 的过程监督问题。但如果关心 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口，这篇工作有一个明确启发：当模型需要通过外部工具逐步收集证据时，终局奖励过粗，训练信号质量会成为主要瓶颈。BiCAA 的价值在于把搜索步骤的好坏拆成两个维度：即时是否提升可解性，以及事后看是否对成功路径关键。这种双向 credit assignment 思路，对工具使用、检索增强推理、甚至长链 CoT 的过程奖励设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是构造 bidirectional process reward。作者认为单一过程奖励不够，因为只看 forward gain 会鼓励局部有帮助但整体冗余的搜索，只看 hindsight criticality 又缺少即时反馈，无法判断某一步到底带来了多少新信息。因此 BiCAA 同时建模两个信号。

第一部分是 forward solvability gain。对一个问题及其 ground-truth answer，作者把每一步检索看成增量证据收集。对于第 t 步，比较模型在看到前缀信息 o_{\le t} 与 o_{\le t-1} 时，对正确答案 a 的条件对数似然变化。这个变化量衡量该步搜索是否真的提高了模型对正确答案的信心。它本质上是“这一步新拿到的信息，是否让答案更可解”。

第二部分是 hindsight success criticality。这个分支从完整轨迹回看，评估某一步是否是通向正确最终答案的关键动作，而不是偶然带来一点局部增益的冗余步骤。摘要和正文给出的描述表明，作者会根据最终成功轨迹中的因果必要性或关键性，对各步赋予 retrospective credit。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整公式，但方法意图很清楚：如果某一步既提高了局部 solvability，又在回看时被证明是成功路径上的关键节点，那么它应得到更高奖励；如果只是带来轻微局部提升，但对最终成功并不关键，则应被下调。

在这两个信号之上，BiCAA 设计了一个 modulation rule，把 hindsight criticality 用来调制 forward gain，形成更有区分度的 process reward。最后再把 process reward 与 trajectory-level outcome reward 一起做 unified advantage estimation，用于 RL 更新。这个设计的取舍很明确：不放弃终局监督，因为最终答案仍是全局目标；但也不再让中间步骤完全靠终局 reward 反传。与 vanilla GRPO 相比，BiCAA 的主要创新不在优化器，而在 reward decomposition 和 credit shaping。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，作者的实验重点是两类指标：一类是最终 answer quality，另一类是搜索行为质量，比如冗余搜索是否减少、搜索路径是否更高效。论文声称 BiCAA 在多步搜索任务上能降低 redundant search behavior，并取得有竞争力的答案质量。结合方法设计，最该关注的不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是过程层面的变化：平均搜索步数是否下降、无效检索比例是否下降、训练曲线是否更稳定、相比 vanilla GRPO 是否更少出现 policy collapse。

由于当前提供的正文片段没有完整实验表和具体数字，能确认的结论是：作者把 dense process reward 与 outcome reward 联合使用，而不是只替换终局奖励；实验结论支持这种联合 credit assignment 优于纯 outcome-only 训练。若阅读全文，建议重点核对三类消融：只用 forward gain、只用 hindsight criticality、两者融合后的差异；以及 modulation rule 和 unified advantage estimation 各自带来的增益。如果这些消融充分，才能说明提升来自双向 credit assignment，而不是简单加了更多 reward shaping。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction，确认作者到底在批评 vanilla GRPO 的什么缺陷。然后直接看方法部分里 forward solvability gain 和 hindsight success criticality 的定义，弄清楚每个信号在奖励里扮演什么角色。最后看实验中的行为分析，而不只是最终正确率。

如果只有 15 到 25 分钟，建议看：任务定义、两个 reward 分支的公式、reward fusion / advantage estimation、主结果表、搜索效率分析。阅读时重点问三个问题。第一，forward gain 的计算是否依赖 ground-truth answer，因此训练时是否只能用于有标注 QA 场景。第二，hindsight criticality 是如何近似“关键步骤”的，是否稳定、是否容易受轨迹噪声影响。第三，这套奖励是否会过度偏向短路径，导致必要探索被压制。若论文对这三点交代得不够完整，方法的泛化边界就需要保留判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a credit-assignment problem in search-augmented agents. In multi-step retrieval and reasoning, vanilla GRPO assigns reward only from the final answer, so intermediate search actions receive no direct supervision. That makes training unstable and often produces redundant or ineffective search behavior. The central question is therefore not how to build a stronger search agent in general, but how to assign informative credit to each search step in a multi-step trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to pretraining is indirect, but it is relevant at the pretrain–post-train interface because it focuses on training-signal quality. When a model must gather evidence through external tools, terminal rewards are often too sparse to shape useful behavior. The paper’s main contribution is to decompose step quality into two dimensions: whether a step immediately improves answerability, and whether it is retrospectively critical to a successful trajectory. That framing is useful beyond search agents. It could inform process rewards for tool use, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and long-chain reasoning where outcome-only supervision is too weak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
BiCAA builds a bidirectional process reward. The paper argues that a single process signal is insufficient. Forward-looking rewards encourage locally helpful search, but they do not distinguish necessary steps from redundant ones. Pure hindsight credit can identify pivotal decisions after the fact, but it does not tell the agent whether a step actually improved the information state when it happened. BiCAA combines both.

The first branch is forward solvability gain. For a question with ground-truth answer, each retrieval step is treated as incremental evidence acquisition. At step t, the method compares the model’s conditional log-likelihood of the correct answer given the trajectory prefix up to t versus up to t-1. This marginal change measures whether the newly retrieved evidence makes the answer more solvable. In other words, it is an immediate estimate of how much that search action improved the model’s belief in the correct answer.

The second branch is hindsight success criticality. This branch looks back over the full trajectory and estimates whether a step was actually pivotal for reaching a correct final answer, rather than merely producing a small local gain. The full formula is not visible in the provided excerpt, but the intended role is clear: steps that are causally important to successful trajectories should receive more credit, while accidental or redundant steps should be downweighted.

BiCAA then uses a modulation rule to combine the two signals. A step that both increases local solvability and proves critical in hindsight gets amplified credit. A step with only weak local gain or low retrospective importance gets reduced credit. Finally, the calibrated process reward is fused with the trajectory-level outcome reward through unified advantage estimation for RL updates. The novelty is therefore in reward decomposition and credit shaping, not in a new RL optimizer.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, the experimental story is centered on two outcomes: final answer quality and search behavior quality. The paper claims that BiCAA reduces redundant search behavior and achieves competitive answer performance on multi-step search tasks. Given the method, the most important evidence is not a single benchmark score but process-level analysis: fewer unnecessary search iterations, better search efficiency, more stable training, and less policy collapse compared with vanilla GRPO.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables or exact numbers, so the strongest confirmed conclusion is that combining dense process rewards with outcome rewards works better than outcome-only supervision. When reading the full paper, the key ablations to check are: forward solvability gain alone, hindsight criticality alone, and the fused BiCAA reward; plus the contribution of the modulation rule and unified advantage estimation. Without those ablations, it would be hard to tell whether the gains come from the bidirectional credit design itself or simply from adding more reward shaping.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to see the exact failure mode the authors attribute to vanilla GRPO. Then go straight to the definitions of forward solvability gain and hindsight success criticality, because those are the conceptual core. After that, focus on the behavior analysis in experiments rather than only final accuracy.

If you have 15 to 25 minutes, read the task setup, the two reward branches, the reward fusion and advantage estimation, the main result table, and the search-efficiency analysis. Keep three questions in mind. First, forward solvability gain uses the ground-truth answer, so how restricted is the method to supervised QA-style settings? Second, how is hindsight criticality approximated, and how sensitive is it to noisy trajectories? Third, does the reward design over-favor short trajectories and suppress necessary exploration? If the paper does not answer these clearly, its generalization boundary is limited.

recommendation.zh: 过程奖励+双向信用分配的思路对RL训练推理/Agent模型有参考，重点看两个步级评估准则的设计
recommendation.en: Process reward + bidirectional credit assignment offers useful insights for RL training of reasoning/agent models; focus on the two step-level evaluation criteria.

paper.title: HindSearch: Trajectory-Level Hindsight Critique for Search-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Search-augmented LM agents are typically trained with a binary exact-match reward, which throws away most of what a failed trajectory tells us about why it failed. We introduce HindSearch, a hindsight self-distillation procedure for GRPO: after each rollout, a frozen judge writes a short critique of every failed trajectory using the gold answer, and the critique supplies an auxiliary on-policy distillation signal on the student's search actions. On the standard seven-benchmark suite with Qwen2.5

summary.core_problem: 搜索增强 LM agent 用 GRPO 训练时，二值 EM reward 只告诉整条轨迹成没成功，不告诉为什么失败；失败轨迹里的 query、检索片段和训练时可见的 gold answer 包含大量可利用的信息，却被 outcome-only 目标丢弃，导致信用分配延迟和训练不稳。
summary.importance: 属于 post-training / agent RL 方向，对预训练本身的直接启发有限，但对理解 pretrain→posttrain 接口有间接价值：它展示了如何把稀疏 outcome reward 用 hindsight 信息稠密化成 per-token 监督，且不依赖在线 process reward model。这种「训练时可见答案 → 事后批评 → 蒸馏到动作 token」的思路，对思考搜索型/工具型后训练数据合成和 RL 信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 trajectory-level hindsight critique (TLHC)，叠加在 GRPO 上。每次 rollout 后，把失败轨迹连同 gold answer 一起发给冻结的 judge（Qwen3.6-27B），生成 1–2 句关于「应该怎么搜」的批评。该批评作为前缀注入到冻结 teacher（即学生初始化，同时也是 GRPO 的 KL anchor），在学生失败轨迹的 search-action token 上计算 on-policy distillation (OPD) loss。OPD 用 clamp 系数（对 teacher-student logprob 差做 stop-gradient）只在 teacher 比 student 更自信的 token 上提梯度，下 clamp 限制梯度流向、上 clamp 防止 outlier 主导；answer token 留给 GRPO。总目标 = GRPO + λ_OPD·L_OPD，λ=0.01。关键设计是 judge 能看到 gold answer，所以批评是 directive（告诉你该做什么）而非 evaluative（打分），且事后生成无需在线 PRM。
summary.experiments: 在七个 QA benchmark（NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle）上评测，共 51,713 验证样本；训练数据为 NQ+HotpotQA 训练集（169k），其余五个 zero-shot。Backbone 为 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，retriever 为 E5-base-v2 over Wikipedia-18，top-3，最多 4 轮。HindSearch 平均 EM 39.4%，超过 Search-R1 PPO/GRPO、ZeroSearch 等搜索-RL baseline，300 步训练稳定。关键消融：去掉 judge 对 gold answer 的访问权后大部分增益消失，说明 hindsight（而非批评本身）是增益来源。OPD 每步增加约 15% 墙钟时间，2×H200 训练。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Method 中 TLHC 的流程和 OPD loss 的 clamp 设计——这是把自然语言批评转成 per-token 梯度且不破坏 GRPO 稳定性的关键。再看消融中「judge 看不到 gold answer 则增益消失」这一条，它直接验证了 hindsight 信号的必要性。对预训练研究员，可快速浏览，重点想这种事后稠密信号能否迁移到其他长信用分配链的 RL 场景。预计 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Search-augmented LM agents trained with GRPO receive only a binary EM reward that signals whether a whole trajectory succeeded, not why it failed. A failed trajectory contains the issued queries, retrieved snippets, and—at training time—the gold answer, but an outcome-only objective discards all of this, causing long credit-assignment delays and instability.
summary_en.importance: This is post-training / agent RL work with limited direct relevance to pretraining itself, but it has indirect value for understanding the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It shows how to densify a sparse outcome reward into per-token supervision using hindsight information, without an online process reward model. The train-time-answer → post-hoc critique → distillation-into-action-tokens pattern is relevant to reasoning/search/tool-use post-training data synthesis and RL signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory-level hindsight critique (TLHC) is added on top of GRPO. After each rollout, every failed trajectory is sent to a frozen judge (Qwen3.6-27B) together with the gold answer, producing a 1–2 sentence critique of what should have been searched differently. The critique is broadcast as a prefix to a frozen teacher (the student's initialization, also the GRPO KL anchor), whose log-probabilities supply an on-policy distillation (OPD) loss on the student's search-action tokens within failed trajectories. The OPD loss uses a clamp coefficient with a stop-gradient on the teacher-student logprob gap, so gradients flow only on tokens where the teacher is more confident than the student; a lower clamp restricts gradient flow and an upper clamp prevents outliers from dominating. Answer tokens are left to GRPO. Total objective is GRPO + λ_OPD·L_OPD with λ=0.01. The key design choice is that the judge sees the gold answer, making the critique directive rather than evaluative, and post-hoc generation removes the need for an online PRM.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on seven QA benchmarks (NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, Bamboogle), 51,713 validation samples total; training uses NQ+HotpotQA train splits (169k), the other five are zero-shot. Backbone is Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, retriever E5-base-v2 over Wikipedia-18, top-3, up to 4 turns. HindSearch reaches 39.4% average EM, outperforming Search-R1 PPO/GRPO, ZeroSearch, and other search-RL baselines, with stable training over 300 steps. The key ablation: removing the judge's access to the gold answer erases most of the gain, isolating hindsight (rather than critique style) as the source of improvement. OPD adds ~15% wall-clock per step; trained on 2×H200.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the Method section's TLHC procedure and the OPD clamp design—that is the mechanism that turns natural-language critique into per-token gradients without destabilizing GRPO. Then look at the ablation showing that gains vanish when the judge cannot see the gold answer, which directly validates hindsight as the causal signal. For pretrain researchers, a quick pass suffices; the transferable idea is whether such post-hoc dense signals can apply to other RL settings with long credit-assignment chains. Estimated 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 本质是用 gold answer 做 hindsight relabeling 的 RL 变体，增益来源清晰，只看 ablation 部分（移除 gold answer 那组）即可。
recommendation.en: Essentially hindsight relabeling for search RL with gold answers; gain source is cleanly isolated. Read only the ablation where gold answer access is removed.

paper.title: LEAP: Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning for Code RL in GPU Kernel Generation
paper.abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced code generation capabilities. To bypass the heavy memory footprint of critic networks, current state-of-the-art frameworks leverage critic-free paradigms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) tied to rule-based verification sandboxes. However, applying these frameworks to low-level systems programming, such as CUDA kernel generation-presents severe challenges: binary pass/fail rewards i

summary.core_problem: 在 CUDA kernel 生成这类低层系统代码任务上，基于规则验证的 GRPO 强化学习面临奖励稀疏、多轮环境反馈编译延迟高、以及最终奖励沿轨迹稀释的问题，导致大规模 code RL 训练效率低且早期轮次准确率受损。
summary.importance: 对预训练后用 RL 提升代码能力有直接参考价值，尤其是在编译器/硬件反馈昂贵、二元奖励信号稀疏的场景。其核心启发是：多轮 RL 不必对所有样本均匀展开，而应按题目难度和组内成功率分配环境交互预算；优势函数也可以用非参数排序方式替代手工回合奖励权重。
summary.technical_approach: LEAP 在 critic-free 的 GRPO 框架内引入 Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning：按一组 rollout 的聚合通过率估计题目难度，简单题目跳过多轮展开，只保留单轮或较少交互；困难题目才进行多轮调试分支，从而减少编译和硬件执行开销。同时提出基于排序的非参数优势计算，把 rollout 按成功所需轮次映射到序数层级，在组内通过 pairwise win-loss 分布计算相对优势，避免为中间轮次手工设定奖励系数。该设计对简单题目自然惩罚多余轮次，对困难题目则奖励逐步修复错误的进展。
summary.experiments: 可用文本中未给出具体基准数字和模型规模。论文声称 LEAP 在保持甚至超过稠密多轮基线性能的同时，显著降低训练时间和编译/沙箱执行开销；早期轮次通过率不会因多轮训练而下降。具体消融应关注 DCP 难度阈值、剪枝比例、排序优势与手工回合奖励的对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。建议重点看方法部分对 reward dilution 的形式化、DCP 的难度判定与剪枝策略，以及 rank-based advantage 如何在 GRPO group 内归一化。若关注代码 RL 落地，可进一步查看其多轮 rollout 调度和编译延迟统计。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Rule-based GRPO reinforcement learning for CUDA kernel generation suffers from sparse binary rewards, high compilation and hardware-feedback latency in multi-turn trajectories, and reward dilution when a single final outcome is propagated across all debugging turns.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to post-training code RL, especially for tasks where environment feedback is expensive and pass/fail signals are sparse. The main useful idea is that multi-turn interaction should be treated as a scarce resource: easy prompts already contain enough successful rollouts, while hard prompts need dense iterative feedback. The rank-based advantage also offers a heuristic-free alternative to manually tuned per-turn rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: LEAP extends critic-free GRPO with Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning. It estimates prompt difficulty from the aggregate pass rate of sampled rollouts, skips multi-turn expansion for easy problems, and reserves branching and environment interaction for hard kernels. It also replaces scalar intermediate-turn rewards with a non-parametric ordinal advantage: rollouts are ranked by how efficiently they succeed, and relative advantages are derived from pairwise win-loss statistics within each GRPO group. This yields an implicit penalty for unnecessary turns on easy prompts and rewards incremental debugging progress on hard prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The available text does not include concrete benchmark numbers or model sizes. The paper claims that LEAP matches or improves the performance of dense unpruned multi-turn baselines while substantially reducing training time, compilation cycles, and sandbox execution cost, and that it preserves early-turn pass rates. The ablations to inspect are DCP thresholding, pruning ratios, and rank-based advantage versus hand-tuned turn rewards.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the formulation of reward dilution, the difficulty estimator and pruning rule in DCP, and the ordinal group-normalized advantage computation. If engineering code RL at scale, look for the rollout scheduler and compilation-latency breakdown. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 代码RL领域的效率优化工作，做代码对齐或多轮环境交互RL的可重点看DCP剪枝机制的设计思路。
recommendation.en: Efficiency optimization work for code RL; researchers working on code alignment or multi-turn RL with environment feedback can focus on the DCP pruning mechanism design.

paper.title: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often require carefully crafted prompts to unlock their full potential, which can be a barrier for non-expert users. This work addresses the challenge by introducing a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter (TAPR), a model that reformulates user prompts into task-optimized prompts with the explicit goal of improving downstream LLM performance. We train TAPR using reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where rewards are derived from LLM-as-judge ev

summary.core_problem: 解决普通用户 prompt 质量不稳定导致 LLM 下游任务表现受限的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练和提示优化方法。它把 prompt rewriting 显式训练成一个策略模型，并用 GRPO 与 LLM-as-judge 奖励优化，对 RL 训练接口层能力有一定参考，但不是预训练方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter，将用户原始 prompt 改写成更适合任务的 prompt；以 Phi-4-mini-instruct 作为 TAPR 基座，用 GRPO 训练；奖励来自 LLM-as-judge，同时评估改写 prompt 本身和改写后下游输出质量。
summary.experiments: 覆盖问答、摘要、算术推理等任务；摘要称在 Natural Questions 和 GSM8K 等基准上带来一致提升，改写 prompt 更清晰、更具指令性。未给出具体提升幅度、judge 校准细节、训练集规模和与强 prompt-optimization baseline 的完整比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable user prompt quality, which can limit downstream LLM performance.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and prompt-optimization contribution. It trains prompt rewriting as an explicit policy optimized with GRPO and LLM-as-judge rewards. It is relevant to RL-trained interface behavior, but not to pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAPR rewrites raw user prompts into task-optimized prompts. The authors fine-tune Phi-4-mini-instruct with GRPO, using rewards derived from LLM-as-judge evaluations of both the rewritten prompt and the resulting task output.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on question answering, summarization, and arithmetic reasoning. The abstract reports consistent gains on benchmarks such as Natural Questions and GSM8K, with prompts becoming clearer and more instructive. Exact gains, judge calibration, training-set size, and comparisons to strong prompt-optimization baselines are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 常规 GRPO 包装 prompt rewriting；只看奖励定义和 judge 泄漏控制，别期待训练范式新东西。
recommendation.en: This is standard GRPO wrapped around prompt rewriting; inspect the reward design and judge-leakage controls, not the method as a new training paradigm.

paper.title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
paper.abstract: Existing video captioning models generate natural descriptions of video content but cannot explicitly ground local visual elements to multiple reference images. We introduce multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a new task requiring factual video descriptions with phrase-level reference grounding, and propose RefCaptioner, a two-stage post-training framework for this task. RefCaptioner combines mixed-data SFT with Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO to jointly improve reference sele

summary.core_problem: 解决视频字幕模型不能把局部视觉短语显式绑定到多张参考图的问题，目标是在生成视频描述时同时完成参考选择、短语级 grounding 和干扰参考拒绝。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态后训练任务定义、训练数据和评测资产：提出 multi-reference image-grounded video captioning，构建 2 万视频、171,354 张参考图的训练语料，并给出 MRVBench 评估视频事实性和多参考 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RefCaptioner 两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用混合数据 SFT 保持通用视频描述能力并学习多参考绑定；第二阶段用 Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO，把参考覆盖、短语绑定、干扰项拒绝和跨参考一致性纳入奖励设计。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖真实视频和 AI 生成视频上的 MRVBench，并与开源视频字幕模型比较。摘要称 RefCaptioner 在开源模型中取得最佳总体表现，同时尽量保持原有视频字幕能力；未给出参数规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses video captioning with explicit phrase-level grounding to multiple reference images, including reference selection, local binding, distractor rejection, and cross-reference consistency.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a multimodal post-training task, dataset, and evaluation asset: multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a corpus of 20,000 videos and 171,354 reference images, and MRVBench for factuality and multi-reference grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: RefCaptioner uses a two-stage post-training pipeline. Mixed-data SFT teaches the grounding behavior while preserving generic captioning ability, and Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO optimizes coverage, phrase-reference binding, distractor rejection, and consistency rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on MRVBench over real-world and AI-generated videos against open-source video captioning models. The abstract reports the best overall open-source performance while retaining general captioning ability, but does not expose model scale or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 多参考 grounding 的奖励设计可以扫一眼，主要价值在任务和数据定义；对基座预训练没有直接动作。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward design for multi-reference grounding; the value is in the task/data definition, not in a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is central to improving long-CoT reasoning in large language models. Critic-free methods such as GRPO convert response-level rewards into advantages and uniformly broadcast them across tokens, overlooking their unequal contributions to the final outcome. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) instead provides dense distributional supervision by minimizing the forward KL divergence between an unprivileged policy and a privileged self-teacher, impl

summary.core_problem: GRPO 等无 critic 的 RLVR 方法把序列级奖励均匀广播到所有 token，而 on-policy self-distillation 假设 privileged teacher 下的似然位移包含与答案对齐的 token 级信用。论文检验这两类 token 级信用信号是否真的携带可靠的对错极性，发现它们在长 CoT 上大多不成立，并据此提出基于反事实敏感性的信用重分配方法。
summary.importance: 直接切入当前长 CoT RLVR 训练的核心痛点：信用分配。论文的诊断部分价值很高——它用反事实重打分证明，无论是 GRPO 隐含的 uniform credit 还是 OPSD 隐含的“似然位移即信用”，都与真正决定结果的 token 严重错位。这一结论对改进 RLVR 目标、设计更可靠的 dense supervision、理解长推理链训练动态都有实质影响。
summary.technical_approach: 核心诊断手段是反事实敏感性分析：给定问题 x 和一条 on-policy 采样轨迹 y，固定每个前缀，分别在两个相反的 privileged 条件下重打分每个 token：c^pos 将整条轨迹标记为正确，c^neg 将整条轨迹标记为错误，计算两个条件下该 token 对数似然相对于原始策略的位移 z^pos_i、z^neg_i。如果位移真的编码了答案极性，两个方向应当符号相反、幅度区分正确与错误 token。实验发现：82%–85% 的 token 在两种条件下都不敏感；在共同敏感的 token 中，91%–96% 的 z^pos 和 z^neg 符号相同，说明位移主要反映的是“当给最终答案相关的提示时，这类表面/衔接 token 的通用重加权”，而非对错极性；forward-KL 的优化量级有约 58% 在正反条件下重叠，大位移 token 多为 Wait、There 等可替换的表层词。基于这一观察，论文提出 Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation（CSCR）：用正反条件下位移的差异而非绝对值来度量每个 token 对结果的真实敏感性，据此重分配 token-level advantage，避免对无语义极性的表层 token 施加一致方向的梯度。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验覆盖数学/代码等典型 RLVR 场景，在长 CoT 轨迹上统计 token 级敏感性：λ=0.05 阈值下，82.4%–84.7% 的 token 双条件均不显著，仅 8.2%–10.4% 在双条件下均显著；其中 91.4%–95.8% 同号；约 58% 的 forward-KL 优化量级在正反条件重叠；大位移 token 集中在表面形式词。所提 CSCR 在相同 RLVR 框架下相较 GRPO 和 OPSD 类基线取得一致收益（论文后续实验部分在提供片段中被截断，具体模型规模与绝对点数未完整给出，但诊断数据本身已足够支撑核心结论）。
summary.reading_guide: 必须精读。第 1 节的反事实构造（表 1、图 1）是整篇论文的关键，建议对照公式仔细读 z^pos/z^neg 的定义以及“同号占比”的含义；接着看 forward-KL 重叠比例与表层 token 的定性分析，这是对 OPSD 类方法前提最直接的反驳；方法部分重点关注 CSCR 如何把正反差异转换成 advantage 重分配权重，而不是再引入一个额外 teacher；消融部分建议看不同阈值 λ 下的稳定性，以及敏感 token 是否集中在真正的推导步骤（如算术运算、关键引理调用、代码关键语句）上。值得深挖的点：这种反事实敏感性与过程监督模型、attention 权重、logit lens 定位的“决策 token”是否重合；在不同长度 CoT 下稀疏度是否随长度恶化。

summary_en.core_problem: Critic-free RLVR methods such as GRPO broadcast sequence-level rewards uniformly to every token, while on-policy self-distillation assumes that likelihood shifts under a privileged teacher encode answer-aligned token credit. The paper tests whether these token-level credit signals actually carry reliable correct/incorrect polarity on long-CoT reasoning trajectories, finds that they largely do not, and proposes a counterfactual-sensitivity-based credit reallocation method.
summary_en.importance: The paper directly targets a core pain point in current long-CoT RLVR: credit assignment. Its diagnostic contribution is substantial. Using counterfactual rescoring, it shows that both the uniform credit implicitly used by GRPO and the “likelihood shift equals credit” assumption implicit in OPSD are severely misaligned with the tokens that actually determine outcomes. This has concrete implications for improving RLVR objectives, designing more reliable dense supervision, and understanding training dynamics on long reasoning chains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central diagnostic tool is a counterfactual sensitivity analysis. Given a problem x and an on-policy trajectory y, every prefix is held fixed and each token y_i is rescored under two opposing privileged conditions: c^pos marks the whole trajectory as correct and c^neg marks it as wrong. The per-token log-likelihood shifts relative to the original policy are denoted z^pos_i and z^neg_i. If shifts truly encoded answer polarity, the two directions should have opposite signs and their magnitudes should distinguish correct from incorrect tokens. Instead, 82%–85% of tokens are insensitive under both conditions at λ=0.05; among jointly sensitive tokens, 91%–96% have the same sign under c^pos and c^neg, indicating that shifts mainly reflect generic reweighting of surface/connector tokens once a final-answer hint is provided, rather than answer polarity. Roughly 58% of the forward-KL optimization magnitude overlaps between opposing conditions, and large-shift tokens are dominated by substitutable surface-form tokens such as “Wait” and “There”. Building on this observation, the paper proposes Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation (CSCR), which uses the difference between the two counterfactual shifts, rather than their absolute magnitude, to measure a token’s true sensitivity to the outcome, and reallocates token-level advantages accordingly, avoiding uniform gradients on non-polar surface tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments are run on typical RLVR domains such as math and code over long-CoT trajectories. At threshold λ=0.05, 82.4%–84.7% of tokens are insignificant under both conditions and only 8.2%–10.4% are significant under both; among those, 91.4%–95.8% share the same sign; about 58% of forward-KL optimization magnitude overlaps between the two opposing conditions; large-shift tokens are concentrated in surface-form words. Under the same RLVR framework, CSCR provides consistent gains over GRPO and OPSD-style baselines. The provided excerpt cuts off before full numerical results (model sizes and absolute scores are not fully shown), but the diagnostic statistics alone already support the main claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must read. The counterfactual construction in Section 1 (Table 1 and Figure 1), together with the definitions of z^pos and z^neg and the interpretation of the “same-sign ratio”, is the key to the whole paper and should be read carefully with the formulas. The forward-KL overlap and the qualitative analysis of surface tokens are the most direct rebuttal of the premise behind OPSD-style methods. In the method section, focus on how CSCR converts the difference between counterfactual shifts into advantage-reallocation weights without introducing an additional teacher. In ablations, look at stability across thresholds λ and at whether sensitive tokens concentrate on genuine reasoning steps (arithmetic operations, key lemma invocations, critical code statements). A good direction to dig deeper: whether counterfactual sensitivity overlaps with tokens identified by process reward models, attention weights, or logit-lens “decision tokens”, and whether sparsity worsens as CoT length grows.

recommendation.zh: 直接动摇GRPO/OPSD的token级信用分配基础，应立刻在内部RLVR实验中复现反事实评分诊断，§3的符号反转分析是核心。
recommendation.en: Directly undermines the token-level credit allocation foundation of GRPO/OPSD; immediately replicate the counterfactual re-scoring diagnosis in internal RLVR experiments, with §3 sign-reversal analysis as the core.

paper.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多轮推理 refinement 中的计算分配问题：模型什么时候应该保留当前答案，什么时候应该继续修改。关键约束是推理时不能依赖外部 verifier、执行器或真实正确性信号，只能用模型自己生成的判断和置信度来控制停止。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning post-train 和 test-time compute 设计有参考价值。它把 self-verification 从一个事后解释信号，变成了控制推理预算的策略信号。这个角度值得注意，因为后续预训练或中训练如果要培养可控推理能力，不能只看最终答案正确率，还要看模型能否识别当前状态是否值得继续计算。论文也提醒一个实际问题：置信度校准错误会直接变成计算分配错误。低估会浪费 refinement，高估会提前停止在错误答案上。
summary.technical_approach: SVR 让模型在每一轮同时输出三类内容：解答、离散 verdict，以及一个表示当前答案正确概率的 confidence。verdict 包括 Correct、Incorrect、Unsure。推理时，如果 verdict 是 Correct 且 confidence 超过阈值，就停止并返回当前答案；否则把原题、上一轮解答和模型自己的 self-verification 一起放入下一轮 prompt，继续 refinement。训练使用固定 horizon 轨迹，不在训练阶段直接优化实际 token 用量。奖励来自真实正确性，但真实标签只用于构造 reward，不进入 refinement prompt，也不在推理时使用。优化目标基于 GRPO，把每轮的解题得分、self-verification 得分和格式得分合成 trajectory return。一个细节是：中间轮参与 return 计算并作为后续上下文，但不是独立优化样本；被监督的是最终 completion tokens。confidence 部分使用类似 Brier score 的校准目标，并额外惩罚高置信错误，鼓励模型识别错误状态和可停止的正确状态。和固定预算 refinement 相比，SVR 的差别不在于多生成几轮，而在于把“是否继续”变成了模型内部策略。和外部 verifier 方法相比，它把部署时的信息边界收紧到模型自身输出。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3.5-2B，在 7 个数学推理 benchmark 上评估，覆盖算术搜索、小学数学应用题、竞赛数学和多步推理。SVR 的 All-7 macro-average accuracy 为 0.563，平均推理轮数为 2.99。相对最强 non-oracle 多轮 baseline 提升 7.5 个百分点；在完整系统比较中，比论文评估的 fixed-budget oracle-guided reference 高 4.4 个百分点。固定预算 sweep 显示，同一个训练后 policy 如果强制所有样本在同一轮停止，没有任何一个共享停止轮能匹配自适应 SVR，说明收益主要来自按样本保留答案，而不是简单增加 refinement 轮数。论文还报告 SVR 在总准确率上接近 10-sample GRPO majority voting，但 token 消耗大约只有一半。这个结果支持 self-verification 作为内部 compute-control signal 的可行性，但也要注意实验集中在数学推理和 2B 规模模型，结论还不能直接外推到更大模型、代码执行类任务或开放式任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、方法部分的 Joint Verdict–Confidence RL、推理时 stopping rule，以及 Table 1 / Figure 1 附近的主结果。重点看两个问题：第一，reward 如何同时约束答案正确性、verdict 和 confidence；第二，固定 horizon 训练为什么仍能在推理时产生计算节省。消融部分如果完整可见，应优先看 confidence 阈值、verdict 类型、去掉校准项、固定停止轮 sweep。预计阅读 20–30 分钟即可把主要设计和局限看清。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets adaptive refinement for reasoning models: when should a model keep its current answer, and when should it spend another refinement turn? The key constraint is that inference cannot rely on an external verifier, executor, or correctness oracle. The stopping decision must be driven by signals produced by the policy itself.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to reasoning post-training and inference-time compute than to base pretraining directly. Its useful contribution is to treat self-verification as a control signal, not merely as a post-hoc uncertainty statement. That distinction matters because confidence calibration errors become compute-allocation errors: underconfidence wastes refinement on already-correct answers, while overconfidence can terminate incorrect trajectories too early. For pretraining researchers interested in trainable reasoning behavior, the paper points to a concrete interface between answer quality, calibration, and compute control.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVR makes the model emit, at every turn, a solution, a discrete verdict, and a confidence estimate. The verdict is one of Correct, Incorrect, or Unsure. At inference, the trajectory stops only when the verdict is Correct and the confidence exceeds a threshold; otherwise, the next prompt includes the original problem, the previous solution, and the model’s own self-verification. Correctness labels are used during training to build rewards, but they are never inserted into refinement prompts and are not available to the inference controller. Training uses fixed-horizon trajectories with a GRPO-style objective. Per-turn solve, verification, and format scores are averaged into a trajectory return, while optimization is applied to the final completion tokens rather than treating intermediate turns as separate samples. The confidence reward uses a Brier-style calibration term, penalizes confident mistakes, and encourages recognizing both error states and correct states that are eligible for stopping. Compared with fixed-budget refinement, the main change is not longer reasoning but learned answer retention. Compared with verifier-guided methods, the deployment-time information boundary is reduced to the model’s own outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3.5-2B on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including arithmetic search, grade-school word problems, competition math, and multi-step reasoning. SVR reaches an All-7 macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with 2.99 inference turns on average. It improves over the strongest non-oracle multi-turn baseline by 7.5 percentage points and is reported to exceed the evaluated fixed-budget oracle-guided reference by 4.4 points in the complete-system comparison. Fixed-budget sweeps with the same trained policies show that no single shared stopping turn matches adaptive SVR, which supports the claim that the gain comes from instance-level retention rather than simply generating more turns. SVR also matches the aggregate accuracy of 10-sample GRPO majority voting while using roughly half as many tokens. The scope is still bounded: the evidence is mainly mathematical reasoning with a 2B-scale model, so transfer to larger models, code execution tasks, or open-ended generation remains an open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction, the Joint Verdict–Confidence RL objective, the inference-time stopping rule, and the main results around Table 1 and Figure 1. The highest-value details are how the reward couples correctness, verdict, and confidence, and why fixed-horizon training can still yield token savings at inference. If the ablations are available, check threshold sensitivity, removal of calibration terms, verdict variants, and fixed-turn stopping sweeps. A focused read should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 自验证+RL实现自适应测试时计算的思路很实用，校准感知的奖励设计可直接引入内部RL后训练ablation，重点看§3的奖励定义
recommendation.en: Self-verification + RL for adaptive test-time compute is practical; the calibration-aware reward design can be directly introduced into internal RL post-training ablations, focus on §3 reward formulation.

paper.title: LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) for mathematical reasoning suffers from a structural blind spot: on "cliff" prompts-those on which every sampled rollout in a group fails-the group-normalized advantage is identically zero, so GRPO produces no gradient on precisely the prompts at the frontier of the model's capability. We introduce LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO), a sampling-time mechanism that recovers this lost gradient. Each RL step, LSPO detects cliff prompts,

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RLVR 里的 cliff prompt：对于某个题目，如果 GRPO 一组采样全错，组内 reward 方差为零，advantage 也为零，模型恰好在不会做的题上拿不到梯度。
summary.importance: 启发点在训练信号质量。RLVR 的难点不只是 reward 是否可验证，还包括采样分布能否产生可学习的 reward 差异。LSPO 提供了一个有意思的接口：用短暂的监督适配器改善采样分布，但最终只更新 base policy。这对数学推理 RL、难例课程构造、以及 SFT 信号如何间接进入 RL 都有参考意义。不过它依赖 ground-truth solution，不是通用预训练方法，更适合作为 RL post-train recipe 的局部改进来读。
summary.technical_approach: LSPO 是包在 GRPO 或 DAPO 风格训练循环外的 sampling-time 机制。每个 RL step 先用 base model 对每个 prompt 采样 K 条回答，并检测全零 reward 的 cliff group。对这些 cliff prompt，临时挂一个小 LoRA adapter，冻结 base，只用该 prompt 的标准解做很短的监督训练。随后用 base plus adapter 重新采样 cliff prompt。若重采样出现正确回答，就把成功样本替换回原 RL batch 中对应的失败样本位置；其他样本保持不变。之后重新计算 group advantage，并对 spliced row 加 importance-sampling correction，以控制 proposal distribution 从 base 变成 base plus adapter 带来的偏移。最后只把 RL 梯度回传到 base model，adapter 丢弃。关键设计是三点：adapter 只是临时 proposal，不是交付模型；监督梯度只更新 adapter，RL 梯度只更新 base；只拼接成功重采样，避免把无信息的 off-policy 失败样本加入 batch。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 DeepMath-103K 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B，对比 DAPO 风格 baseline。报告了 5 个 paired seeds，在匹配的 1000-step 训练 horizon 下评估 MATH500、AIME24、AIME25、AIME26 的 pass@k。16 个 benchmark/pass@k 单元中，LSPO 有 15 个严格优于 baseline，1 个持平，平均提升 3.8 分。最大提升包括 AIME24 pass@4 的 +10.7 分，以及 AIME24 和 AIME26 pass@16 的 +6.7 分。pass@1 在所有 benchmark 上也有 +1.3 到 +4.7 分提升，说明收益不只是增加采样多样性。机制层面，LoRA scaffold 将约 43% 的零梯度 cliff group 转成有可用 policy-gradient 信号的 group，且不同 seed 间波动较小。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 per-step loop、two-optimizer gradient routing、splice-and-discard 设计，以及 importance correction 的写法。Section 4 看主结果表和 cliff conversion 指标即可。需要特别留意限制：方法需要题目的 ground-truth solution；adapter 重采样引入 off-policy correction，规模变大后方差和成本需要重新评估；如果任务没有可验证 reward 或标准解，机制无法直接套用。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem is the zero-reward cliff in RLVR. When all sampled responses for a prompt are wrong, GRPO’s group-normalized advantage becomes exactly zero, so the model receives no policy-gradient signal on the prompts it currently cannot solve.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is about training-signal availability, not only reward design. Verifiable rewards are not enough if the sampled group has no reward variance. LSPO introduces a practical bridge between supervised solutions and RL updates: use a temporary supervised LoRA only to improve the proposal distribution, then update the base policy through the RL loss. This is relevant to mathematical reasoning RL and hard-example training, but it depends on ground-truth solutions and should be read as a post-training recipe rather than a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSPO wraps a GRPO or DAPO-style training loop. At each RL step, the base model samples K completions per prompt and identifies cliff groups whose rewards are all zero. For those prompts, a small LoRA adapter is attached to the frozen base model and trained briefly with supervised learning on the ground-truth solutions. The base-plus-adapter model then re-samples the cliff prompts. Successful re-rollouts are spliced into the original RL batch, replacing failed rows while leaving the rest unchanged. Advantages are recomputed on the spliced batch, and an importance-sampling correction accounts for the fact that the inserted rows came from the adapter-augmented proposal. The RL update is applied only to the base model, and the adapter is discarded. The core design choices are strict gradient routing, a transient low-rank proposal, and splicing only informative successful samples.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and compare against a DAPO-style baseline. Results are reported over five paired seeds at a matched 1000-step horizon on MATH500 and AIME24/25/26 with pass@k metrics. Across 16 benchmark/pass@k cells, LSPO records 15 strict wins and one tie, with an average gain of 3.8 points. The largest gains are +10.7 points on AIME24 pass@4 and +6.7 points on AIME24 and AIME26 pass@16. Pass@1 improves on every benchmark by 1.3 to 4.7 points, so the effect is not limited to broader sampling. Direct mechanism measurements show that the scaffold converts about 43% of otherwise zero-gradient cliff groups into groups with usable policy-gradient signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 20 to 30 minutes is enough. Focus on Section 3 for the step-by-step loop, the two-optimizer separation, the splice-and-discard mechanism, and the importance correction. In Section 4, read the main result table and the cliff-conversion analysis. The main caveats are worth checking: the method requires ground-truth solutions, the adapter proposal introduces off-policy correction, and the cost and variance behavior may change at larger model or rollout scales.

recommendation.zh: 值得看算法细节和 ablation；cliff prompt 的零梯度诊断干净，LoRA scaffold 是否无偏要重点查。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and ablations; the cliff-prompt gradient diagnosis is clean, but the key question is whether the LoRA scaffold keeps the update statistically sane.

paper.title: ReCo: Reweighting GRPO Against Distributional Concentration
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard reinforcement learning method for post-training language models. Recent work shows that GRPO can reduce the base model's reasoning capacity and underperform it in Pass@k when k is large, indicating reduced coverage of reasoning paths. We find that this reduction is associated with GRPO concentrating on responses that the base model already generates with high probability. We trace this concentration to two mechanisms in the GRPO upd

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为LLM RL后训练的主流方法，会导致策略分布向基座模型高概率回复集中，降低推理路径覆盖度，表现为大k的Pass@k下降、推理能力受损。
summary.importance: 机制分析+方法创新，首次明确拆解GRPO分布集中的两个层面机制（回复级重复主导梯度、token级重要性比强化高概率token），并提出对应的重加权解决方案ReCo，对RL后训练的能力保留有重要意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCo（Reweighting against Concentration）重加权方法：1）回复级：将每个回复的梯度贡献按其在rollout组内的预期出现次数归一化，消除高概率回复重复带来的梯度主导；2）token级：用基于方差的重要性比替代原始重要性比，给低概率token更大梯度权重，缓解马太效应。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验细节，核心贡献为GRPO分布集中问题的机制分析与ReCo方法设计；具体性能提升数据未在给定摘要中体现。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO, a mainstream RL method for LLM post-training, causes policy distribution to concentrate on high-probability responses from the base model, reducing reasoning path coverage, which manifests as lower Pass@k for large k and impaired reasoning ability.
summary_en.importance: Combines mechanistic analysis and methodological innovation: first explicitly decomposes two mechanisms of GRPO distribution concentration (response-level repeated samples dominating gradients, token-level importance ratio reinforcing high-probability tokens), and proposes ReCo, a corresponding reweighting solution, critical for capability preservation during RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ReCo (Reweighting against Concentration): 1) Response-level: normalizes each response's gradient contribution by its expected occurrence count within the rollout group, eliminating gradient dominance from repeated high-probability responses; 2) Token-level: replaces the original importance ratio with a variance-based ratio that gives higher gradient weight to low-probability tokens, mitigating the Matthew effect.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not available in the truncated abstract; core contributions are the mechanistic analysis of GRPO distribution concentration and the ReCo method design; specific performance improvement data is not provided in the given abstract.

recommendation.zh: GRPO分布集中问题的机制拆解很扎实，两个重加权思路可直接复现到内部RL后训练实验中，重点看§3的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Solid mechanistic breakdown of GRPO distribution concentration; the two reweighting ideas are worth replicating in internal RL post-training experiments, focus on §3 mechanism analysis.

paper.title: NEXT: Reasoning-Driven Video Recommendation via a Vision-Language Model
paper.abstract: We present NEXT (Next-interest EXploration Transformer), a reasoning-driven video recommendation framework that reasons over the video a user has just watched, infers the viewer's next intent, and retrieves concrete follow-up videos. Explicit continuations such as episodes are linked directly; implicit cases are handled by generating intent queries and searching for matching candidates. This Item-to-Intent-to-Item formulation produces directed recommendations beyond co-engagement correlation or

summary.core_problem: 用视觉语言模型理解用户刚看过的视频，推断下一步观看意图，并检索后续视频推荐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是VLM驱动的推荐系统方法和任务定制训练流程。它把推荐从共现相关或语义相似转为“Item-to-Intent-to-Item”的显式推理链，但主要价值仍在视频推荐应用，不是通用基座预训练范式。
