Read the hallucination taxonomy and Figure 2 first to check how context-sensitive factual hallucinations are identified and how frequent they are in the analyzed samples. In the method section, focus on how self-consistency produces step rewards and how advantage redistribution preserves the total rollout advantage. In the experiments, prioritize the GRPO comparison, stability across base and instruction-tuned models, and the consistency-dynamics plots. The reported gain is modest, so the main point to evaluate is whether this step-level signal can scale to stronger models and longer reasoning traces.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 构造和 ablation；若 step consistency 真能降已知事实错误，RLVR 数据打分要改。
recommendation.en: Read the reward construction and ablations; if step consistency really reduces known-fact errors, RLVR scoring needs adjustment.

paper.title: AGG: Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient for Efficient GRPO Training of Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a powerful reinforcement learning algorithm for aligning generative models with human preferences. While successful in large language models~\cite{shao2024deepseekmathpushinglimitsmathematical}, its extension to diffusion and flow matching models introduces a severe computational bottleneck: gradients must be back-propagated through the high-capacity DiT backbone at \emph{every} timestep of the sampling trajectory, making high-resolution text-to-image

summary.core_problem: 将GRPO算法扩展到扩散/流匹配生成模型（如高分辨率文生图DiT）时，需要在采样轨迹的每个时间步对DiT backbone做全反向传播，计算成本极高，阻碍生成模型的RL对齐训练。
summary.importance: DeepSeek团队在GRPO落地扩散模型过程中提出的训练效率优化，揭示了扩散类生成模型RL训练的核心瓶颈，利用轨迹平滑性削减梯度计算冗余的思路可迁移到文本扩散/流匹配LM的RL训练，属于实用的系统/方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出JAGG（Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient）方法：基于已有推理加速工作观察到的“DiT隐藏状态与速度预测沿去噪轨迹平滑近线性”性质，无需在每个时间步执行全Transformer反向传播，通过Jacobian聚合对相邻时间步的梯度做低秩近似，大幅减少全反向传播次数，降低训练成本。
summary.experiments: 针对高分辨率文生图DiT的GRPO训练场景，摘要未披露具体模型参数量、速度提升倍数、性能保持数据，仅称可显著降低反向传播计算开销（摘要截断）。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队，该团队在GRPO算法与大规模RL对齐训练上有丰富实践经验，代表工作包括DeepSeekMath、DeepSeek-R1等。

summary_en.core_problem: Extending GRPO to diffusion/flow matching generative models (e.g., DiT for high-resolution text-to-image) requires full backpropagation through the DiT backbone at every sampling timestep, creating prohibitive computational overhead that blocks RL alignment of generative models.
summary_en.importance: A training efficiency optimization from DeepSeek’s deployment of GRPO to diffusion models, identifies the core bottleneck of RL training for diffusion-style generative models; the idea of exploiting trajectory smoothness to reduce gradient computation redundancy can transfer to RL training of discrete diffusion/flow matching language models, representing a practical systems/method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes JAGG (Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient): building on the prior observation from inference acceleration work that DiT hidden states and velocity predictions vary smoothly and nearly linearly along the denoising trajectory, JAGG avoids running full Transformer backward passes at every timestep, instead using Jacobian aggregation to compute low-rank approximations of gradients across adjacent timesteps, drastically cutting the number of full backward passes and reducing training cost.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on GRPO training for high-resolution text-to-image DiT models; the abstract does not report specific model sizes, speedup factors or performance preservation metrics, only claims significant reduction in backpropagation overhead (abstract truncated).
summary_en.authors_note: From DeepSeek, the team behind DeepSeekMath and DeepSeek-R1 with extensive practical experience in GRPO implementation and large-scale RL alignment for foundation models.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek关于扩散模型GRPO训练的效率优化，核心的轨迹近线性观察可迁移到文本扩散LM的RL训练，重点看§3的平滑性验证即可。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek's efficiency optimization for GRPO training of diffusion models; the core near-linear trajectory observation transfers to RL training of text diffusion LMs; focus on the smoothness verification in §3.

paper.title: Toward Anthropomorphic Dialogue: A Closed-Loop Framework for Human-Like Chat Generation, Evaluation, and Preference Alignment
paper.abstract: Human-like private chat requires more than fluent response generation: a system must preserve persona, relationship, memory, bounded knowledge, medium-specific timing, and a coherent multi-turn arc. We present AnthroDial, a closed-loop framework that formulates anthropomorphic dialogue as a joint problem of system architecture, executable evaluation, and diagnostic alignment. It combines (1) a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual

summary.core_problem: 解决私聊式人类化对话中，模型如何同时保持 persona、关系、记忆、知识边界、时间节奏和多轮叙事一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练系统和可执行评估框架。它把 dialogue runtime、benchmark、SFT 数据过滤和 GRPO 偏好优化放在一个闭环中，对长程对话对齐和 reward 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AnthroDial 包含三部分：角色条件化的 scheduled dialogue runtime，带 persona/scenario cards、长期记忆、虚拟时间和 single-draft 决策；一个可执行 benchmark，包含 L0 validity gate、五个 per-turn 维度和五个 dialogue-level 维度；一个后训练流程，从 scheduled-decision 数据中过滤 16,436 条样本做 SFT，并用带认知诊断和 ZPD 感知的 reward 做 GRPO。reward 用 Kalman filter 估计各行为维度能力，对能力缺口更大的维度加权，并用 rollout 分数匹配任务级 ZPD。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 16,436 条 SFT scheduled-decision examples，但未说明底座模型、参数量、训练 token、baseline 或量化提升。需要看正文中 GRPO 相对普通偏好 reward、固定 rubric reward 和仅 SFT 的消融。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注为 Cohere 相关工作；未能从给定信息确认具体知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets human-like private chat, where a model must maintain persona, relationship state, memory, bounded knowledge, timing, and coherent multi-turn arcs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training system plus executable evaluation framework. It connects a dialogue runtime, benchmark, SFT filtering, and GRPO-based preference optimization, making it relevant to long-horizon dialogue alignment and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: AnthroDial has three components: a role-conditioned scheduled dialogue runtime with persona and scenario cards, long-term memory, virtual time, and single-draft decisions; an executable benchmark with an L0 validity gate, five per-turn dimensions, and five dialogue-level dimensions; and a post-training pipeline that filters 16,436 scheduled-decision examples for SFT and applies GRPO with a cognitive-diagnostic, ZPD-aware reward. The reward uses Kalman-filtered capability estimates per behavior dimension, upweights weak dimensions, and uses rollout scores for task-level ZPD matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 16,436 SFT examples but does not specify the base model, parameter count, training budget, baselines, or quantitative gains. The key evidence should be the ablation of GRPO against fixed-rubric rewards, standard preference rewards, and SFT-only training.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked as associated with Cohere. No specific well-known author background can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 奖励按能力缺口动态加权这点可借鉴；其余偏聊天产品化，读 reward 和 eval 设计即可。
recommendation.en: The adaptive deficit-weighted reward is the part to inspect; much of the rest is chat-product scaffolding.

paper.title: OR Else: A Differentiable Trust Region for Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: PPO and the GRPO baseline studied here use clipped surrogate objectives whose favorable-direction saturation introduces an abrupt change in the scalar objective's derivative. We ask whether Output Reset (OR), a smooth one-sided saturation rule, offers a useful alternative for large language model post-training. PPO-OR and GRPO-OR replace the clipped policy term with an OR squared-margin loss in rollout-relative token log-ratio space; the advantage sign determines the update direction, and a toke

summary.core_problem: 解决 PPO/GRPO 中 clipped surrogate 在有利方向上出现硬饱和、导数突变，从而影响 LLM 后训练稳定性和优化质量的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练优化目标的小而干净的改动：不是新 RL 范式，而是对 trust-region 风格目标做可微平滑替换。对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于，它提供了一个观察 post-train 信号质量与训练稳定性接口的具体切口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Output Reset (OR) 作为单侧平滑饱和规则，用 OR squared-margin loss 替换 PPO/GRPO 中的 clipped policy term。优化变量放在 rollout-relative token log-ratio 空间，advantage 的符号决定更新方向；当 token 越过有利边界后，该 token 的直接 OR 残差归零，从而保留 trust-region 的约束意图，但避免 clip 带来的不可微折点。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct，在 Anthropic hh-rlhf 上训练，共享一个 reward model，并对每种方法跑 3 个随机种子。结果上，GAE 设定下 PPO-OR 的最终训练期 reward-model 分数平均比 PPO-clip 高 0.305，但跨种子波动更大；group-relative advantages 设定下，GRPO-OR 相比 GRPO 也有优势。规模不大，结论更像目标函数层面的弱信号，而非大规模定论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the hard saturation and derivative discontinuity in PPO/GRPO clipped surrogates, which can hurt optimization quality and stability in LLM post-training.
summary_en.importance: This is a small but clean objective-level modification rather than a new RL paradigm. Its value to pretraining researchers is mostly at the pretrain↔post-train interface: it probes how smoother optimization signals may affect downstream adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Output Reset (OR), a smooth one-sided saturation rule, and replaces the PPO/GRPO clipped policy term with an OR squared-margin loss in rollout-relative token log-ratio space. The sign of the advantage sets the update direction, and once a token crosses the favorable margin, its direct OR residual becomes zero. The goal is to preserve trust-region behavior while removing the sharp kink introduced by clipping.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on Anthropic hh-rlhf with a shared reward model and three seeds per method. Under GAE, PPO-OR improves the mean final training-time reward-model score by 0.305 over PPO-clip, though with larger seed variance; under group-relative advantages, GRPO-OR also outperforms GRPO. The setup is modest in scale, so the result should be read as an objective-level signal rather than a settled large-scale conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的 objective ablation，不足以改写 RLHF prior，但如果你在看 PPO/GRPO 的梯度形状与稳定性，读损失定义和种子方差就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean objective ablation, not enough to rewrite RLHF priors, but worth reading if you care about gradient shape and stability in PPO/GRPO; focus on the loss and seed variance.

paper.title: A Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning Framework for Fine-Tuning Discrete Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We formulate reinforcement learning (RL) in continuous time with discrete state spaces and possibly arbitrary action spaces via a stochastic control approach, where the state dynamics are modeled as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). We consider policy optimization problems and derive the corresponding policy gradient methods, leading to continuous-time variants of proximal policy optimization (PPO) and group relative policy optimization (GRPO). As a primary application, we develo

summary.core_problem: 现有离散扩散大语言模型的RL微调方法缺乏统一理论支撑，依赖启发式轨迹似然估计，且仅使用终端奖励做信用分配，中间去噪步骤的token解掩码决策无法获得有效反馈，限制了非自回归大模型的推理能力提升。
summary.importance: 将连续时间随机控制理论拓展到离散状态空间，给离散扩散模型的RL微调提供了有严格概率推导的框架，解决了此前方法似然估计粗糙、信用分配粒度粗的核心缺陷，为非自回归建模范式的后训练对齐和推理增强提供了新的技术路径。
summary.technical_approach: 构建离散状态空间下的连续时间RL（CTRL）框架，将状态动态建模为受控连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），推导对应策略梯度得到连续时间版本的PPO和GRPO算法。针对离散扩散场景，将去噪器输出的词表概率向量作为控制动作，把反向生成过程建模为受控CTMC，得到解析形式的策略对数似然，无需启发式似然估计，同时支持在去噪过程的任意时间步分配奖励，不再局限于终端反馈。
summary.experiments: 当前公开预印本版本未披露完整实证结果，理论部分已完成连续时间策略梯度推导和离散扩散场景的算法落地形式，验证了框架可兼容现有GRPO类方法的目标形式，同时原生支持中间步奖励分配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有离散扩散RL微调方法缺陷的梳理，以及CTMC建模和策略梯度推导的核心思路，无需细抠随机控制的证明细节，重点对比该框架与现有离散扩散RL方法的结构差异。后续可关注完整版本放出的实验结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL fine-tuning methods for discrete diffusion large language models (dLLMs) lack a unified theoretical foundation, rely on heuristic trajectory likelihood estimators, and only use terminal rewards for credit assignment, providing no effective feedback for intermediate unmasking decisions during the denoising process.
summary_en.importance: Extends continuous-time stochastic control theory to discrete state spaces, delivering a rigorously derived framework for RL fine-tuning of discrete diffusion models. It addresses core limitations of prior heuristic methods: coarse likelihood estimation and low-granularity credit assignment, providing a clear technical path for alignment and reasoning capability enhancement for non-autoregressive LLM paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates a continuous-time RL (CTRL) framework for discrete state spaces with arbitrary action spaces, modeling state dynamics as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC), and derives corresponding policy gradients to produce continuous-time variants of PPO and GRPO. For discrete diffusion applications, the denoiser's output vocabulary probability vector is treated as the control action, the reverse generation process is modeled as a controlled CTMC, yielding an analytical form of policy log-likelihood without heuristic estimation, and supporting reward assignment at arbitrary denoising timesteps rather than only at sequence completion.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available preprint version does not include full empirical results as of release. The theoretical section completes the derivation of continuous-time policy gradients and algorithmic implementation for discrete diffusion settings, verifying compatibility with existing GRPO-style objectives while adding native support for intermediate-step reward allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focused on the introduction's breakdown of limitations in current dLLM RL fine-tuning approaches, and the core CTMC modeling and policy gradient derivation logic. No need to work through full stochastic control proofs; focus on structural differences between this framework and prior discrete diffusion RL methods. Check for updated versions with empirical results for follow-up. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法推导即可；若做 diffusion LM 后训练，这篇给了比 terminal-only GRPO 更自然的 credit assignment 形式。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation if you work on diffusion-LM post-training; it gives a cleaner credit-assignment form than terminal-only GRPO.

paper.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
paper.abstract: A growing gap separates inference context lengths from RL post-training: inference systems are approaching million-token contexts, while post-training workloads often remain at 256K tokens or below and rely on length generalization at deployment. The gap is especially important for AI agents, whose observations, tool outputs, documents, and prior decisions accumulate over long trajectories. LongStraw is an architecture-aware execution stack for million-token RL post-training under a fixed GPU bu

summary.core_problem: LongStraw 处理的是长上下文 RL post-training 的系统瓶颈：推理侧已经接近百万 token 级上下文，但 GRPO/RL 训练仍常停留在 256K 或更短，因为训练不仅要前向读长 prompt，还要对同一历史下的多条 response 打分、回放并反传。论文关注在固定 GPU 预算下，怎样把 RL 训练上下文推到 2M token 以上，同时明确哪些路径只是前向一致，哪些路径真正构成可更新的梯度。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座研究的价值主要在训练系统和 posttrain-pretrain 接口，而不是新的 RL 目标。它把长上下文 RL 的问题拆成依赖图、状态生命周期、物理 ownership 和梯度一致性几个层面，提醒研究者不要把“能跑一次长上下文 forward”误认为“完成了长上下文 RL update”。尤其值得注意的是论文主动区分 forward fidelity、update consistency 和 gradient parity，并在限制部分承认 distributed gradient composition、prompt-state gradient、GLM 局部 attention receipt 等尚未闭合。贡献量级更接近系统可行性边界探索，而不是已验证的训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是“capture once, replay the suffix”。长 prompt 的状态先被捕获并分页保存，response 侧在需要反传时按层、按块重放，避免完整长序列激活长期驻留 GPU。论文先从 GRPO 依赖图出发，定义同一 prompt 下 G 个 response 的 policy ratio、clipped policy term 和需要反传的路径，再分析 conditional replay 中会丢失的 prompt-state 梯度项。系统设计包括状态清单与 ownership、device placement、layer staging、whole-layer checkpointing、parallel layout、adapter/optimizer scope。对 Qwen 路径，论文讨论 dense FFN 与 hybrid token mixing 下 prompt 边界如何处理，将 logical shards 映射到 physical pages，并用 four-block response replay 支撑 8 张 H20 的执行 envelope。对 GLM 路径，论文围绕 MLA/DSA、dense-to-MoE FFN、TP1/CP32/EP32、EP32 ownership、zigzag context pages 和 CPU pages 组织重放。与一般长上下文 attention 优化不同，LongStraw 的重点不是单个 kernel，而是把长 prompt 状态的生命周期、跨层重放和 optimizer update 放进同一个执行约束中。
summary.experiments: 实验更像 execution probe 和 trace audit，而不是任务性能评测。论文给出两条主要 receipt：Qwen 在 8 张 H20 下达到 4.25M context envelope；GLM 在 32 张 H20 下用 paged MLA/DSA replay 和 MoE 并行组织长上下文 GRPO 路径。GLM 部分按七个阶段推进：full-graph bottleneck localization、prefix-state scaling、single-layer differentiable replay、all-layer architecture closure、parallel ownership and CPU pages、fixed-budget optimizer-call canary、fresh grouped execution。关键洞察包括：固定预算容量主要来自状态生命周期管理，而不只是稀疏性；dense 和 MoE 的峰值内存位置不同；context parallelism 与 expert parallelism 是两类 ownership；group scaling 取决于调度，而不是简单增加 response 数。需要谨慎的是，论文承认 distributed gradient composition 不完整，历史 GLM receipt 使用 CP-local response attention，prompt-state gradient 被 detach，且 workload 仍是执行探针，没有给出长上下文 RL 后模型能力提升的数据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看第 2 节 GRPO Training Dependency Graph，重点理解为什么多 response、同 prompt 的训练图不同于推理缓存复用。再看第 4 节 LongStraw 设计，抓住 capture/replay、state ownership、whole-layer checkpointing 三个核心。若关心 dense 模型，看第 5 节 Qwen 的 8-H20 envelope；若关心 MoE 和 MLA/DSA，看第 6、7 节 GLM 路径。第 8、9 节适合快速提炼系统经验。第 12 节限制必须读，它决定了这篇工作能否被当作真实 RL 训练方案，而不是长上下文执行能力展示。

summary_en.core_problem: LongStraw targets the systems gap between million-token inference and much shorter RL post-training. In GRPO-style training, the system must score and backpropagate through multiple responses conditioned on the same long history. This creates a different workload from inference KV-cache reuse: long-lived backward states, grouped responses, and optimizer-visible gradients all have to fit under a fixed GPU budget.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in training-systems reasoning for long-context post-training, not in a new RL objective. The paper is useful because it separates three notions that are often conflated: faithful long-context forward execution, a coherent optimizer update, and full gradient parity with the reference computation. Its own limitations are important: distributed gradient composition is incomplete, prompt-state gradients are detached, and one GLM receipt uses CP-local rather than full-context response attention. The contribution is best read as a fixed-budget execution envelope and an audit framework for long-context RL, rather than a validated recipe that improves model quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central design is to capture the long prefix once and replay the response suffix. Prefix states are stored as paged, owned physical states, while response-side computation is replayed layer by layer and block by block so that the full long-sequence activation graph does not remain resident on GPU. The paper starts from the GRPO dependency graph, including policy ratios and clipped policy terms over G responses, then identifies where conditional replay can miss a gradient term. LongStraw combines state inventory, explicit ownership, device placement, layer staging, whole-layer checkpointing, adapter-scoped optimization, and architecture-specific parallel layouts. For Qwen, it handles dense hybrid layers, logical-to-physical page mapping, global full-attention forward composition, and four-block response replay under an eight-H20 envelope. For GLM, it builds around MLA/DSA, dense-to-MoE feed-forward paths, TP1/CP32/EP32 ownership, zigzag context pages, CPU page residency, and replayed whole-layer backward records.
summary_en.experiments: The evidence is mainly execution receipts, traces, memory accounting, and staged closure of the training path. The Qwen path reports a 4.25M-token context envelope within eight H20 GPUs. The GLM path targets a 32-H20 MoE setup with paged MLA/DSA replay and expert parallel ownership. The GLM validation is organized as seven stages, from bottleneck localization and prefix-state scaling to single-layer differentiable replay, all-layer closure, CPU-page ownership, an optimizer-call canary, and fresh grouped execution. The strongest systems lessons are that capacity under a fixed budget comes from managing tensor lifetime, dense and MoE models move the memory peak to different places, context parallelism and expert parallelism solve different ownership problems, and group scaling is a scheduling property. The paper does not provide downstream RL quality gains or a closed proof of gradient parity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. Read Section 2 first to understand the GRPO dependency graph and why long-context RL is not just long-context inference with gradients. Section 4 contains the core execution idea: capture, replay, ownership, placement, and whole-layer checkpointing. Section 5 is the relevant path for dense Qwen-like models; Sections 6 and 7 are the relevant path for GLM-like MLA/DSA plus MoE models. Sections 8 and 9 are useful for trace evidence and practical systems lessons. Section 12 should not be skipped, because it states which parts of the claimed training path are not yet fully gradient-consistent.

recommendation.zh: 只看执行图和 replay 代价分析；它不改 RL 目标，但会改变长上下文 RL 该不该等硬件的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the execution graph and replay-cost analysis; it does not change the RL objective, but it changes the prior that million-token RL must wait for larger hardware.

paper.title: Where Should RL Post-Training Compute Go? Model Size, Search, Learning, and Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training is increasingly used to adapt foundation models for reasoning, planning, and feedback-driven robot-learning pipelines, but constrained post-training resources are often summarized by a single total FLOP budget. We study the fixed-budget decision problem behind this practice: under the same post-training budget, should one use a larger policy, train a smaller policy longer, generate more rollout search, or spend compute on stronger reward feedback? We int

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 RL post-training 的固定算力分配问题：在同样的后训练 FLOPs 下，算力应该投给更大的 policy、更多 rollout/search、更长的 policy update，还是更强但更贵的 reward/feedback model。核心点是，RL 后训练不能像预训练那样只用“总算力”描述；同样的 FLOPs 可能对应完全不同的机制路径。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把 post-train compute 从一个粗粒度标量拆成可诊断的资源分配问题。这对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口很有用：预训练模型大小决定每 token 推理和更新成本，进而改变 RL 阶段可购买的 rollout 数、update 数和 feedback 质量。贡献量级不是提出一个单一训练配方，而是提供一套算力会计和条件 frontier 的分析框架。它适合用来设计 reasoning / verifier / reward model 后训练实验，避免把不同 reward 系统或不同模型尺寸的结果放在“同 FLOPs”标签下直接比较。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 GRPO 后训练总算力分解为三项：C_search、C_learning、C_reward。C_search 对应自回归 rollout 生成；C_learning 对应 policy optimization，包括 LoRA adapter 的有效更新成本和 frozen backbone 的 forward/activation 成本；C_reward 对应 rule-based reward、verifier 或 process reward model 的推理成本。主要控制变量是 update fraction ρ，即 C_learning / C_total。小 ρ 表示算力更多用于 rollout/search 或 reward evaluation；大 ρ 表示更多算力用于 policy update。这个分解的关键区别在于，它不把 reward model 推理成本当作免费项。rule-based reward 的额外成本很低，而 PRM 或 learned verifier 会占用明显预算；如果忽略这部分，PRM 方案会看起来像是在同样预算下拥有更多有效训练资源。实验设置使用 LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5 policy，在数学推理任务上做 GRPO，比较不同模型尺寸、不同 ρ、不同 reward 系统和不同 evaluation target。RACE 是一个 pilot-grid protocol，用较小代价先扫出可能的 allocation regime，再决定昂贵验证实验投在哪里。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 LoRA 版 Qwen2.5 policy、GRPO、数学推理任务展开。可确认的结果有四类。第一，同样后训练 FLOPs 下，模型尺寸和训练分配强耦合：更大的 policy 每 token 成本更高，同预算下可生成的 rollout 和可执行的 update 更少，因此“大模型 + 少训练”不总是优于“小模型 + 更充分训练”。第二，最佳 observed ρ 随模型尺寸变化，没有一个固定 update/search 比例适用于所有 policy。第三，reward 系统会改变 allocation frontier：rule-based reward 几乎把预算留给 rollout 和 update，learned feedback 则把一部分预算转移到 reward inference。第四，评价目标会选择不同的最优点：native training reward、pass@1 symbolic accuracy、common-judge process score 可能偏好不同 allocation。正文片段没有给出可复核的具体表格数值、模型参数规模列表或绝对提升幅度，因此不应补造精确数字。更稳妥的读法是把实验看作条件 frontier 证据，而不是一个追求单点分数提升的 benchmark 结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Method: Conditional Compute Allocation 和 Appendix B。前者定义三类 FLOPs 和 ρ，是整项工作的核心；后者涉及 LoRA update 的有效成本估计，决定会计框架是否可信。实验部分应重点看三组图表：同 FLOPs 下不同模型尺寸的 frontier、不同 reward system 的预算拆分、native reward/pass@1/process score 三种目标选择的最优 ρ 是否一致。RACE 部分值得细看，因为它更接近实际工程流程：先用 pilot grid 找 allocation regime，再扩大预算验证。阅读时不要只看最终 accuracy，应同时看 token 数、rollout 数、update 步数、reward model 调用成本；这些量才解释了为什么同样总 FLOPs 会得到不同结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies fixed-budget allocation in RL post-training. Given the same post-training FLOP budget, it asks whether compute should be spent on a larger policy, more rollout search, more policy updates, or stronger but more expensive reward feedback. The central issue is that total FLOPs alone under-specify an RL run: two runs with the same budget can differ mechanistically in how much exploration, learning, and reward evaluation they buy.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model training is a clean accounting lens for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Model size fixes the per-token cost of rollout and update, so it directly changes the amount of RL data, optimization, and feedback that can fit under a fixed budget. The contribution is not a universal recipe for GRPO. It is a framework for comparing post-training runs without hiding reward-model inference or rollout cost inside a single scalar. This is especially relevant for reasoning models, verifiers, process reward models, and robot-learning pipelines that reuse foundation-model components.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes total GRPO post-training compute into C_search, C_learning, and C_reward. C_search covers autoregressive rollout generation. C_learning covers policy optimization, including an effective update-cost model for LoRA that accounts for trainable adapters as well as the frozen backbone forward and activation costs. C_reward covers reward or verifier inference, which is negligible for rule-based rewards but can be substantial for learned feedback such as process reward models. The main allocation variable is the update fraction ρ = C_learning / C_total. Low ρ corresponds to search- or feedback-heavy runs; high ρ corresponds to update-heavy runs. This differs from common reporting practice because reward-model inference is not treated as free. A PRM-based run and a rule-based run can have the same total FLOPs while buying different amounts of exploration and learning. The empirical setting uses LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5 policies trained with GRPO on mathematical reasoning tasks, and compares model sizes, allocation ratios, reward systems, and evaluation targets. RACE is introduced as a pilot-grid protocol for locating useful allocation regimes before spending budget on larger validation runs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use GRPO post-training of LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5 policies on math reasoning tasks. Four findings are central. First, model size and allocation are coupled under a fixed budget: larger policies cost more per token, so the same budget yields fewer rollouts and fewer updates. As a result, a larger policy is not automatically the best post-training choice. Second, the best observed update fraction changes with model size; no single search-versus-learning split dominates. Third, reward design changes the compute frontier. Rule-based rewards leave most non-update compute for policy rollout, while learned feedback spends part of the budget on reward-model inference. Fourth, evaluation target matters. Native training reward, pass@1 symbolic accuracy, and common-judge process scores can select different allocations. The available text does not expose reproducible numerical tables, exact model-size lists, or absolute gain values, so the safest reading is that the empirical evidence supports conditional allocation frontiers rather than a single winning operating point.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the compute-accounting method and the LoRA cost appendix carefully. They define what is actually being compared. In the experiments, focus on plots that place model size, update fraction, rollout/search cost, and reward-evaluation cost on the same budget axis. The most useful figures are likely the same-FLOP model-size comparisons, reward-system comparisons, and target-dependent frontier plots. RACE is worth a separate pass because it translates the analysis into a practical workflow: run a pilot grid, identify the allocation regime, then scale only the promising configurations. Expect a careful read to take about one hour if the goal is to reuse the accounting framework in new RL post-training experiments.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看 RL 后训练 ablation 的方式：以后别再接受“同 FLOP 公平比较”这种粗口径，建议直接复现它的预算拆账框架做内部实验。
recommendation.en: This should change how you read RL post-training ablations: stop accepting vague 'same-FLOP' comparisons and adopt the paper’s compute accounting in your own internal studies.

paper.title: CoRe: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Image Comparative Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Cross-image comparative reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), especially when correct prediction requires fine-grained attribute grounding and globally consistent reasoning. We present CoRe, a unified framework for this problem. CoRe includes: (i) CoRe-20K, a large-scale triplet-based training set automatically constructed from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert collaborative pipeline, covering counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations; (ii) TriSR

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在多图比较推理中难以同时完成细粒度属性定位、跨图判断和全局一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态推理数据、训练框架和评测资产的组合。它把 cross-image comparative reasoning 单独拎出来，覆盖计数、深度、距离、空间关系等需要比较而非单图识别的能力，对 VLM 后训练和评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoRe 框架，包括从结构化视觉元数据自动构造的 CoRe-20K 三元组训练集，以及 TriSR 结构化奖励。TriSR 在 GRPO 优化中同时约束属性 grounding、判断对齐和 triplet consistency，避免只用最终答案奖励导致模型学到表面比较模式。
summary.experiments: 在 CoRe-Bench 上评测多图细粒度比较推理能力。摘要报告 CoRe 相比最强 baseline 的 partial accuracy 提升 28.2 个百分点，同时在常规多模态 benchmark 上保持竞争力。未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体 baseline 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets VLM failures in cross-image comparative reasoning, where models must ground fine-grained attributes and maintain consistent judgments across multiple images.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a combined data, reward, and benchmark package for multi-image VLM reasoning. The task isolates comparative capabilities such as counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations, which are not well captured by standard single-image VQA setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRe builds a triplet-based training set, CoRe-20K, from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert construction pipeline. It also introduces TriSR, a structured reward scheme for GRPO that supervises attribute grounding, judgment alignment, and triplet-level consistency instead of relying only on final-answer reward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are centered on CoRe-Bench. The abstract reports a 28.2-point gain in partial accuracy over the strongest baseline while remaining competitive on standard multimodal benchmarks. Model scale, training size beyond CoRe-20K, and detailed baselines are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和 TriSR 奖励设计；它更像 VLM 后训练 recipe，不会改变基座预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and TriSR reward design; this is more a VLM post-training recipe than a base-pretraining signal.

paper.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Learning broad world knowledge directly from raw visual data is a fundamental capability of intelligence. We introduce UniVR, the first investigation into simultaneously learning complex reasoning, fine-grained physical dynamics, and long-term planning from pure visual demonstrations. At its core, UniVR features VR-GRPO, a reinforcement learning paradigm with complementary global and step-level rewards. This approach enforces logical coherence and physical consistency throughout the reasoning pr

summary.core_problem: 探索模型能否仅从纯视觉 demonstrations 中学习复杂推理、物理动态和长程规划，而不依赖图文配对数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉推理训练范式和评测套件。它关心的是视觉空间中的 reasoning，而不是传统图像分类或检测；对 native multimodal pretraining 和 RL 后训练接口有弱相关启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniVR 及 VR-GRPO。VR-GRPO 使用全局奖励和 step-level 奖励的互补设计，分别约束最终逻辑一致性和中间过程的物理一致性，避免为每个任务手写规则或依赖 image-text pairs。论文还构建 VR-X，汇集 16 个来源，覆盖长程操作、空间谜题和物理推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 UniVR 在 VR-X 上最高提升 25%，并且纯视觉推理能力还能迁移提升若干多模态任务表现。未提供模型参数量、视觉数据规模、baseline 名称和各子任务细分结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether complex reasoning, physical dynamics, and long-horizon planning can be learned directly from pure visual demonstrations without image-text supervision.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a visual reasoning training paradigm plus a benchmark suite. It is relevant to native multimodal training because it treats visual sequences as a reasoning substrate rather than as inputs to be captioned first.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVR introduces VR-GRPO, which combines global rewards with step-level rewards to enforce both final logical coherence and intermediate physical consistency. It avoids task-specific heuristics and image-text pairs. The paper also builds VR-X from 16 sources spanning long-horizon manipulation, spatial puzzles, and physical reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to a 25% improvement on VR-X and claims transfer benefits to several multimodal tasks. It does not specify model size, amount of visual demonstration data, baseline list, or detailed per-domain gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VR-GRPO 奖励分解和 VR-X 任务组成；纯视觉 reasoning 的方向有意思，但摘要信息不足以信服。
recommendation.en: Read only the VR-GRPO reward decomposition and VR-X task mix; pure-visual reasoning is interesting, but the abstract is not enough to trust the claim.

paper.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅使用稀疏的最终答案正确性作为奖励信号，存在两个阶段的系统性缺陷：1）成功前：困难问题上模型很少答对，推理路径上的前置进展无法获得奖励，训练陷入停滞；2）成功后：最终正确的轨迹中，冗余、局部有缺陷的推理路径和高质量推理路径获得相同奖励，无法优化推理过程的质量和效率。现有方法通常分别处理这两个问题，没有从「稀疏终端奖励锚点」的统一视角出发设计解决方案。
summary.importance: 该工作首次将RLVR中「成功前探索不足」和「成功后过程低效」两个看似独立的问题，统一归因于稀疏终端奖励锚点的固有缺陷。提出的两阶段奖励稠密化方案完全兼容GRPO等现有策略更新算法，不需要修改RL训练的核心更新逻辑，对推理模型的RL训练流程有直接的工程参考价值；同时「前缀分解可验证奖励」的思路也为预训练阶段的过程监督信号设计提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach:
提出SCOPE-RL两阶段框架，核心设计原则是不修改GRPO的策略更新逻辑，仅在成功边界的两侧稠密化奖励信号：
1）第一阶段自适应脚手架RL（ASR）：通过在线策略路由自动识别成功率低的问题（组内奖励方差为0且全错的问题），将问题拆分为答案隐藏的子问题链，为每个子问题的正确解答提供前缀一致的可验证奖励——子问题答案不会泄露最终答案，且模型必须按顺序完成前缀子问题才能获得后续奖励，既为困难问题提供了部分进展的奖励信号，又避免了答案泄露。
2）第二阶段质量感知过程RL（QPR）：针对已经能答对的问题，通过正确性门控确保只有最终答案正确的轨迹才能获得过程奖励，过程奖励偏好有用步骤密度高、低价值步骤少、错误定位清晰的推理路径，惩罚冗余和局部有缺陷的推理。过程奖励设置了上限，权重不会超过正确性奖励，避免模型为了简洁性牺牲答案正确性。
两个阶段天然顺序衔接：ASR先提升困难问题的答对率，增加验证轨迹的供给，QPR再优化这些正确轨迹的过程质量。
此外还提出了步骤质量评估协议，在规则验证答案正确性的基础上，增加事后LLM评判的有用步骤密度、低价值步骤比例、错误定位、token效率等诊断指标，用于评估推理过程质量。
summary.experiments:
基础设置：以Qwen3-8B-Instruct为基座模型，在DAPO-Math和Big-Math两个训练语料上开展实验，基线算法为GRPO。
- 准确率提升：DAPO-Math上平均准确率从55.80%提升至66.35%，Big-Math上从53.58%提升至64.79%。
- 推理效率提升：在准确率提升的同时，推理token消耗分别减少16.2%（DAPO-Math）和27.1%（Big-Math）。
- 兼容性验证：替换为GSPO策略更新后端时仍有效（准确率从61.60%提升至66.93%）；在更小的Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct上也获得一致收益（准确率从26.06%提升至32.06%），说明奖励稠密化与策略更新层面的RLVR改进是互补关系。
- 消融实验：ASR和QPR各自独立贡献收益，ASR主要提升困难问题的准确率，QPR主要提升推理效率和有用步骤密度。
summary.reading_guide: 1）精读第1章的稀疏锚点视角，理解两个看似不相关的RLVR失败模式如何统一到同一个根源；2）精读第3章的ASR和QPR设计细节，重点关注：ASR如何构造答案隐藏的子问题链、如何保证前缀一致性、如何实现在线策略路由；QPR的正确性门控设计、过程奖励的组成和权重设置、如何避免过程奖励压过正确性奖励；3）第4章的消融实验和步骤质量评估协议值得细看，尤其是推理过程质量的量化指标设计；4）附录中的子问题构造示例和奖励设计细节是工程落地的关键参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies solely on sparse final-answer correctness as reward signal, leading to two phase-specific systematic failures: (1) Before success: On hard problems where models rarely produce correct answers, prerequisite progress along the reasoning path receives no reward, causing training stalls. (2) After success: Among trajectories with correct final answers, redundant or locally flawed reasoning paths receive the same reward as high-quality ones, leaving process quality and efficiency unoptimized. Existing work addresses these two issues separately, lacking a unified framing around the sparse terminal reward anchor.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to unify two seemingly independent RLVR failures — insufficient exploration before success and inefficient process after success — as inherent consequences of the same sparse terminal reward anchor. Its two-stage reward densification scheme is fully compatible with existing policy update algorithms like GRPO, requiring no changes to core RL update logic, and provides direct engineering reference for RL training of reasoning models. The prefix-decomposed verifiable reward design also offers insights for process supervision signal design in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCOPE-RL is a two-stage framework built on a single design principle: leave the GRPO policy update unchanged, and only densify the reward signal on either side of the success boundary.
1) Stage 1: Adaptive Scaffolded RL (ASR). Hard problems with low success rates are identified via on-policy routing (prompts with zero within-group reward variance where all rollouts are wrong). The problem is decomposed into an answer-hidden sub-question chain, and prefix-consistent verifiable rewards are assigned to each correctly solved sub-question. Sub-question answers do not leak the final answer, and the model must complete prefix sub-questions sequentially to earn subsequent rewards, providing partial progress signal for hard problems without answer leakage.
2) Stage 2: Quality-Aware Process RL (QPR). For problems where the model already produces correct answers, a correctness gate ensures only trajectories with correct final answers receive process-shape rewards. These rewards prefer reasoning paths with higher useful-step density, fewer low-value steps, and clearer error localization, penalizing redundancy and local flaws. Process rewards are bounded to never outweigh correctness rewards, preventing the model from optimizing for brevity at the cost of answer accuracy.
The two stages are naturally sequential: ASR first raises the supply of verified correct trajectories on hard problems, then QPR refines the process quality of those correct trajectories.
A Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol is also introduced, complementing rule-based answer verification with post-hoc LLM-judged diagnostics: useful-step density, low-value step ratio, error localization, and token efficiency.
summary_en.experiments:
Base setup: Qwen3-8B-Instruct as the base model, trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math corpora, with GRPO as the baseline RL algorithm.
- Accuracy gains: Average accuracy rises from 55.80% to 66.35% on DAPO-Math, and from 53.58% to 64.79% on Big-Math.
- Efficiency gains: Token reduction reaches 16.2% on DAPO-Math and 27.1% on Big-Math, alongside accuracy improvements.
- Compatibility: Gains hold under GSPO policy update backend (accuracy rises from 61.60% to 66.93%) and on smaller Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct (accuracy rises from 26.06% to 32.06%), confirming reward densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances.
- Ablation: Both ASR and QPR contribute independently. ASR primarily improves accuracy on hard problems, while QPR primarily improves reasoning efficiency and useful-step density.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1) Read Section 1 closely for the sparse-anchor framing, which unifies two seemingly unrelated RLVR failure modes. 2) Dive into Section 3 for ASR and QPR design details: focus on how ASR constructs answer-hidden sub-question chains, ensures prefix consistency, and implements on-policy routing; for QPR, focus on the correctness gate design, process reward composition and weighting, and the mechanism to prevent process rewards from overriding correctness. 3) Section 4 ablation studies and the Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol are worth careful reading, especially the metric design for quantifying reasoning process quality. 4) Appendix examples of sub-question construction and reward design details are critical reference for engineering implementation.

recommendation.zh: 应读奖励分解和 step-quality protocol；它改变的 prior 是 RLVR 只靠最终答案锚点也能把过程学干净。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition and step-quality protocol; it challenges the prior that final-answer RLVR alone can cleanly learn reasoning process quality.

paper.title: When the Reward Suite Is Leaky: A Preregistered Causal Contrast of Natural Verifier False Positives in RLVR
paper.abstract: The test suites used as RLVR rewards for code have natural false positives: per-task, persistent, asymmetric errors that accept the same wrong programs every time they appear, unlike the symmetric or resampled noise assumed by existing noise-robustness analyses. We run a preregistered two-arm causal contrast on a deployed suite: GRPO on identical MBPP tasks, seeds, and compute, rewarded by the original MBPP tests (leaky) versus the MBPP+ extra tests (hardened). Two further families replicate the

summary.core_problem: 研究代码 RLVR 中测试套件作为 reward 时的自然假阳性问题：错误程序被固定测试持续接受，导致奖励泄漏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练奖励信号质量分析和因果实验。它直接关系到 RLVR 能否真实提升能力，还是只是在固定 verifier 的漏洞上优化；对预训练研究员理解 pretrain 与 posttrain 闭环中的 reward hacking 很有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做了 preregistered two-arm causal contrast：在相同 MBPP 任务、随机种子和计算预算下，用 GRPO 分别对原始 MBPP tests 的 leaky reward 和 MBPP+ extra tests 的 hardened reward 训练。另有两个实验族在数据产生前冻结 preregistration 后复现设计。论文还提出廉价静态 leakiness audit，用训练前信号预测哪些任务更容易产生 rewarded false positives，并用人工签名规则审计 rewarded FP。
summary.experiments: 核心实验是在 MBPP 代码任务上比较原始测试和强化测试作为 RLVR reward 的效果。平均 held-out 效应在预注册 1.5pt non-inferiority margin 内，gap 为 0.20pt，单侧 95% 上界为 0.75pt。训练前静态 leakiness audit 与 rewarded FP mass 的 Spearman 相关为 0.80；注册的 train-side test 显示 leak-stratum 的 FP share 比 clean tasks 高 43.8pt。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Jiaotong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies natural false positives in code RLVR rewards, where fixed test suites repeatedly accept the same wrong programs and create persistent reward leakage.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-signal quality study for post-training. It matters because RLVR improvements can come either from genuine capability gains or from exploiting stable verifier holes; the distinction is directly relevant to reward hacking and the pretrain-posttrain feedback loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author runs a preregistered two-arm causal contrast: GRPO is trained on identical MBPP tasks, seeds, and compute, with rewards from either the original leaky MBPP tests or hardened MBPP+ extra tests. Two additional experiment families replicate the design under preregistration frozen before their data existed. The paper also introduces a cheap static leakiness audit computed before training and audits rewarded false positives under signed human-adjudicated rules.
summary_en.experiments: On MBPP code tasks, the average held-out effect is bounded and non-inferior under a preregistered 1.5-point margin, with a 0.20-point gap and a one-sided 95% upper bound of 0.75 points. Rewarded false-positive mass correlates strongly with the pretraining static leakiness audit, with Spearman 0.80. The registered train-side test places the leak-stratum false-positive share 43.8 points above clean tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Beijing Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 应把静态 leakiness audit 加进 RLVR pipeline；平均收益不塌不代表 reward 干净，分层 FP 才是危险信号。
recommendation.en: Add static leakiness audits to RLVR pipelines; stable average gains do not mean clean rewards, and stratified false positives are the warning signal.

paper.title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. However, RL algorithms with PPO-Clip are inherently limited by exploration collapse. Subsequent works remain primarily heuristic and fail to identify the essential cause of PPO-Clip's failure. This work reveals the fundamental flaw of PPO-Clip: it implicitly measures policy discrepancy using Euclidean metric, which is theoretically inconsistent with the intrinsic geometry on the policy Riemanni

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LLM reasoning RL 中 PPO-Clip / GRPO 的 exploration collapse 问题。作者认为根因不是 clip range 取值不合适，而是固定 importance-ratio clipping 用了错误的几何尺度：它把 ratio 的欧氏距离当成策略变化大小，但策略分布的自然局部几何由 KL / Fisher metric 决定。结果是低概率动作更新太小，高概率动作更新太猛，训练很快收缩到少数高概率轨迹，长程推理所需的探索被压掉。
summary.importance: 这是一篇值得精读的 RL-for-LLM 论文。它切入的是 post-train 训练目标和优化器接口，但会反过来影响预训练研究者对模型分布、探索、熵和 reasoning 能力释放的理解。贡献类型主要是算法和训练动态分析：不是再调一个 PPO clip 超参，而是把 clip 边界改成依赖局部策略概率的几何量。若实验稳定复现，它对 GRPO 系列 recipe、RL 数据利用效率、长程推理训练的 entropy 管理都有实际影响。文中给出的量级是，在 AIME24 上相对 GRPO 最高有 60% relative improvement。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先从 TRPO 的 KL trust region 出发，指出 PPO-Clip 是对 KL 约束的启发式一阶近似。问题在于 PPO 对 importance ratio r=πθ(a|s)/πold(a|s) 使用固定 clipping，例如 1±ε，等价于认为相同的 ratio 偏移就是相同的策略变化。但对离散策略，KL 的二阶近似对应 Fisher/Riemannian metric：局部距离大致与 Δp²/p 有关。若写成 ratio 偏移，单个动作的 KL 贡献近似为 p_old(r−1)²/2。于是同样的 ε 对低概率 token 只允许很小的绝对概率变化，也几乎不消耗 KL budget；对高概率 token 则允许较大的 KL 变化。RIPO 的核心做法是让 clipping boundary 随局部概率自适应：低概率动作获得更宽的 ratio 更新范围，高概率动作受到更紧约束，从而让不同动作在 Riemannian 几何下的更新尺度更接近等距。作者还把这种等距更新和统计同方差联系起来，认为它能改善 bias–variance trade-off，使 advantage 驱动的更新不再被高概率 token 主导。与 DAPO 这类增大上界或非对称 clip 的方法相比，RIPO 的区别是边界按每个状态-动作的局部几何调整，而不是给所有 token 使用同一套手工范围。
summary.experiments: 可核验的关键信息包括：实验覆盖多个 LLM 和 competition-level reasoning benchmarks；RIPO 相比现有 RL 算法有明显提升；在 AIME24 上相对 GRPO 最高报告 60% improvement。论文还声称在长程任务上优势更明显，这与方法动机一致，因为长程推理更依赖低概率但有用的探索分支。由于给出的正文片段没有完整实验表、模型参数、训练 token 数、rollout 数、batch size、KL 系数、clip 公式细节和 ablation 表，具体绝对分数与不同模型规模下的稳定性需要回到实验章节核对。精读时应特别检查三类消融：第一，动态 clip 是否优于简单调大 ε 或 DAPO 式 asymmetric clip；第二，低概率 token 的更新幅度、熵、unique solution 数是否确实提升；第三，KL、gradient norm、reward 曲线是否更稳定，而不是只在某个 benchmark 上更激进。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，约 60–90 分钟。先读 preliminary 中 TRPO、PPO-Clip、GRPO 的公式，确认作者如何把 LLM token-level policy update 映射到 trust-region 问题。然后重点看理论部分中从 KL 二阶近似到 Riemannian clipping boundary 的推导；核心创新应在动态边界如何定义、是否需要归一化或截断、怎样处理极低概率 token。实验部分优先看 AIME24、MATH 类 benchmark 的主表，再看训练曲线和 entropy / KL / clip fraction 分析。消融实验比主结果更重要：如果 RIPO 只是等价于更大的有效 clip range，它的价值有限；如果它在相同 KL budget 下提升低概率正确轨迹的发现率，才说明几何解释有训练意义。实现层面还应检查额外开销、与 GRPO group-normalized advantage 的耦合、以及在不同 base model 和不同 reward sparsity 下是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses exploration collapse in PPO-Clip and GRPO-style RL for LLM reasoning. Its central claim is that fixed importance-ratio clipping uses the wrong notion of distance. It treats equal deviations in the ratio as equal policy changes, while the local geometry of a policy distribution is induced by KL divergence and the Fisher metric. This mismatch under-updates rare actions and over-updates frequent actions, causing the policy to concentrate too early on a narrow set of trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is a must-read for researchers working on the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The paper is about RL optimization rather than base pretraining, but it speaks directly to how pretrained distributions are modified during reasoning RL. If the results hold up, the implication is practical: exploration should be controlled in the geometry of the policy distribution, not by a single global clip range. This can affect GRPO recipes, entropy management, RL data efficiency, and long-horizon reasoning training. The reported scale of improvement is substantial: up to 60% relative improvement over GRPO on AIME24.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from TRPO, where policy improvement is constrained by a KL trust region, and views PPO-Clip as a cheap first-order approximation to that idea. The flaw is that PPO clips the importance ratio r=πθ(a|s)/πold(a|s) with a fixed interval such as 1±ε. For a categorical policy, the local KL expansion is approximately 0.5·Σ Δp(a)^2/p(a). Written in terms of ratio changes, the KL contribution of one action is roughly 0.5·p_old(a|s)·(r−1)^2. A fixed ratio bound therefore gives low-probability actions very small absolute movement and high-probability actions disproportionately large movement. Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization changes the clip boundary as a function of the local old-policy probability. Rare actions get a wider ratio range; frequent actions get a tighter one. The intended effect is an approximately isometric update under the policy manifold geometry. The paper further argues that this geometry-aware clipping induces a more homoscedastic update signal and improves the bias-variance trade-off. Compared with heuristics such as increasing the upper clip bound or using asymmetric clipping, the key difference is per-state-action adaptation based on local policy geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports experiments across multiple LLMs and competition-level reasoning benchmarks. RIPO is said to outperform existing RL algorithms, with up to 60% relative improvement over GRPO on AIME24. The claimed advantage is especially relevant for long-horizon reasoning, where successful trajectories may require exploring low-probability branches. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, model sizes, rollout budgets, training data scale, KL coefficients, exact clipping formula, or ablation numbers. Those details need to be checked in the experimental section. The most important empirical checks are whether RIPO beats simply enlarging the clip range, whether rare-token updates and entropy are actually preserved, and whether reward, KL, gradient norm, and clip fraction curves are more stable under the same compute and KL budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully in about 60–90 minutes. Start with the equations for TRPO, PPO-Clip, and GRPO to verify how the authors formulate token-level LLM RL as a trust-region problem. Then focus on the derivation from the KL quadratic approximation to the adaptive Riemannian clipping boundary. The most important implementation details are how the boundary depends on old-policy probability, whether it is normalized or capped, and how extremely low-probability tokens are handled. In the experiments, prioritize the AIME24 and math benchmark tables, then inspect entropy, KL, clip fraction, and reward curves. The ablations are decisive: RIPO is much more convincing if it improves exploration at the same KL budget, rather than acting as a larger effective clip range.

recommendation.zh: 应在内部 PPO/GRPO ablation 里复现低概率 token 更新分析；若成立，会改变 RL 裁剪只靠调 ε 的习惯。
recommendation.en: Reproduce the low-probability-token update analysis in internal PPO/GRPO ablations; if it holds, it changes the habit of treating clipping as just epsilon tuning.

paper.title: SVR-R1: Bootstrapping Multi-modal Reasoning with Self-verification in Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce Self-Verified Reasoner (SVR-R1), a multi-turn RL framework that turns a model's own verification into a learning signal for multimodal reasoning. For each query, the model proposes an answer using the same weights, and issues a binary self-verdict (Yes/No). A 'No' triggers a second-chance rethink; a 'Yes,' or a turn cap, finalizes the output for computing the outcome-based reward. SVR-R1 is implemented with GRPO and an asynchronous multi-turn rollout framework and needs no external

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决多模态 RL 训练中的一个训练信号问题：在没有外部 verifier、critic 或额外监督的情况下，如何利用模型已有的自我验证能力，让 VLM 在 rollout 阶段先判断自己的答案是否可信，再决定是否重新作答。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接价值不在视觉问答分数本身，而在 RL 训练接口。SVR-R1 把“生成—验证—再生成”放进 RL rollout，而不是只在推理时 prompt 模型反思，也不是用自生成高置信样本做离线 SFT。这说明 rollout 结构可以成为一种训练信号设计：即使最终 reward 仍是 outcome-based，模型在拿到 reward 前经历的交互路径会改变策略学习。这个思路对 RL pretrain、推理型 mid-training、多模态可验证任务训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SVR-R1 使用同一个 VLM 权重同时扮演 generator 和 verifier，只通过不同 prompt 区分角色。给定图像和问题后，模型先生成包含推理过程和答案的响应；随后同一模型看到问题和初始答案，输出二元自检结果 Yes 或 No。如果输出 No，系统把会话历史保留，并要求模型重新思考和重新作答；如果输出 Yes，或者达到最大验证轮数，就把最终答案送入 reward 计算。训练使用 GRPO，reward 是基于最终答案匹配的 outcome reward，不引入外部监督模型。工程上采用异步多模态多轮 rollout 框架来协调生成、验证和重新生成。这与普通 GRPO 的区别在于，普通 GRPO 对单次采样答案直接打分；SVR-R1 让同一策略在 reward 前执行自检和修正，训练的是一个多轮决策过程。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多模态表格和图表推理 benchmark，以及通用推理任务。SVR-R1 相比标准 GRPO baseline 有明显准确率提升。一个有信息量的训练动态是：训练早期模型更频繁触发 verification 和 rethink；随着训练推进，verification 轮数下降，模型更常在第一轮就给出 Yes，但测试准确率仍提高。这说明模型并不是长期依赖多轮自检来换取推理时间，而是在训练中把 verifier 提供的选择压力内化到第一轮生成策略中。提供内容中没有完整列出各 benchmark 的精确分数、模型尺寸和训练步数；这些数字需要结合实验表、训练曲线和消融部分读取。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分的 rollout protocol，特别是 generator/verifier 共享权重、Yes/No 触发规则、最大轮数和 GRPO reward 计算的位置。然后看训练动态图，重点观察 verification turns 如何随训练变化，以及准确率是否同步上升。消融部分如果包含去掉 self-verification、固定多轮反思、外部 verifier 或不同轮数上限的对比，应优先阅读，因为这些实验决定 SVR-R1 的收益来自自检机制，还是来自额外生成长度和更多采样机会。对基座训练更有启发的是 rollout 设计，而不是某个多模态 benchmark 的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training-signal problem in multimodal RL: how to use a VLM’s own verification ability during rollout, without an external verifier, auxiliary critic, or additional supervision. The model first answers, then judges whether its own answer is correct, and only rethinks when it predicts failure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant as an RL training interface than as a vision-language benchmark result. SVR-R1 moves generation, verification, and regeneration into the rollout process. It is different from inference-time self-reflection prompts, and also different from offline SFT on high-confidence self-generated traces. The final reward can remain outcome-based, but the path taken before reward assignment changes the learning problem. This is a useful design pattern for RL pretraining, reasoning-oriented mid-training, and multimodal tasks with verifiable answers.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVR-R1 uses the same VLM weights for both the generator and the verifier, with role separation handled by prompts. Given an image and a question, the model generates a rationale and an answer. The same model then receives the question and its tentative answer and emits a binary verdict, Yes or No. A No triggers another generation round with the conversation history preserved. A Yes, or hitting the maximum number of verification rounds, finalizes the answer for reward computation. Training uses GRPO with outcome-based answer matching, and an asynchronous multimodal multi-turn rollout framework handles generation, verification, and regeneration. Compared with standard GRPO, which scores a single sampled response directly, SVR-R1 trains the policy over a multi-turn decision process before reward assignment.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers multimodal table and chart reasoning benchmarks, as well as general reasoning tasks. SVR-R1 improves accuracy over strong standard GRPO baselines. The most informative observation is in the training dynamics: early in training, the model uses more verification and rethink turns; later, it uses fewer verification rounds and often accepts the first answer, while test accuracy continues to improve. This suggests that the training process internalizes the verifier’s selection pressure into the first-pass generator rather than merely spending more inference-time compute. The provided content does not include the full per-benchmark scores, model size, or training-step details; those should be read from the experimental tables, training curves, and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the rollout protocol: shared generator/verifier weights, the Yes/No control rule, the maximum-turn cap, and where GRPO reward is applied. Then read the training-dynamics figure showing verification turns over time and accuracy changes. The most useful ablations would be comparisons against no self-verification, fixed multi-turn reflection, external verification, and different turn caps, because they separate the effect of self-verification from extra generation length or more sampling opportunities. For foundation-model training, the main object of interest is the rollout design, not the absolute ranking on a particular multimodal benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 自验证+多轮GRPO的VLM版本，训练动态那张图值得看；rethink轮次和reward hacking风险需自行消融。
recommendation.en: Self-verification extended to multi-turn GRPO for VLMs; worth reading the training-dynamics plot, but recheck reward hacking and rethink-turn budgets in your own ablations.

paper.title: Cost of Reasoning in non-English Languages: A Case Study on Japanese
paper.abstract: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) achieve their strongest performance when they reason in English, the language for which reasoning-oriented training data is most abundant. However, reasoning trace is a clue for model interpretability and safety, and useful in practice for both the model users and for model developers. Thus, it is desirable to be able to develop a model that reasons in a language of the user's choice, while still maintaining strong reasoning performance. To this end, we study the

summary.core_problem: 非英语推理语言是否能通过后训练控制实现，同时不显著损失推理能力；作者以日语为例研究 reasoning language control 的代价。
summary.importance: 这项工作连接 continual pretrain 与 RL 后训练，关注 reasoning trace 的语言控制、可解释性和安全性。它不是预训练范式创新，但对“推理能力是否绑定英语 CoT”这个问题给出了一手证据。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Qwen-3-Swallow-8B 这一从 Qwen-3-8B 持续预训练得到的日语模型，作者再用 GRPO 训练其以日语进行推理，并在 coding、math、science benchmark 上评估性能与语言控制效果，比较日语推理与英语推理基线。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 8B。结果显示，reasoning language control 是可行的，模型可以被训练成输出日语推理链；但整体性能至多与强英语推理基线持平，没有明显超过英语推理设置。摘要未给出详细提升幅度，结论更偏 feasibility study 而非性能突破。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether non-English reasoning can be induced through post-training without sacrificing reasoning quality, using Japanese as a case study.
summary_en.importance: It connects continual pretraining and RL-style post-training, focusing on language control over reasoning traces for interpretability and safety. This is not a pretraining paradigm paper, but it provides useful evidence on whether strong reasoning remains tied to English CoT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from Qwen-3-Swallow-8B, a Japanese model continually pretrained from Qwen-3-8B, the authors apply GRPO to train Japanese reasoning behavior. They then evaluate coding, math, and science benchmarks, comparing Japanese-reasoning behavior against strong English-reasoning baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The model is 8B. The main result is that reasoning-language control is feasible: the model can be trained to reason in Japanese. However, performance is at best on par with strong English-reasoning baselines rather than clearly better. The abstract suggests a feasibility study more than a performance breakthrough.

recommendation.zh: 结论不激进，但它给了一个干净信号：非英语 CoT 可控，性能却未必赚到；若你在做 multilingual reasoning，先把它当成本项而不是增益项。
recommendation.en: The result is modest but useful: non-English CoT is controllable, yet not obviously performance-positive; treat reasoning-language localization as a cost center, not an automatic gain.

paper.title: MJ: Multi-turn LLM Jailbreaking via Decomposed Credit Assignment
paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) operate in interactive multi-turn settings, making multi-turn jailbreaking a realistic threat model and an important setting for automated red teaming. A core challenge in learning multi-turn jailbreak attackers is credit assignment: different turns contribute differently to the final outcome, yet existing learning signals are often too coarse to identify their individual contributions. We propose decomposed credit GRPO (DC-GRPO), a unified turn-level credit a

summary.core_problem: 多轮 jailbreak 攻击学习中，单个回合对最终越狱成功的贡献不同，轨迹级奖励会导致 credit assignment 错位。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/RL 设定下的 credit assignment 改进。对做 GRPO、长轨迹 RL、multi-turn agent 训练的人有参考价值，但与基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 decomposed credit GRPO（DC-GRPO），为多轮对话中的每一轮分配独立的 group-relative 学习信号，并结合 immediate credit 与 future credit；同时给出 static 和 dynamic 两种加权规则，避免把单一 trajectory-level 分数广播到所有轮次。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法在多轮 jailbreak 学习上做了实验比较，但未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度。核心对比对象是标准 GRPO 或使用轨迹级奖励的多轮攻击学习方法，结论是 turn-level credit assignment 更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn jailbreak learning, different dialogue turns contribute differently to the final attack success, so trajectory-level rewards create a credit-assignment mismatch.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL contribution on credit assignment. It is relevant if you work on GRPO, long-horizon RL, or multi-turn agent training, but only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes decomposed credit GRPO (DC-GRPO), which assigns a separate group-relative learning signal to each turn in a dialogue by combining immediate and future credit. It also introduces static and dynamic weighting schemes to avoid broadcasting a single trajectory-level score to all turns.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments on multi-turn jailbreak learning, but does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The main comparison is against standard GRPO or trajectory-level reward formulations, with the conclusion that turn-level credit assignment works better.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做长轨迹 RL，这篇可借鉴 reward decomposition；否则只是 jailbreak 场景里的局部技巧，不必高估。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about long-horizon RL credit assignment; otherwise it is a jailbreak-specific trick and not something to over-index on.

paper.title: Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO
paper.abstract: This paper introduces Actor as Its Own Critic, a unified reinforcement learning framework, Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization (CycleGRPO), that jointly optimizes region understanding and localization for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike existing separate pipelines, we leverage the inherent duality between the two tasks to construct a self-evaluating reinforcement learning paradigm: "region $\to$ text $\to$ region''. Specifically, a single MLLM first acts as the actor to gen

summary.core_problem: 用一个多模态大模型同时优化区域描述和区域定位，减少对文本标注的依赖。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练方法。它把“region→text”和“text→region”的互逆关系变成 RL 奖励信号，尝试用自评估闭环替代人工区域 caption 标注。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization，即 CycleGRPO。模型先根据输入区域生成文本描述，再用同一模型把生成文本重新定位回空间区域；定位质量被转成 token-level cycle-consistency reward，用于衡量描述是否具有可区分的空间语义。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法构建在 SAMTok 之上，并可从仅有区域输入，如 mask 或 bounding box，进行 bootstrapping；提供文本未给出完整 benchmark、模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to jointly optimize region captioning and grounding in an MLLM while reducing reliance on text annotations.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal post-training recipe: it turns the duality between region-to-text and text-to-region into a reinforcement learning signal, using self-evaluation instead of supervised region captions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization, or CycleGRPO. A single MLLM first generates a caption for a given region and then grounds that generated caption back into the image; grounding accuracy is converted into a quality-aware token-level cycle-consistency reward.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the framework is built on SAMTok and can bootstrap from region-only inputs such as masks or bounding boxes. The provided text does not expose full benchmarks, model scale, data scale, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 设计即可；把 grounding 当 caption 质量代理有用，但离基座预训练信号还很远。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward design only; using grounding as a proxy for caption quality is useful, but this is still far from a base pretraining signal.

paper.title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation

summary.core_problem: 深度搜索Agent的RL训练普遍采用轨迹级评分，无法为找到关键支持文档的动作分配针对性信用，存在奖励-信用不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 提出溯源引导的步级信用分配方法STAMP，在不改变轨迹级奖励和排名的前提下提升搜索Agent RL训练效率，属于Agent RL训练方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 1）训练时用基于引用的验证器判断每个被引文档是否支持证据图中的实体或关系；2）首次曝光归因机制将每个有效引用追溯到首次发现它的搜索动作；3）符号保持优势调制，在步级重新分配优势，不改变轨迹总奖励和组内轨迹相对排名。
summary.experiments: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DS基准上，相同SFT初始化、训练数据和搜索工具配置下，STAMP相比GRPO基线分别提升2.0/5.5/3.0个点，可与结果奖励、引用评分奖励叠加使用。

summary_en.core_problem: RL for deep-search agents relies heavily on trajectory-level scoring, failing to assign targeted credit to actions that surface critical supporting documents, leading to a reward-credit mismatch.
summary_en.importance: Proposes STAMP, a provenance-guided step-level credit assignment method that improves RL training efficiency for search agents without altering trajectory-level rewards or rankings, as an RL training improvement for agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Uses a reference-based verifier at training time to judge whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in the evidence graph; 2) Applies first-exposure attribution to trace each valid citation back to the search action that first surfaced it; 3) Uses sign-preserving advantage modulation to redistribute step-level advantages without changing total trajectory reward or relative ranking of trajectories within a batch.
summary_en.experiments: On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP outperforms the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards.

recommendation.zh: 针对搜索Agent的GRPO步级信用分配改进，场景绑定较强，可快速扫过方法部分了解优势调制思路，无需深入读。
recommendation.en: Step-level credit assignment improvement for GRPO tailored to search agents, highly scenario-specific; skim the method section for the advantage modulation idea, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Route, Communicate, and Reason: Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent ensembling multiplies active parameters and inference cost without answering three basic questions: which agents to consult, how deeply a query should traverse a hierarchy of agents, and when inter-agent communication is worth its cost. We present GRADE (Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Reasoning), a hierarchical multi-agent system in which four lightweight learned gates jointly govern agent selection, hierarchy depth, inter-agent communication, and branch pruning. Trai

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多智能体 LLM 系统里的一个老问题：如果用一组较小、异构、专长不同的模型协同推理，怎样才能让系统按题目难度自适应地决定‘找谁来做、做到多深、谁和谁需要通信’，而不是像固定 ensemble 那样每次都把所有 agent 全跑一遍。作者还额外处理了一个很实际的问题：当某个 expert 在部署时被替换后，原先学到的 gate 阈值会失效，系统需要一种低成本的重新校准机制。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性有限，它更接近 post-train 阶段的多智能体推理系统与 RL 协调方法，而不是预训练方法本身。启发点主要有两类。第一，它把 MoE/conditional compute 的思想搬到了 agent 层：query-dependent routing、adaptive depth、selective communication，这些设计和大模型里 token-level 或 expert-level 路由有相通之处。第二，它展示了在冻结专家、只训练轻量协调层的设定下，RL 可以学到比手工协议更细的协作策略，这对研究 pretrain 与 post-train 接口、以及如何把计算预算分配给不同推理路径，有一定参考价值。但如果只从预训练研究优先级看，这篇不属于必须精读的那类。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者提出 GRADE，一个分层多智能体框架。系统分三层：最上层是一个小型 orchestrator M0，负责接收共享 encoder 产出的 query 表示并做初步决策；中间层是两个 manager，用 MLP 形成分组信号，把相关 specialist 组织到各自子池中；底层是若干 sub-agent，每个 agent 绑定一个冻结的 expert LLM，同时带有少量可训练模块，包括把 expert 输出映射到共享 d 维空间的 adapter、answer head，以及用于热替换后的 calibration map。

核心机制是四个 gate。Assignment Gate 决定激活哪些 sub-agent；Depth Gate 决定是否继续下探到更深层级或提前停止；Communication Gate 决定 agent 间哪些消息需要传递，避免全广播；Pruning Gate 则在分支展开后裁掉低价值路径。这样做的目标很明确：把多智能体系统从固定拓扑、固定通信、固定深度，改成按 query 自适应分配计算。

训练上，作者提出 CoGRPO，可以看成 group-relative policy optimization 在多智能体层级系统里的改写。它不需要 critic，而是基于 rollout 的相对奖励给所有参与当前轨迹的 gate 和 agent 分配 advantage。这里的关键不是 RL 名字本身，而是 credit assignment：因为最终只有一个 correctness reward，系统必须把这个稀疏信号回传给路由决策、通信决策和具体回答 agent。作者的做法是把所有对当前 rollout 有贡献的模块都纳入同一个相对优势更新框架。

另一个比较实用的设计是 Expert Registry + calibration。每个 agent 不直接和某个固定 expert 强绑定，而是通过 registry descriptor 与可替换 expert 关联。部署时如果替换 expert，只需用 64 个 anchor queries 对该 agent 的 calibration map 做重新校准，而不必重训 gates。作者强调这是因为不同 expert 的输出分布会漂移，若不校准，原有 gate 阈值和通信决策都会偏掉。
summary.experiments:
实验主要回答五件事：是否比 monolithic 或 flat ensemble 更省算力；四种 gate 各自贡献多大；CoGRPO 的 credit assignment 是否优于替代方案；expert hot-swap 后校准是否必要；以及难题是否真的会触发更多 agent 和更深层级。

结果上，GRADE 在平均约 17B active parameters 下，GSM8K 达到 94.8±0.3%，MMLUPro 78.2±0.6%，GPQA 57.4±1.8%，相对 Puppeteer 在 MMLUPro 提升 4.8 个点、在 GPQA 提升 3.3 个点。AIME-2025 上，Puppeteer 的 4-model brute-force ensemble 仍高 1.9 个点，说明在高强度数学推理上，单纯增加并行大模型推理深度仍有优势。

消融方面，论文的主线结论是：层级路由、选择性通信、深度自适应不是可互相替代的小组件，去掉任一部分都会带来明显退化；而 CoGRPO 比若干简单 credit assignment 方案更稳，因为它能把最终正确性奖励更合理地分给参与轨迹的 gate 与 agent。关于部署鲁棒性，去掉 calibration 后，expert 热替换会立刻造成约 18 个点的准确率下降，且需要 20+ 查询才能自然恢复；加入 calibration 后，恢复只需 0–9 个查询。这个结果虽然偏系统工程，但很实用。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看方法总览图和四个 gate 的定义，弄清楚系统到底在哪些位置做条件计算。然后重点看 CoGRPO 的 credit assignment 设计，因为这是区别于手工 orchestration 的核心。实验部分优先看三类表：一是和 Puppeteer、flat ensemble、monolithic baseline 的主结果；二是 gate/communication/depth 的消融；三是 expert substitution 与 calibration 的恢复曲线。

如果你的兴趣点是预训练，只需要花 25–35 分钟抓住 conditional compute 和 routing 设计即可，不必深挖所有 benchmark。若你做 post-train、agent RL 或 inference-time orchestration，这篇可以再细看训练细节和热替换实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical coordination problem in multi-agent LLM systems: given a heterogeneous pool of smaller experts, how can the system decide per query which agents to activate, how deep the reasoning hierarchy should go, and which agents should communicate, instead of running every expert every time? It also addresses a deployment issue that many agent papers ignore: when an expert is swapped at inference time, previously learned gate thresholds can become miscalibrated.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is limited. This is primarily a post-training and inference-time coordination paper, not a pretraining-method paper. The useful connection to foundation-model research is indirect. First, it brings conditional-compute ideas to the agent level: query-dependent routing, adaptive depth, and selective communication resemble MoE-style allocation, but at a coarser granularity. Second, it shows that RL can learn collaboration policies over frozen experts better than fixed prompt protocols, which is relevant if one cares about the interface between pretrained experts and downstream orchestration. Still, for a pretraining-focused reader, this is a skim rather than a must-read.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed system, GRADE, is a hierarchical multi-agent architecture with three levels. At the top is a lightweight orchestrator M0 that consumes a shared query representation from an encoder and makes initial routing decisions. The middle layer contains two manager modules, implemented as small MLPs, which provide grouping signals over subsets of specialists. The bottom layer consists of sub-agents, each backed by a frozen expert LLM plus lightweight trainable components: an adapter into a shared latent space, an answer head, and a calibration map used after expert substitution.

The main design is a set of four learned gates. The Assignment Gate selects which sub-agents are activated. The Depth Gate decides whether the system should continue deeper into the hierarchy or stop early. The Communication Gate learns pairwise message passing masks so that agents do not always broadcast to one another. The Pruning Gate removes low-value branches during execution. Together, these gates turn a fixed multi-agent pipeline into a query-adaptive conditional-compute system.

For training, the paper introduces CoGRPO, a multi-agent variant of group-relative policy optimization. It avoids a critic and instead assigns relative advantage to all gates and agents that contributed to a rollout under a final correctness reward. The important point is credit assignment: the system must propagate a sparse end reward back to routing, communication, and answering decisions jointly.

A practical addition is the Expert Registry with lightweight recalibration. Agents are associated with swappable experts through registry descriptors, and when an expert is replaced at inference time, only a small calibration step on 64 anchor queries is needed. The gates themselves are left untouched. This is meant to handle distribution shift in expert outputs after substitution.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around five questions: whether GRADE beats monolithic and flat-ensemble baselines at lower active-parameter cost, how much each gate contributes, whether CoGRPO improves credit assignment, whether calibration is necessary after expert hot-swap, and whether harder tasks trigger deeper and broader agent usage.

Reported results show 94.8±0.3 on GSM8K, 78.2±0.6 on MMLUPro, and 57.4±1.8 on GPQA with about 17B average active parameters. Relative to Puppeteer, the gains are +4.8 on MMLUPro and +3.3 on GPQA. On AIME-2025, however, Puppeteer’s brute-force four-model ensemble remains ahead by 1.9 points, suggesting that for very hard mathematical reasoning, simply allocating more large-model compute still helps.

The ablations indicate that hierarchical routing, selective communication, and adaptive depth each matter; they are not interchangeable extras. The calibration study is one of the more practical results: removing calibration causes an immediate accuracy drop of about 18 points after expert swap and requires more than 20 queries to recover, whereas with calibration the recovery takes only 0 to 9 queries.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the system overview and the definitions of the four gates. Then focus on CoGRPO, since learned credit assignment is the main methodological difference from prompt-engineered orchestration. In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the main comparison against Puppeteer, flat ensembles, and monolithic baselines; the gate and communication ablations; and the expert-substitution calibration results. If your main interest is pretraining, 25 to 35 minutes is enough to extract the conditional-compute lessons. If you work on agent RL or inference-time orchestration, the training details are worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 只看 gating ablation 和预算归一化；若 token/模型调用算清楚，它是多 Agent test-time compute 的好参照。
recommendation.en: Read the gating ablations and budget normalization; if token and model-call accounting is clean, it is a useful reference for multi-agent test-time compute.

institutions: Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi

paper.title: Switch-Reasoner: Learn When to Think in Multitask Mixtures via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often follow a fixed Think-then-Answer paradigm, which is inefficient in heterogeneous multitask settings because simple inputs may not require explicit reasoning while difficult ones can benefit substantially from it. Learning when to think is also unstable during post-training, where imbalanced rollouts can drive the model toward always-thinking or always-direct behavior. We propose Switch-Reasoner, a GRPO-based framework that learns to adaptively selec

summary.core_problem: 解决多任务 MLLM 在推理时固定采用“先思考再回答”带来的计算浪费，以及后训练中模型容易退化为总是思考或总是直接回答的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法改进。它把“是否显式思考”变成可学习的策略选择，关心的是推理预算分配和 reasoning behavior 控制，对预训练研究员的价值主要在于观察 RL 信号如何塑造模型的思考触发边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Switch-Reasoner，一个基于 GRPO 的框架。方法把 Thinking Mode 视作一种虚拟工具调用，模型可选择直接回答或先生成显式推理再回答；同时引入双层 regulation：全局层面平衡 Thinking Mode 与 Direct Mode 的使用比例，样本层面根据两种模式的相对收益提供监督，避免 rollout 分布失衡导致策略坍缩。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个多模态任务上评估。摘要称该方法能减少不必要的显式推理，同时维持或改善任务表现；未给出模型参数规模、训练数据规模、具体 baseline 名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient fixed think-then-answer behavior in MLLMs and the instability of learning when to reason during post-training.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect: it probes how RL objectives can shape the boundary between explicit reasoning and direct answering under heterogeneous task difficulty.
summary_en.technical_approach: Switch-Reasoner uses GRPO and treats explicit thinking as a virtual tool call. The model can either answer directly or invoke a thinking mode before answering. A dual-level regulation mechanism balances global usage of the two modes and adds sample-level supervision based on the relative benefit of thinking versus direct answering.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 11 multimodal tasks. The abstract reports reduced unnecessary reasoning while maintaining or improving performance, but does not provide model scale, data scale, baseline details, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法里的 dual regulation；这是后训练控推理预算的实用小招，不会改变 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the dual regulation design; it is a practical RL trick for reasoning budget control, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: Max Out GRPO Signal: Adaptive Trace Prefix Control for Hard Reasoning Problems
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stalls on a model's hardest problems: when no rollout in a group succeeds, the group-relative advantages vanish and the problem contributes no gradient, wasting the frontier examples we most want to learn from. Prepending a correct prefix of a reference solution raises the success rate, making prefix length a continuous knob on difficulty. Concurrent methods set the knob once; AdaPrefix-GRPO turns it into a feedback controller: throughout training it adj

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 GRPO 在难题上的“无梯度区”问题。对一批很难的题，如果同组 G 个 rollout 全错，那么 group-relative advantage 全为 0，这道题虽然最有训练价值，却不给任何更新信号。已有做法要么靠过滤和重采样绕开这些样本，要么先用监督痕迹把模型拉起来，但前者不能凭空制造正样本，后者又容易让策略熵过早塌缩，削弱后续探索。作者抓住了一个更直接的控制量：给参考解的正确前缀。前缀越长，条件成功率通常越高，于是“前缀长度”就成了题目难度的连续旋钮。真正的问题不只是加前缀，而是训练过程中应该把成功率控制在什么区间，以及如何随模型变强动态调整，避免一开始有效、后面失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有两层。第一，它把 RLVR/GRPO 中常见的 sparse reward 失灵，改写成一个可控的 curriculum 问题：不是被动接受样本难度，而是主动把样本推到最有梯度的区域。第二，它给出的是闭环控制而不是静态课程。很多课程学习方法在初始化时按 base model 定一次难度，模型一旦进步，原来的难度分配就偏离了最优工作点；这篇文章强调 success rate 的最优区间是动态目标，训练器需要持续追踪。这个思路对 reasoning RL 之外也有价值：凡是存在“太难无信号、太易无增益”的训练目标，都可以考虑把某个可操作条件变量做成 feedback controller。贡献量级上，它不是改写优化器或目标函数，而是在不动 GRPO 核心的前提下，显著改善 hard split 上的样本利用率，属于训练 recipe 层面比较干净、可复用的增益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 AdaPrefix-GRPO。核心设计有四步。第一，作者先分析 GRPO 信号与组内成功率 k/G 的关系。采用未做 std-normalization 的 centered advantage 时，正向学习信号随 p(1-p) 变化，在 p≈0.5 附近最大；这也是他们把目标 solve rate 设在约 50% 的原因。这里有一个细节：如果用按组标准差归一化的 advantage，极低成功率时单个正确样本的 advantage 会被放大，数值上更不稳定，而未归一化形式更适合把“中等成功率最有信号”这个结论直接落到控制目标上。

第二，作者把参考解前缀注入 prompt，作为 assistant message 的部分答案，让模型只补全后半段；前缀 token 不参与梯度，reward 仍按完整输出的最终答案计算。这样做的好处是实现层面几乎不改 trainer，只改数据管线和 loss mask。与直接做 trace SFT 不同，它没有把整条参考解当监督目标压给模型，而是只在条件分布上降低问题难度，保留了 RL 的探索空间。
