第三，作者不是给每题固定一个 prefix ratio，而是做“全局基准前缀 + 每题静态偏移”的两级控制。训练前先做一次 cold-start calibration，根据 base model 在不同题上的条件成功率，给每个样本估一个 difficulty-dependent offset；训练时再维护一个全局 base prefix length，用 secant 或 binary search 这类 root-finding 更新规则，根据最近 batch 实际观测到的平均 k/G，把全局前缀往目标 solve rate 推。这样既避免逐题在线搜索的高成本，也比完全固定的 per-sample 前缀更能跟踪策略随时间的变化。

第四，训练后期把所有前缀 anneal 到 0，保证部署时模型不依赖提示拐杖。这个 annealing 很关键。如果一直带前缀训练，模型学到的是“条件补全参考解”的能力，而不是无辅助求解；逐步撤掉前缀，相当于把课程从 teacher-assisted completion 过渡到独立解题。

和并行工作相比，差别主要在控制论视角。已有 prefix-based RL 方法通常在训练开始前选几个固定前缀长度，要求 base accuracy 落在“还行”的范围；AdaPrefix 的主张是，非零信号不够，应该把样本尽量维持在接近 50% 成功率的高梯度区，而且这个点会随训练漂移，所以必须在线调节。
summary.experiments:
实验重点放在 hard math。文中反复强调所有方法在 matched training FLOPs 下比较，避免把收益归因于额外采样或更长训练。基线包括 vanilla GRPO 和 fixed-prefix baseline。结果层面，AdaPrefix-GRPO 在 hard split 的 pass@1 上相对 vanilla GRPO 超过翻倍，也明显优于固定前缀方案；同时 pass@16 没有出现明显塌缩，说明收益不是靠牺牲多样性换来的。作者还指出，模型越小，提升越大，这和方法机理一致：小模型死区更大，更多题目原本完全不给梯度，因此把样本拉回可学习区的边际收益更高。

从文中给出的训练现象看，几个消融最值得注意。其一，目标 solve rate 设在中间区间优于过低或过高，支持“50% 左右最有信号”的分析。其二，固定前缀在训练初期可能有效，但随着策略变强，同样前缀会把题目推到过易区，k/G 上升后 advantage 变小，学习效率下降；闭环控制能持续把 batch-mean solve rate 拉回目标附近。其三，anneal-to-zero 是必要的，没有退火时测试期无前缀性能会打折。其四，作者把一次性 calibration 视为模型级预处理，不计入训练预算，理由是同一模型和数据上可跨多次训练复用。

摘要里提到 vanilla GRPO 在 hard split 上只有约 35% 的题能达到 pass@16，这说明训练集里存在相当大的 dead zone；AdaPrefix 的主要收益就是把其中一部分转成“有时能做对”的样本，从而产生非零且较强的 group signal。全文片段没有给出完整参数表和所有绝对数值，但从叙述看，作者做了按模型规模分层的比较，并且把 compute、group sampling 和部署时无前缀约束都控制得比较严。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Section 4.1。这里把问题讲得最清楚：为什么 GRPO 在 hard examples 上会失灵，为什么目标不是“让成功率大于 0”而是“尽量靠近 50%”。如果只想抓住方法本身，再看 Section 4.2，重点理解三件事：cold-start calibration、全局 base prefix 的闭环更新、以及 anneal-to-zero。

图表上，优先看展示 solve rate 随 prefix length 单调变化的图，以及训练过程中 batch-mean k/G 被控制在目标附近的曲线。这两类图决定了方法是否站得住。然后看主结果表，确认比较是否真的是 matched FLOPs、是否同时报告 pass@1 和 pass@16。消融里最该看的是 target solve rate、固定前缀 vs 自适应前缀、是否退火到零、以及不同模型尺寸的收益变化。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若要深挖，值得想两个问题。第一，prefix 作为 curriculum 变量是否会引入 reference-solution style bias，尤其在多解题上会不会把策略拉向某一种解法。第二，这个控制框架能否推广到代码、工具使用、甚至预训练阶段的 masked ratio / corruption strength 调度，而不局限于 reasoning RL。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural failure mode of GRPO on very hard reasoning problems. If all G rollouts in a group fail, the group-relative advantages are exactly zero, so the example contributes no gradient even though it is often the most valuable frontier case. Existing fixes either filter or oversample around the issue, or warm-start with supervised traces. The former cannot create positive signal when the model has none; the latter often reduces entropy and hurts exploration. The paper turns a correct solution prefix into a controllable difficulty knob: longer prefixes raise conditional success probability. The real question is not whether to add prefixes, but what success rate to aim for and how to keep problems near that regime as the policy improves.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a clean recipe-level intervention for RL-on-reasoning that reframes sparse-reward failure as a controllable curriculum problem. Instead of accepting the natural difficulty of each sample, the method actively moves samples into the region where GRPO produces the strongest learning signal. More importantly, it argues for closed-loop control rather than a static curriculum. A prefix schedule chosen once from the base model quickly becomes stale as the policy changes. That idea is useful beyond this specific setting: whenever training suffers from a “too hard gives no signal, too easy gives little gain” pattern, one can search for an observable control variable and regulate it online. This is not a new optimizer or a new RL objective, but it is a practical and reusable improvement to sample efficiency on hard reasoning data.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, AdaPrefix-GRPO, has four key pieces. First, the paper analyzes how GRPO signal depends on the within-group success rate k/G. With unnormalized centered advantages, the aggregate positive learning mass scales like p(1-p), peaking near p=0.5. That is why the controller targets roughly a 50% solve rate. The choice to avoid std-normalized advantages matters here: normalization can make rare successes numerically dominant when p is tiny, while the unnormalized form preserves a cleaner and more stable signal-shape argument.

Second, the method prepends a correct prefix from a reference solution as an assistant message and asks the model to complete the rest. Gradients are masked on the prefix tokens, while reward is still computed from the final full answer. This is an important design choice. It lowers conditional difficulty without turning the whole trace into a supervised target, so it preserves more of the exploration behavior that plain trace SFT tends to suppress.

Third, the controller is not fully per-sample online and not fully static either. The paper uses a two-level scheme: a global base prefix length plus a fixed per-sample offset derived from a one-time calibration. During training, the system observes the realized batch mean k/G and updates the global base prefix using a root-finding style rule such as secant or binary search, pushing the observed solve rate toward the target. The per-sample offsets account for persistent difficulty differences, while the global term tracks the non-stationarity induced by policy improvement.

Fourth, all prefixes are annealed to zero by the end of training, so the deployed model solves problems unaided. This is crucial. Without annealing, the policy may become good at conditioned continuation of partially solved traces rather than independent problem solving.

Relative to concurrent prefix-based RL work, the distinction is the control perspective. Prior methods typically choose a few fixed prefix lengths so that the base model has a “reasonable” conditioned accuracy. AdaPrefix argues that merely making the signal non-zero is not enough; one should keep examples near the high-signal regime, and that regime drifts during training.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on hard math and are explicitly run under matched training FLOPs, which is important because otherwise gains could be explained by extra sampling or longer training. Baselines include vanilla GRPO and a fixed-prefix variant. The headline result is that AdaPrefix-GRPO more than doubles pass@1 over vanilla GRPO on held-out hard problems, while also beating the fixed-prefix baseline. At the same time, pass@16 does not collapse, suggesting the method is not simply trading diversity for a narrow pass@1 gain. The paper also reports that the gains grow as model size shrinks, which matches the mechanism: smaller models have a larger dead zone, so converting impossible examples into learnable ones yields larger marginal benefit.

Several ablations are especially informative. Targeting an intermediate solve rate works better than aiming too low or too high, supporting the p(1-p) analysis. Fixed prefixes help early but drift toward the too-easy regime as the policy improves, reducing learning signal; the adaptive controller keeps the observed batch solve rate near the target. Annealing prefixes to zero is necessary for strong unaided test-time performance. The one-time calibration cost is treated as model-level preprocessing rather than run-specific training cost, since it can be reused across runs on the same model and dataset.

A useful quantitative anchor from the paper is that vanilla GRPO solves only about 35% of problems at pass@16 on the hard split, indicating a substantial dead zone in the training distribution. AdaPrefix’s benefit comes from moving a meaningful fraction of that region into a non-degenerate regime where group-relative learning signal exists. The excerpt does not expose the full parameter table or every absolute number, but the evaluation setup appears careful about compute matching, model-size stratification, and the no-prefix deployment constraint.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Section 4.1. Those parts make the central argument clearly: why GRPO fails on hard examples, and why the target is not just “non-zero success” but “success near 50%.” Then read Section 4.2 for the actual recipe: cold-start calibration, global closed-loop prefix adaptation, and annealing to zero.

For figures, prioritize the plots showing how solve rate changes with prefix length and the training curves showing batch-mean k/G being regulated near the target. Those are the core validity checks. Then inspect the main results table to verify that comparisons are truly under matched FLOPs and that both pass@1 and pass@16 are reported. In the ablations, focus on target solve rate, fixed versus adaptive prefixing, annealing versus no annealing, and how gains vary with model size.

Estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind. First, does prefixing introduce a style or solution-path bias from the reference trace, especially on problems with many valid derivations? Second, can the same control framework be generalized to code, tool use, or even pretraining settings where one can regulate corruption strength, mask ratio, or other difficulty variables?

recommendation.zh: 这是个很工程但很实用的 RL 信号修补：如果你在 hardest bins 上长期零梯度，先别改算法，先看它怎么把 success rate 控到 50%；重点读控制逻辑和撤前缀实验。
recommendation.en: A very practical RL signal patch: if your hardest bins sit at zero gradient, do not redesign the objective first—read how they servo success rate toward 50%; focus on the controller and prefix-withdrawal ablations.

paper.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming increasingly important for post-training large language models (LLMs). Previous RL pipelines for LLMs were mostly synchronous and batch-interleaved, which is inefficient for long-horizon agentic tasks. Recently, asynchronous RL has emerged as a more efficient alternative by updating the model as rollouts arrive. However, existing asynchronous RL systems often emphasize throughput, while leaving training stability and task effectiveness largely underexplore

summary.core_problem: 面向长horizon智能体任务的LLM异步强化学习（RL），在提升GPU利用率的同时，面临策略滞后引发的off-policy偏差大、训练不稳定，以及GRPO等组式采样方法与异步机制、单轨迹反馈的智能体场景不匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练后长轨迹智能体任务的RL对齐有实际参考价值，解决了异步RL训练的稳定性与组采样不兼容问题，为提升RL阶段的GPU利用率与训练效率提供了可落地方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出单轮异步优化（SAO），核心有四点：1）采用token级重要性采样，结合更严格的双边裁剪与掩码，缓解不同策略滞后下的off-policy偏差；2）用单轮采样替代GRPO的组式采样，从根源上避免组内等待带来的策略滞后，也适配单轨迹反馈的在线/智能体场景；3）优化价值模型训练流程——critic更新频率高于actor，且采用冻结注意力的方式微调价值模型，降低训练开销；4）针对多轮智能体轨迹（含环境反馈观测），推导跳过观测token的token级GAE估计器，避免观测token引入的噪声传播。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench Verified、AIME2025、BeyondAIME、HMMT、IMOAnswerBench等编程和数学推理基准上测试，SAO可稳定训练约1000步，性能优于改进版GRPO；单轮采样策略适配模拟在线学习场景，可适应动态环境变化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注核心方法部分的SAO设计，尤其是token级裁剪、单轮采样、skip-observation GAE三个创新点；实验部分关注异步训练的稳定性曲线和与GRPO的性能对比，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon agentic LLM tasks improves GPU utilization but suffers from severe off-policy drift due to policy lag, and existing group-wise sampling methods like GRPO are incompatible with asynchronous pipelines and single-trajectory feedback in agentic settings.
summary_en.importance: Provides practical insights for stable and efficient agentic RL in LLM post-training, addressing key pain points of asynchronous training stability and group-sampling incompatibility for long-horizon coding and reasoning workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) with four key components: 1) Token-level importance sampling with strict double-sided clipping and masking to mitigate off-policy drift under varying policy lag; 2) Single-rollout sampling per prompt to replace group-wise GRPO sampling, eliminating intra-group wait latency and fitting single-trajectory agent/online settings; 3) Improved value model training with more frequent critic updates than actor, plus frozen-attention fine-tuning for the value model to reduce overhead; 4) A skip-observation token-level GAE estimator for multi-turn agent trajectories that excludes environment observation tokens from advantage computation to avoid noise propagation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on agentic coding and math benchmarks including SWE-Bench Verified, AIME2025, BeyondAIME, HMMT, and IMOAnswerBench. SAO stably trains for ~1000 steps and consistently outperforms improved GRPO. The single-rollout design also performs well in simulated online learning with dynamic environment changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core method section for SAO design, especially token-level clipping, single-rollout sampling, and skip-observation GAE. Skim experimental results for stability curves and GRPO comparison. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 单rollout采样打破GRPO组归一化的常规思路，对做agent RL训练的人有启发，重点看方法和稳定性分析部分。
recommendation.en: Single-rollout sampling challenges the group-normalization convention in GRPO; relevant for researchers working on agentic RL training stability.

paper.title: Latent Visual Cache for Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: Video reasoning requires Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to remain grounded in dense evidence, yet existing systems largely adopt "read-once, generate-many" paradigm, in which visual grounding weakens during generation. This phenomenon has been widely observed and is known as Visual Anchoring Decay. To fill this gap, we introduce Latent Video Cache (Latent-VC), a recurrent latent visual cache inserted into the decoder to preserve compact visual memories throughout reasoning. The cache is trained

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是视频 LMM 在长链生成中逐步脱离视觉证据的问题。现有做法通常把视频 token 放在 prompt 前缀里，后续自回归生成时只依赖注意力回看这些早期视觉 token。随着回答变长，模型更容易依赖语言先验，出现论文称为 Visual Anchoring Decay 的视觉锚定衰减。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更像是视频 LMM 的结构和训练改造。但它有一个值得保留的启发：多模态模型不能只把非文本信息当作一次性前缀输入。对于长推理、多轮生成或视频理解，视觉信息需要以更靠近解码过程的形式持续存在。这个思路和 native multimodal pretraining、跨模态 latent memory、视觉 token 压缩都有关系。它也提示，长上下文多模态建模的瓶颈不只是上下文长度，还包括生成过程中模态证据是否仍能被有效访问。
summary.technical_approach: Latent-VC 在视频 LMM 的 decoder 内插入一组 latent cache token，作为非语言化的视觉记忆。具体做法是先用冻结视觉塔和 visual merger 得到视频前缀 token，然后在 prompt 与 answer 之间插入 S 个特殊的 <|lvc|> token。这些 token 的隐藏状态不作为普通词表 token 来预测，而是作为确定性的 recurrent computation state，用来保存压缩后的时空语义。论文把原始视频 token 称为 main memory，把 latent cache 看作更靠近解码过程的高速缓存。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT，同时加入 supervised contrastive cache alignment，把 cache hidden states 投影回视觉空间，并与关键帧 embedding 对齐，避免 latent slot 退化为空占位符。第二阶段使用 vision-grounded GRPO，奖励包括 answer reward、format reward、temporal reward 和 latent grounding reward。其中 latent reward 度量 completion-token hidden states 对关键帧的 coverage，用轨迹级信号约束推理链保持视觉一致性。一个关键工程选择是所有 cache 操作都发生在模型原生 hidden states 上，尽量减少训练和推理之间的分布偏移。这一点区别于一些把 latent reasoning 设计成额外生成 token 或外部模块的方法。
summary.experiments: 模型基于 Qwen3.5-9B 构建，在六个视频推理与理解 benchmark 上评测：TempCompass、Video-MME、MVBench、MMVU、Video-MMMU 和 VSI-Bench。对比对象包括强 CoT baseline 以及 SFT+GRPO baseline。论文报告 Latent-VC 在这些 benchmark 上均有稳定收益，并且回答长度更短，说明性能提升不只是来自生成更长的文本推理链，而是 latent cache 帮助模型保留了视觉证据。消融重点包括 latent cache 是否加入、cache alignment 是否加入、vision-grounded GRPO 中 latent reward 的作用，以及不同视频推理能力维度上的收益分布。给定内容未提供各表格的精确数值，精读时需要核对主结果表和奖励项消融表。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1，确认 Visual Anchoring Decay 的问题设定；再看 Figure 2 和方法部分 2.1–2.4，重点理解 latent cache token 如何插入 decoder、它为什么不是普通生成 token、训练和推理如何保持一致。实验部分优先看六个 benchmark 的主结果表，以及关于 cache alignment、latent grounding reward、response length 的消融。若关注多模态预训练，可以重点想一个问题：这种 cache 是否应只在后训练阶段加入，还是可以在 native multimodal pretraining 中作为结构先验一起训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual anchoring decay in video LMMs. Standard systems prepend video tokens once and then generate a long answer autoregressively. As generation proceeds, attention to early visual tokens weakens, and the model increasingly relies on language priors rather than dense video evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation-model design. The useful signal is that non-text modalities should not only be represented as a read-once prefix. For long video reasoning, the model needs a persistent visual state that stays close to the decoding process. This connects to native multimodal pretraining, visual token compression, latent memory, and the broader question of how a decoder should retain modality-specific evidence over long generations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent-VC inserts a small set of latent cache tokens into the decoder. The video is encoded by the frozen visual tower and visual merger into video-prefix tokens. Then S special <|lvc|> tokens are placed between the prompt and the answer. Their hidden states act as non-verbal visual memory rather than normal vocabulary tokens. The answer likelihood is still defined over discrete answer tokens, while the latent slots serve as deterministic recurrent computation states. Training has two stages. During SFT, a supervised contrastive cache-alignment objective projects cache states back into the visual space and aligns them with key-frame embeddings. This gives the cache a direct visual training signal and prevents it from becoming an empty placeholder. During RL, the paper uses vision-grounded GRPO with answer, format, temporal, and latent grounding rewards. The latent reward measures key-frame coverage over completion-token hidden states, encouraging the reasoning trajectory to remain visually grounded. A practical design choice is that the cache operates on native decoder hidden states, which keeps training and inference aligned and avoids the distribution shift seen in some latent-reasoning setups.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation is built on Qwen3.5-9B and evaluated on six benchmarks: TempCompass, Video-MME, MVBench, MMVU, Video-MMMU, and VSI-Bench. The reported comparisons include strong CoT baselines and SFT+GRPO baselines. Latent-VC improves performance across these benchmarks and produces shorter responses, suggesting that the gain is not simply from longer textual reasoning but from better retention of visual evidence. The key ablations to check are the latent cache itself, the supervised cache-alignment loss, the latent grounding reward inside GRPO, and response-length behavior. The provided content does not include exact table values, so the main result table and ablation tables should be checked before relying on the magnitude of the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 1 to understand the visual anchoring decay claim. Then read Figure 2 and Sections 2.1–2.4 for the cache interface, recurrent mechanism, training objectives, and train-inference alignment. In the experiments, focus on the main benchmark table, reward ablations, cache ablations, and response-length analysis. For pretraining researchers, the main question is whether this kind of latent visual cache should remain a post-training add-on or be introduced during native multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 多模态视频推理的缓存+RL联合设计很扎实，视觉接地GRPO的奖励设计和训练-推理对齐思路可直接迁移到内部多模态预训练ablation，重点看§3训练策略
recommendation.en: Solid cache+RL joint design for multimodal video reasoning; vision-grounded GRPO reward design and train-inference alignment can be directly migrated to internal multimodal pretraining ablations, focus on §3 training strategy

paper.title: Amortising Bayesian Experimental Design for Sequential Information Gathering in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and world-knowledge capabilities, yet often struggle to gather information effectively across the multi-turn interactions required in sequential decision-making settings. We introduce Amortised Sequential Information Gathering (ASIG), a fine-tuning approach that amortises Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) into LLM policies via a multi-turn extension of Group Relative Policy Optimisation with an Expected Information Gain reward. Evaluated on

summary.core_problem: LLM 在多轮序列决策场景中难以有效收集信息——既不能准确判断何时需要补充信息，也难以在多轮交互中保持连贯的信念更新；现有推理时优化的贝叶斯实验设计（BED）方法计算成本高且任务特定，而权重空间微调方法的泛化性尚不明确。
summary.importance: 将贝叶斯实验设计的信息增益原则通过强化学习微调 amortize 进 LLM 权重，实现了低成本的序列信息收集能力，并展示了跨任务迁移的可能；对预训练/后训练研究的启发在于，EIG 这类有理论依据的内在奖励信号可以与任务成功奖励结合，通过 GRPO 类算法塑造模型的主动探索行为，是 RL 后训练中值得关注的奖励设计方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ASIG（Amortised Sequential Information Gathering）框架，把 BED 的期望信息增益（EIG）作为奖励信号，通过多轮扩展的 Group Relative Policy Optimisation（GRPO）微调 LLM。核心设计：1）将 LLM 视为序列 BED agent，每轮选择实验（提问）以最大程度降低对潜在目标的不确定性；2）奖励由两部分组成——每轮的 EIG 奖励（用 Rao-Blackwellised 估计器计算，鼓励信息增益最大的提问）和最终任务成功奖励（多时间尺度信号）；3）扩展 GRPO 支持多奖励流与不同时间 horizon 的联合优化，并采用多轮 rollout 的课程学习策略。以 20 Questions 作为受控训练场景（二元结果使 EIG 可计算，且提问能力本身是领域无关的），评估泛化到医疗诊断基准 MediQ 的效果。
summary.experiments: 在 7B 规模模型上实验：1）20 Questions 任务上，ASIG 将基础模型的成功率提升超过 2 倍；2）与推理时 BED-LLM 基线相比，在四个设置中有两个表现更优，推理成本降低超过 25 倍；3）在训练中未见的医疗诊断基准 MediQ 上，7B 规模的 ASIG 模型无需领域内微调即可提升信息收集行为，展示了一定的跨领域迁移能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第 3 节的方法框架——多奖励流 GRPO 扩展和 EIG 奖励的构造方式；第 4 节实验看 20 Questions 的成功率提升和 MediQ 的迁移结果即可。背景中的 BED 和 EIG 数学推导可按需跳过。预计阅读时间 35–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs struggle with effective information gathering in sequential multi-turn settings: they fail to reliably recognize when additional information is needed and cannot maintain coherent belief updates across extended interactions. Inference-time Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) methods are computationally expensive and task-specific, while weight-space fine-tuning approaches have unclear generalization properties.
summary_en.importance: ASIG amortizes the information-gain principle of BED into LLM weights via reinforcement learning fine-tuning, achieving low-cost sequential information gathering and demonstrating cross-task transfer potential. For pretraining and post-training research, it shows that theoretically grounded intrinsic rewards like Expected Information Gain can be combined with task-success rewards via GRPO-style algorithms to shape active exploration behavior, representing a promising reward design direction for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASIG (Amortised Sequential Information Gathering) frames the LLM as a sequential BED agent that selects experiments (questions) at each turn to maximally reduce uncertainty about a latent target. The model is fine-tuned with a multi-turn extension of Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) using two reward signals: (1) per-turn Expected Information Gain (EIG), computed via a Rao-Blackwellised estimator to incentivize maximally informative questions, and (2) an outcome-based task-success reward operating at a longer horizon. GRPO is extended to support multiple reward streams with distinct temporal horizons, and a curriculum over multi-turn rollouts is used during training. The framework is instantiated on the 20 Questions game as a controlled setting (binary outcomes make EIG tractable, and question-asking is domain-agnostic), with generalization evaluated on the MediQ medical diagnosis benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments at the 7B scale show: (1) On 20 Questions, ASIG more than doubles the success rate of the base model. (2) Compared with the inference-time BED-LLM baseline, ASIG outperforms in two out of four settings while reducing inference cost by over 25×. (3) On MediQ, a medical diagnosis benchmark unseen during training, the 7B ASIG model improves information-seeking behavior without in-domain fine-tuning, demonstrating cross-domain transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 3 for the method framework—the multi-reward GRPO extension and EIG reward construction. In Section 4, look at the 20 Questions success-rate improvements and MediQ transfer results. The BED/EIG mathematical background can be skipped depending on interest. Estimated reading time: 35–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §method 和 20Q 结果；它把昂贵的推理时信息增益搜索变成可训练 policy，setup 小但信号干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and 20Q results; it turns costly inference-time information-gain search into a trainable policy, with a small but fairly clean setup.

paper.title: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is effective when the current policy already samples useful reasoning trajectories, but it stalls on hard prompts whose correct solution modes lie outside the student's on-policy support. We propose TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL), a simple staged procedure that uses distillation not for imitation but for exploration support expansion. A key advantage of TREK is its generality: because it only consumes verified output trajectories, it ca

summary.core_problem: GRPO 在困难推理提示上会遇到 on-policy 探索覆盖不足的问题：当学生策略几乎抽不到任何正确轨迹时，加大采样组规模或调整优势函数都只是在当前策略支撑集内搜索，奖励信号无法到达真正的解题模式。论文要解决的是如何在不依赖教师内部参数/logits 的前提下，为 on-policy RL 安全、可控地扩展可采样的解空间。
summary.importance: 这是 post-train/RL 推理训练方向上一个有实际工程价值的 recipe 观察：把蒸馏从“模仿教师”重新定位为“探索支持集扩展”，并给出一个与黑盒教师、白盒教师、同模型带额外上下文推理（执行反馈、反思、更长思考预算）都兼容的接口。对预训练研究的直接启发在于：它明确区分了“把已有高概率行为学精”和“把之前根本采不到的行为拉进策略支撑集”这两个训练阶段，对理解 annealing、mid-training 往 RL 的接口也有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: TREK 是一个分阶段流程：先用无辅助学生的 pass rate 识别 hard prompts，只对这些 prompt 调用 proposal 源（可以是外部黑盒强模型，也可以是同模型加 reflection/执行反馈/长 rollout），用 verifier 过滤出正确轨迹，再按当前学生策略下的似然选出最接近学生当前分布的 top-r 条样本，对这些轨迹做一小段 forward KL(q_prop || π_θ) 的 warm-start 蒸馏，最后回到标准 GRPO 流里继续 on-policy 精炼。关键设计选择是用 forward KL 而不是 reverse KL：目标是把学生没覆盖到的新解模式往策略里注入概率质量，而不是让学生在已有模式上精确拟合教师；同时只选“学生当前可达”的 proposal，避免把过于远端、与当前策略脱节的轨迹硬塞进来导致训练不稳。
summary.experiments: 在 agentic 推理任务上，TREK 相比纯 GRPO 显著加速早期训练，尤其在最难任务类型上收益明显：通过在 RL 开始前注入经过验证的解模式，学生更快达到高成功率，而纯 GRPO 需要多得多的训练步才能到达同等水平。论文给出的 ablation 要点包括：prompt 级路由（只在 hard prompts 上调教师）优于全量蒸馏；按学生似然筛选 proposal 比随机/贪心选更好；forward KL warm-start 作为探索注入比直接 imitation/reverse KL 更适合后续 GRPO 衔接；黑盒教师和同模型上下文增强两种 proposal 源都有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Introduction 里对 GRPO 失效模式的刻画、Method 里 forward-KL proposal learning 的推导动机，以及 experiments 中关于 hard prompt 筛选率 r 和 warm-start 步数的消融。预计阅读 25–35 分钟。不需要逐行跟 RL 目标公式推导，抓三件事即可：为什么 on-policy 在 hard prompt 上失效、为什么蒸馏应该作为 proposal 而不是 imitation、为什么用 forward KL 与学生似然筛选来控制注入的“距离”。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO stalls on hard prompts when the student policy puts too little mass on any correct reasoning trajectory. The bottleneck is not reward sparsity on sampled trajectories, but lack of exploration beyond the student’s current on-policy support. The paper asks how to expand that support safely without requiring white-box access to a teacher.
summary_en.importance: The useful reframing is to treat distillation as exploration support expansion rather than imitation or token-level credit shaping. The proposed staged recipe is compatible with black-box teachers, white-box teachers, and same-model context augmentation (execution feedback, reflection, longer reasoning budgets). For pretraining researchers, this matters as a clean case study of the distinction between sharpening behaviors already inside the model’s support and pulling new modes into that support before RL refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: TREK proceeds in stages. It first identifies hard prompts using unaided student pass rate, invokes a proposal source only on those prompts, filters proposals with a verifier, keeps the top-r verified trajectories by current student likelihood, runs a short forward-KL(q_prop || π_θ) warm-start on those trajectories, and then returns control to ordinary GRPO. The central design choice is forward KL rather than reverse KL: the objective is to add probability mass to newly discovered solution modes that are still reachable from the current student, not to precisely clone teacher behavior. The student-likelihood filter explicitly avoids forcing in trajectories too far from the current policy.
summary_en.experiments: On agentic tasks, TREK improves final success rate and materially accelerates early training, especially on the hardest task types. Injecting verified solution modes before GRPO lets the student reach high success rates much earlier than unaided GRPO. Reported ablations support the main design choices: routing proposals only to hard prompts is better than blanket distillation, ranking proposals by student likelihood outperforms alternative selection rules, and forward-KL warm-start integrates better with subsequent on-policy GRPO than imitation-style objectives. Both black-box teachers and same-model context augmentation work as proposal sources.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a methods/recipe paper rather than a theory paper. Focus on the introduction’s diagnosis of GRPO’s support-coverage failure mode, the justification for forward-KL proposal learning in Method, and ablations on routing, proposal selection, and warm-start length. Skip the detailed GRPO formula rewrites if you already know the algorithm. Time estimate: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对GRPO探索不足的核心痛点，蒸馏做探索的思路可迁移到预训练数据课程设计，重点看前向KL阶段的实现细节
recommendation.en: Targets GRPO's core exploration bottleneck; the distillation-for-exploration idea transfers to pretraining data curriculum design, focus on forward-KL phase implementation

paper.title: Evidence-State Rewards for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning requires models to locate, revise, and synthesize evidence distributed across lengthy inputs. Existing long-context RL methods usually reward final answers or static evidence extraction, offering little feedback on how intermediate actions change the model's evidence state. We propose Maven, a reinforcement learning framework with an editable evidence memory. Maven defines an answer-conditioned evidence-state value and rewards action-level state transitions: add actions ar

summary.core_problem: 现有长上下文推理的 RL 奖励主要监督最终答案或静态证据抽取，无法反馈模型在推理过程中对证据集合进行增删、关联、修正的中间状态变化，容易导致模型过早锚定局部证据、无法丢弃干扰项、也难以组合分散证据。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train / long-context reasoning 方向的过程奖励设计，对预训练研究的直接启发在于两点：一是它把长上下文推理拆解为显式的证据状态转移，这种结构化中间表示与近年 reasoning trace / latent reasoning 的训练信号设计思路相通；二是动作级 credit assignment 的做法说明，仅靠 outcome reward 不足以训练长程依赖下的信息整合行为，对设计 pretrain-posttrain 闭环中的细粒度监督有参考价值。但它不是基座预训练方法本身，影响力主要在长上下文 RL 和过程奖励。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Maven，一个带可编辑 evidence memory 的 RL 框架。模型生成轨迹时可执行四类动作：add 将某段上下文加入证据记忆，link 说明两条已有证据如何联合支撑答案，drop 删除无关或误导性证据，answer 输出最终答案。核心是定义 answer-conditioned evidence-state value：对当前问题 Q、证据集合 E 和标准答案 a⋆，用冻结 verifier 计算 teacher-forced 下答案的 NLL，再用加入证据前后的相对 NLL 下降作为证据状态价值。基于该状态价值，给每个动作分配局部过程奖励：add 看边际增益和 hindsight 贡献，link 看证据协同带来的联合价值提升，drop 看移除误导证据后答案支撑度是否改善，answer 看最终答案正确性。这些动作级奖励随后在 GRPO 中分配到对应生成 span。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 上评测 LongBench v2、LongReason、RULER。论文报告 Maven 相比 outcome-only RL 和已有 evidence-aware reward，在最终答案准确率上有一致提升，同时诊断指标显示证据充分性提高、distractor 留存减少。当前提供的全文截断了实验详细表格，无法核对具体百分点和消融拆分，但方法的主要 empirical claim 是跨模型族、跨 benchmark 稳定增益，并且不是只提升显式引用质量，而是改善证据修订和组合行为。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看方法部分的动作定义、evidence-state value 公式，以及三类非 answer 动作的 reward 设计逻辑。如果关心长上下文 RL，可以再看后面的证据充分性/干扰项留存诊断。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。不需要把它当成 pretrain 核心论文，但对理解 process reward 如何从结果监督走向状态转移监督有帮助。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL methods for long-context reasoning mostly reward final answers or static evidence extraction, and therefore give little feedback on how intermediate actions revise the model’s evolving evidence state. This encourages premature commitment to partial evidence, failure to discard distractors, and weak synthesis of evidence scattered across long inputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training / long-context RL paper rather than a base pretraining method, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it makes the reasoning process structurally explicit: long-context reasoning is modeled as a sequence of edits to an evidence state rather than a single retrieval step. The local, action-level credit assignment is a useful example of how sparse outcome reward can be insufficient for long-horizon information integration, which matters for broader work on process supervision, reasoning traces, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maven adds an editable evidence memory to RL training. The policy can emit four action types: add a context span to memory, link two existing pieces of evidence by explaining their joint support for the answer, drop a misleading or redundant item, and answer. At each step, evidence-state value is defined as the answer-conditioned utility of the current memory: a frozen verifier computes teacher-forced answer NLL given the question and evidence set, and value is measured by relative NLL reduction. Action-level rewards are then assigned locally in GRPO: add is rewarded by marginal gain and hindsight contribution, link by evidence synergy, drop by improved answer support after removing the item, and answer by final correctness.
summary_en.experiments: Maven is evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B across LongBench v2, LongReason, and RULER. The paper reports consistent gains over outcome-only RL and prior evidence-aware rewards on final-answer accuracy, with diagnostic evidence of higher evidence sufficiency and lower distractor retention. The available text is truncated before the result tables, so exact numbers and ablation breakdowns cannot be verified from the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the methodology first, especially the action space, the answer-conditioned evidence-state value, and how rewards are assigned to add/link/drop transitions rather than to static evidence chunks. If interested in long-context RL, continue to the diagnostic metrics on sufficiency and distractor retention. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文RL从结果监督转向证据状态过程监督的创新，动作级奖励分配的设计可直接迁移到预训练中间推理信号的构造，重点看§3.2的奖励定义和§4的GRPO对齐细节。
recommendation.en: Innovates long-context RL by shifting from outcome supervision to evidence-state process supervision; action-level reward design can be directly adapted to construct intermediate reasoning signals for pretraining, focus on §3.2 reward definition and §4 GRPO alignment details.

paper.title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Training, Evaluation, and Release Control for Domain Agent Post-training
paper.abstract: Domain agents often face noisy business data, uncertain post-training gains, offline/application mismatch, and adapter-release risk. This paper presents CLAP (Closed-Loop Agent Post-training), a closed-loop method that converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records. CLAP combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide wheth

summary.core_problem: 领域 Agent 后训练面临业务数据噪声、离线收益不确定、离线-线上 mismatch 与 LoRA 适配器发布风险，缺乏闭环质量管控机制。
summary.importance: 工程系统贡献：提出领域 Agent 后训练的闭环管控流程，覆盖数据构造、诊断、离线门禁与线上回放验证全链路。
summary.technical_approach: CLAP 闭环方法：将业务数据转化为结构化 SFT 样本、决策偏好样本、留出集、风险诊断项与发布门禁记录；融合数据校验、目标/证据归一化、reward/KL 诊断、离线门禁与应用链回放，判断适配器是否可上线。
summary.experiments: 在 5 组匿名制造场景批次上测试：QLoRA 式 LoRA-SFT 平均总分提升 0.0098、通过率提升 0.0240、证据准确率提升 0.0280，幻觉与错误事实下降；仅 3/5 批次有提升，部分批次退化，GRPO 暴露高 KL 风险；同等 3B 骨干下应用链回放显示 RAG 对事实抽取必要。

summary_en.core_problem: Domain agent post-training faces noisy business data, uncertain offline gains, offline-online mismatch, and LoRA adapter release risks, with no closed-loop quality control mechanism available.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution: proposes a closed-loop control pipeline for domain agent post-training, covering data construction, diagnosis, offline gating, and online replay verification end-to-end.
summary_en.technical_approach: CLAP closed-loop method: converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records; combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide adapter release eligibility.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 anonymized manufacturing batches: QLoRA-style LoRA-SFT yields average gains of 0.0098 overall score, 0.0240 pass rate, 0.0280 evidence accuracy, with reduced hallucination and wrong facts; only 3/5 batches improve, some regress, GRPO exposes high KL risks; application-chain replay under the same 3B backbone shows RAG is necessary for factual extraction.

recommendation.zh: 领域 Agent 后训练的工程化管控经验，GRPO 高 KL 风险的观察可做弱信号，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Engineering control experience for domain agent post-training; the high KL risk observation for GRPO serves as weak signal, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Mastermind: Strategy-grounded Learning for Repository-Scale Vulnerability Reproduction
paper.abstract: Repository-level vulnerability reproduction is a demanding software engineering (SE) task: an agent must inspect a codebase, infer the input grammar that reaches a vulnerable path, construct a proof-of-conceptv(PoC), and verify that the crash disappears on the patched build. Recent LLM agents can often execute these steps when the approach is correct, yet they still fail by choosing the wrong strategy. This paper argues that strategy, rather than the full action trajectory, is the right learning

summary.core_problem: 解决仓库级漏洞复现任务中LLM智能体因策略选择错误导致失败的问题，提升复杂软件工程任务的规划能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出将可迁移策略而非完整动作轨迹作为软件工程智能体的学习单元，结合SFT与GRPO实现策略复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mastermind双循环框架：可训练规划器通过SFT和基于里程碑的GRPO学习可复用的漏洞复现策略；经验循环维护任务局部策略记录，指导后续尝试；将策略学习与任务特定经验分离，实现跨尝试的策略迁移。
summary.experiments: 面向仓库级漏洞复现任务，对比现有LLM智能体基线，通过策略复用提升任务成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high failure rate of LLM agents in repository-level vulnerability reproduction caused by incorrect strategy selection in complex software engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing transferable strategy (rather than full action trajectory) as the learning unit for SE agents, combining SFT and GRPO for strategy reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mastermind, a dual-loop framework: a trainable planner learns reusable vulnerability-reproduction strategies via SFT and milestone-based GRPO; an experience loop maintains task-local strategy records to guide subsequent attempts, separating transferable strategy learning from task-specific experience.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on repository-level vulnerability reproduction tasks, improving success rate over existing LLM agent baselines via strategy reuse.

recommendation.zh: 软件工程智能体的策略学习思路有一定参考性，关注GRPO在长程规划中的用法即可，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: The strategy learning formulation for SE agents has some reference value; focus on the GRPO usage for long-horizon planning only.

paper.title: Beyond Next-Token Prediction: An RLVR Proof of Concept for Tool-Use Agents on Atlassian Workflows
paper.abstract: Large language models are trained to predict the next token, not to act inside a specific API. In niche enterprise SaaS workflows -- where success means hitting the right endpoint with the right nested arguments in the right order -- this objective mismatch shows up as silent failures: dropped required fields, hallucinated tools, or early stops after a single read. We ask whether Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), applied directly in the target environment, closes the gap. As

summary.core_problem: LLM的下一词元预测训练目标与企业SaaS工作流中工具调用Agent的目标不匹配，导致必填字段缺失、工具幻觉、提前停止等静默失败问题。
summary.importance: 概念验证类工作，验证了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升企业级工具调用Agent性能上的作用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建5个模拟Jira REST v3和Confluence v2 API的合成环境，奖励完全基于工具调用轨迹计算，无需活API、学习型评判或人类标注；采用GRPO算法训练Qwen系列模型。
summary.experiments: 在4个非退化奖励场景中，RL训练后的策略将平均奖励从4B基线的0.35-0.9区间提升（原文摘要截断，完整结果未披露）。

summary_en.core_problem: The next-token prediction objective of LLMs mismatches the goal of tool-use agents in enterprise SaaS workflows, leading to silent failures like missing required fields, hallucinated tools, and early stops.
summary_en.importance: Proof-of-concept work validating the effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for improving enterprise tool-use agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds 5 synthetic environments emulating Jira REST v3 and Confluence v2 APIs, with rewards computed entirely from tool-call traces without live APIs, learned judges, or human labels; uses GRPO to train Qwen models.
summary_en.experiments: On 4 non-degenerate reward scenarios, RL-trained policies lift average reward from the 4B baseline range of 0.35-0.9 (abstract truncated, full results undisclosed).

recommendation.zh: 特定企业SaaS场景的RLVR概念验证，方法无本质创新，仅可作为工具调用Agent训练的弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: RLVR proof of concept for specific enterprise SaaS scenarios with no fundamental method innovation; weak reference for tool-use agent training, read abstract only.

paper.title: Staleness-Learning Rate Scaling Laws for Asynchronous RLHF
paper.abstract: High-throughput RLHF systems often decouple rollout generation from policy optimization, leading to the use of stale rollouts during learner updates. In this work, we study the effect of such staleness in asynchronous GRPO. We make the behavior policy explicit in the GRPO surrogate objective and distinguish between the surrogate-gradient mapping used by the learner and the true total derivative of a distribution-dependent population objective. Under assumptions of local boundedness, distribution

summary.core_problem: 大规模异步RLHF流水线（尤其是当前推理增强对齐主流采用的GRPO方案，如DeepSeek-R1所用架构）中，rollout生成与策略优化解耦会产生陈旧rollout问题——即生成经验的行为策略滞后于学习器当前策略。现有异步SGD分析仅将滞后程度（staleness）视为有界延迟，未量化其与策略梯度固有的分布偏移、学习率之间的交互作用，也无法解释异步GRPO中普遍观测到的「先稳定提升后突然崩溃」的两阶段训练动态，更缺乏可落地的学习率与滞后程度匹配规则。
summary.importance: 该工作填补了现有分布式RL理论与主流GRPO-based RLHF实践之间的空白，针对无 critic、无显式off-policy校正、仅依赖重要性采样比裁剪与KL正则的现代RLHF场景，建立了滞后程度-学习率缩放律的理论框架，给出了稳定训练的闭式约束条件。结论可直接指导工业级大规模异步RLHF的系统设计与超参调优，减少试错成本、避免训练崩溃，属于预训练-后训练闭环中对齐优化环节的基础理论+可落地规则类贡献，可直接影响工业级系统的配置策略。
summary.technical_approach: 核心技术方案分为四个部分，与现有方法的核心区别在于完全适配GRPO的无 critic 结构与当前RLHF的无显式off-policy校正设定：1. 行为策略感知的GRPO代理目标重构：不同于默认行为策略与当前学习策略等价的传统GRPO推导，显式将生成rollout的陈旧行为策略φ与学习器参数θ解耦，定义代理梯度映射ℋ(θ,φ)，避免将代理梯度与分布依赖的总体目标全导数混为一谈，为滞后偏差分析提供了严谨基础。2. 单步滞后偏差量化：在局部有界、分布平滑、行为策略平滑三个假设下，严格证明陈旧rollout引入的单步代理梯度偏差量级为O(Sη)，其中S为最大rollout滞后步数、η为学习率，即单步训练的安全区域由Sη的乘积控制。3. 条件崩溃时间缩放律：区分两类约束——GRPO重要性采样比的batch级裁剪半径、训练时域内的学习器漂移阈值，将训练稳定性分为两种状态区间（regime）：当Sη足够小、单步滞后偏差未超出batch裁剪容忍范围时，崩溃时间遵循Tη（T为训练步数）的时域律，此时最大稳定学习率几乎与S无关；当Sη超出batch裁剪容忍范围时，稳定性直接由Sη约束。4. 双约束稳定规则：结合两种状态区间给出可直接落地的超参配置公式η ≪ min{R_batch/(S·G_upd), R_crit/(T·G_upd)}，其中R_batch为batch级裁剪半径、R_crit为临界漂移阈值、G_upd为单步梯度幅度，解释了工业实践中有时观察到的「最大稳定学习率与滞后程度无关」的现象仅出现在时域约束主导的场景。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的全文片段未包含完整实验章节，摘要及理论推导部分未给出具体实验数值（如参数量、数据规模、性能提升幅度）；所有结论均基于三个明确假设的解析推导，给出了偏差量级与稳定约束的闭式表达。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级如下：1. 引言部分：重点理解异步GRPO的吞吐动机、现有分析的核心缺陷，以及「先稳后崩」两阶段训练动态的观测背景。2. 行为策略感知的GRPO代理重构章节：重点理解ℋ(θ,φ)的定义逻辑，明确传统GRPO推导无法处理滞后问题的核心原因。3. 单步滞后偏差证明：关注三个假设的适用边界——例如当策略更新过于激进时，局部有界假设会失效，此时结论不再成立。4. 条件崩溃时间缩放律推导：重点理解两种状态区间的切换条件，即batch级裁剪约束与时域漂移约束的权衡逻辑。5. 若后续获取完整实验章节：重点关注不同滞后步数S、不同学习率η下的训练稳定性曲线，验证两阶段动态与双约束规则的匹配度。值得深挖的方向：将该框架扩展至普遍加入KL正则的GRPO场景、适配多模态RLHF设定、结合V-trace等显式off-policy校正方法以提升允许的最大滞后步数S，进一步提高训练吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: In large-scale asynchronous RLHF pipelines (especially GRPO-based setups widely adopted for reasoning-enhanced alignment, such as the architecture used in DeepSeek-R1), decoupling rollout generation from policy optimization introduces the stale rollout problem: the behavior policy generating experience lags the current learner policy. Existing asynchronous SGD analyses only treat staleness (lag magnitude) as a bounded delay, without quantifying its interaction with the inherent distribution shift of policy gradients and the learning rate, nor explaining the commonly observed two-phase training dynamic in asynchronous GRPO — stable improvement followed by abrupt collapse — nor providing actionable matching rules between learning rate and lag magnitude.
summary_en.importance: The work fills a critical gap between distributed RL theory and mainstream GRPO-based RLHF practice. Targeting modern RLHF setups that omit critic networks and explicit off-policy corrections, relying solely on clipped importance sampling ratios and KL regularization, it establishes a theoretical framework for the staleness-learning rate scaling law and provides closed-form stability constraints. Its conclusions directly guide system design and hyperparameter tuning for industrial-scale asynchronous RLHF, reducing trial-and-error cost and avoiding training collapse. It falls into the category of foundational theory plus actionable rules for alignment optimization in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop, with direct impact on industrial system configuration strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core technical scheme consists of four parts, with the key difference from prior methods being full adaptation to GRPO’s critic-free structure and the current RLHF setup without explicit off-policy corrections: 1. Behavior-policy-aware GRPO surrogate objective reconstruction: Unlike traditional GRPO derivations that assume equivalence between the behavior policy and the current learner policy, it explicitly disentangles the stale behavior policy φ (used to generate rollouts) from the learner parameter θ, and defines the surrogate gradient mapping ℋ(θ,φ) to avoid conflating the surrogate gradient with the total derivative of the distribution-dependent population objective, providing a rigorous foundation for lag bias analysis. 2. Per-step staleness bias quantification: Under three assumptions (local boundedness, distributional smoothness, behavior-policy smoothness), it strictly proves that the per-step surrogate gradient bias induced by stale rollouts scales as O(Sη), where S is the maximum rollout lag step count and η is the learning rate — meaning the single-step training safe region is controlled by the product Sη. 3. Conditional collapse-time scaling law: It distinguishes two types of constraints: the batch-level clipping radius from GRPO’s importance sampling ratio, and the learner drift threshold over the training horizon. Training stability is divided into two regimes: when Sη is small enough that per-step staleness bias stays within the tolerance of batch clipping, the collapse time follows a Tη horizon law (T is the total training step count), and the maximum stable learning rate is nearly independent of S; when Sη exceeds the batch clipping tolerance, stability is directly bounded by Sη. 4. Two-constraint stability rule: Combining the two regimes, it provides an actionable hyperparameter configuration formula η ≪ min{R_batch/(S·G_upd), R_crit/(T·G_upd)}, where R_batch is the batch-level clipping radius, R_crit is the critical drift threshold, and G_upd is the per-step gradient magnitude. This explains the industrial observation that the maximum stable learning rate sometimes appears independent of lag magnitude, which only occurs in scenarios dominated by the horizon constraint.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available full-text snippet does not include the complete experimental section, and no specific empirical metrics (model size, data scale, performance lift) are provided in the abstract or theoretical derivation segments. All conclusions are derived analytically under the three explicitly stated assumptions, with closed-form expressions for bias magnitude and stability constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the following sections for intensive reading: 1. Introduction: Focus on the throughput motivation of asynchronous GRPO, the core limitations of existing analyses, and the observational background of the two-phase "stable-then-collapse" training dynamic. 2. Behavior-policy-aware GRPO surrogate reconstruction: Focus on the definition logic of ℋ(θ,φ), and clarify the core reason why traditional GRPO derivations cannot handle staleness. 3. Per-step staleness bias proof: Pay attention to the applicability boundaries of the three assumptions — for example, when policy updates are overly aggressive, the local boundedness assumption fails and the conclusions no longer hold. 4. Conditional collapse-time scaling law derivation: Focus on the switching condition between the two regimes, i.e., the tradeoff logic between the batch-level clipping constraint and the horizon drift constraint. 5. If the full experimental section is available later: Prioritize training stability curves under different lag step counts S and learning rate η settings to verify the two-phase dynamic and the validity of the two-constraint rule. Worth further exploration: extending the framework to GRPO scenarios with universally added KL regularization, adapting it to multimodal RLHF setups, and combining it with explicit off-policy correction methods such as V-trace to increase the maximum allowable lag step count S for higher training throughput.

recommendation.zh: 极其硬核的异步 RL 训练动态分析，给出了 staleness 和 LR 的定量关系，做大规模 RLHF 系统的必读，直接指导系统设计和调参。
recommendation.en: Extremely hardcore analysis of asynchronous RL training dynamics, providing a quantitative relationship between staleness and LR; a must-read for large-scale RLHF system builders, directly guiding system design and tuning.

paper.title: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models, especially when small but critical visual cues are buried in high-resolution images. Existing approaches rely on repeated cropping or test-time visual search to introduce local evidence, but they typically do not explicitly distinguish perception from reasoning. In this paper, we propose Perceive-to-Reason (P2R), a unified framework that formulates fine-grained visual reasoning as a two-stage process: the model first l

summary.core_problem: 细粒度视觉推理任务中，视觉语言模型难以定位高分辨率图像中微小但关键的视觉线索，现有方法未明确区分感知与推理过程，导致细粒度推理能力不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出感知-推理解耦的细粒度视觉推理框架，以及角色感知的交替强化学习策略，为VLM细粒度能力提升提供了新的优化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Perceive-to-Reason（P2R）两阶段框架：先由感知器模块定位与问题相关的视觉证据区域，再由推理器模块基于标注图像和裁剪区域回答问题；配套提出PRA-GRPO强化学习策略，仅用最终答案监督交替进行感知方向和推理方向的模型更新。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen3-VL-Instruct的2B/4B/8B三个参数规模的模型进行实验，在细粒度视觉推理任务上取得一致的性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Fine-grained visual reasoning is challenging for vision-language models, as small but critical visual cues in high-resolution images are hard to locate, and existing methods do not explicitly separate perception from reasoning processes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a decoupled perception-reasoning framework for fine-grained visual reasoning and a role-aware alternating reinforcement learning strategy, offering new optimization ideas for improving VLM fine-grained capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Perceive-to-Reason (P2R), a two-stage framework where a perceiver module first localizes question-relevant visual evidence regions, then a reasoner module answers questions based on the annotated image and cropped regions; introduces PRA-GRPO, an alternating RL strategy that updates perception and reasoning modules separately using only final-answer supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-VL-Instruct models with 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters, achieving consistent performance improvements on fine-grained visual reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 细粒度VLM的解耦训练思路可参考，PRA-GRPO的交替优化设计有一定启发，看摘要和方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The decoupled training idea for fine-grained VLM is worth noting, and the alternating optimization design of PRA-GRPO provides some inspiration; read abstract and method section only.

paper.title: Flow-Map GRPO: Reinforcement Learning for Few-Step Flow-Map Generators via Anchored Stochastic Composition
paper.abstract: Few-step flow-map generators, such as consistency models and MeanFlow, accelerate sampling by directly learning long-range transport maps between noise and data. However, these models are typically deterministic, which makes them difficult to optimize with reinforcement learning (RL) post-training methods that require stochastic trajectories and well-defined likelihood ratios. Existing SDE-based stochasticization techniques are designed for velocity-based samplers with infinitesimal or finely di

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但并不小的问题：如何对“确定性的 few-step flow-map 生成器”做 RL 后训练。像 consistency model、MeanFlow 这类模型把长程传输直接学成少步映射，采样很快，但也因此没有天然的随机轨迹和可计算的 transition likelihood ratio。现有 DDPO、Flow-GRPO 一类方法依赖随机转移核来做策略梯度，而针对 velocity-based sampler 的 SDE stochasticization 又不适合直接套到长程 flow map 上。作者要补的，就是 deterministic flow-map generator 与 likelihood-ratio RL 之间的结构性缺口。
summary.importance: 它和文本 LLM 预训练的直接关系不强，但对“非 AR 生成范式如何做 post-training 对齐”有方法层面的参考价值。原因有两点。第一，很多新型生成模型为了推理效率会把连续过程压缩成少步甚至一步，这通常会牺牲可探索性和可优化性；这篇给出了一种不改预训练参数化、事后给 deterministic map 加上随机策略语义的办法。第二，当前基座研究越来越关心 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口，这篇正好讨论了一个典型接口问题：预训练学到的是确定性 transport map，但后训练需要 stochastic policy。它的意义不在图像奖励优化本身，而在于说明“如何在不破坏原有概率路径的前提下，为少步生成器构造 RL 友好的转移机制”。
summary.technical_approach:
核心技术是 Anchored Stochastic Flow Map Composition，简称 ASFMC。作者先指出一个负面结论：对 velocity field 或细粒度 ODE discretization，可以用 path-preserving SDE 把确定性过程改写成随机过程；但对 long-range flow map，目标时刻的随机转移一般依赖整条中间随机路径，不能简单写成“以 deterministic flow-map 输出为均值的高斯扰动”。如果硬做精确 SDE stochasticization，就得重新进行随机积分，few-step 的计算优势会消失。

ASFMC 的思路是绕开“直接随机化长程 map”这件事，改为借助 anchor time τ 构造一个保持边缘分布的随机复合转移。给定从 t 到 r 的确定性映射，先用 pretrained flow map 把样本送到 r；再把这个确定性终点 transport 到某个 anchor time τ；然后利用概率路径上的条件转移，从 anchor 随机采样回 r。这样得到的 t→r 转移不再是单点确定映射，而是一个随机核，同时又保持原模型学到的 marginal probability path。作者把这个构造分别实例化到两类 few-step flow-map 模型：单时间端点映射，如 sCM；以及双时间映射，如 MeanFlow。对后者还区分 local anchor 和 endpoint anchor 的实现。

有了 ASFMC，每一步采样都可以看成 MDP 中的随机 policy transition，于是就能套用 GRPO 风格的 likelihood-ratio 优化。论文强调这是 post-hoc stochasticization：不需要改 pretrained flow-map parameterization，也不要求回到多步 ODE/SDE 采样。这个点很关键，因为如果为了 RL 又把 few-step 模型退回细粒度采样，方法就失去意义了。
summary.experiments:
实验对象是 few-step 的 FLUX-based text-to-image generator，比较对象包括 pretrained MeanFlow 和 sCM checkpoint，以及相应的 RL 后训练变体。作者声称在 reward-based、perceptual 和 task-level 指标上都有提升，说明 ASFMC 不只是让 RL 在数学上可写，而是在实际图像生成质量和奖励对齐上带来收益。

从引言能确认的实验重点有三类。第一，验证 Flow-Map GRPO 相比直接使用 pretrained checkpoint 是否能提升奖励目标。第二，比较不同 stochasticization 设计，证明 ASFMC 比简单噪声注入或不合适的 SDE 近似更稳定、更保留原始概率路径。第三，分别在 sCM 和 MeanFlow 两类参数化上做统一实验，说明方法不是绑死在单一 flow-map 形式上。

当前给到的全文片段没有结果表和具体数值，因此不能可靠写出如采样步数、奖励提升百分比、FID 或偏好分数等精确数字。精读时建议重点核对：few-step 具体是 1-step、2-step 还是 4-step；ASFMC 在不同 anchor 选择下的方差与性能差异；RL 后训练是否明显损伤 base model 的感知质量；以及 likelihood ratio 的估计是否稳定。如果这些实验做得扎实，这篇的价值就在于把“few-step deterministic generator 也能做 principled RL”这件事讲清楚。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题去读。先看 3.1 左右作者对“为什么 SDE-based stochasticization 不适用于 long-range flow map”的论证，这是全文立论基础。如果这个负面结论不成立，ASFMC 的必要性会下降。

然后看 ASFMC 的构造细节。重点理解 anchor time τ 的作用：它不是随便插一个中间变量，而是用来把 deterministic endpoint 与概率路径上的条件随机采样连接起来，从而得到 path-preserving 的随机转移。这里最好结合公式推一遍，确认边缘分布保持的条件。

再看 MeanFlow 和 sCM 两种实例化。很多论文的方法写得统一，真正实现时却只对一种参数化自然；这篇是否真的统一，要看两类模型下 transition kernel 和 likelihood ratio 的写法是否都干净。

最后看实验部分的 ablation，尤其是 anchor 选择、采样步数、奖励提升与图像质量的权衡。若只是想判断是否值得继续跟，30 分钟左右够用；若你关心 diffusion/flow 生成模型的 RL post-training，这篇值得把方法推导和实验细节都看完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific but important mismatch: how to apply RL post-training to deterministic few-step flow-map generators. Models such as consistency models and MeanFlow learn long-range transport maps directly, which makes sampling fast, but they do not naturally provide stochastic trajectories or transition likelihood ratios. Existing RL methods for generative models, including DDPO-style and Flow-GRPO-style approaches, rely on stochastic transitions for exploration and policy-gradient estimation. SDE-based stochasticization works for velocity-based samplers with fine-grained dynamics, but it does not transfer cleanly to long-range deterministic flow maps. The paper fills that gap.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to text LLM pretraining is limited, but the methodological lesson is broader: efficient non-AR generators often become harder to align because the very compression that reduces sampling steps also removes the stochastic structure needed by RL. This work shows one way to recover an RL-compatible policy view without changing the pretrained parameterization. That matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The pretrained object is a deterministic transport map; the post-training objective needs a stochastic policy. The contribution is a principled bridge between the two while preserving the learned probability path.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key idea is Anchored Stochastic Flow Map Composition, or ASFMC. The paper first makes a negative point: for velocity fields or finely discretized ODE samplers, one can introduce stochasticity through a path-preserving SDE reformulation. For long-range flow maps, however, the stochastic transition from source time t to target time r generally depends on the entire intermediate stochastic path. It cannot, in general, be reduced to a simple Gaussian perturbation around the deterministic flow-map output. Exact SDE stochasticization would therefore require stochastic integration and would largely destroy the efficiency advantage of few-step generators.

ASFMC avoids direct stochasticization of the long-range map. Instead, it introduces an anchor time τ and constructs a stochastic transition by composition. Starting from a deterministic transition t to r, the method first maps the sample to the deterministic endpoint at time r using the pretrained flow map. It then transports that endpoint to an anchor time τ and resamples back to time r through a conditional transition defined on the probability path. This yields a stochastic kernel for the t to r step while preserving the marginal path learned by the original model.

The framework is instantiated for both major few-step flow-map parameterizations: single-time endpoint maps such as sCM, and two-time maps such as MeanFlow. For the latter, the paper discusses local and endpoint anchors. Once ASFMC is in place, each sampling step becomes a stochastic policy transition, so the few-step generator can be cast as an MDP and optimized with GRPO-style likelihood ratios. A major practical point is that this is post hoc: the pretrained flow-map parameterization is kept intact, and the method does not fall back to expensive fine-step ODE or SDE sampling.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are conducted on few-step FLUX-based text-to-image generators, with pretrained MeanFlow and sCM checkpoints as the starting point. The paper reports improvements after RL post-training on reward-based, perceptual, and task-level metrics. That suggests ASFMC is not only a formal device for making the RL objective well-defined, but also useful in practice for aligning image generators to downstream rewards.

From the available text, the experimental agenda appears to have three parts. First, show that Flow-Map GRPO improves over the pretrained checkpoints under reward optimization. Second, compare ASFMC against simpler stochasticization baselines or unsuitable SDE approximations to demonstrate better stability and better preservation of the original probability path. Third, validate the method on both sCM and MeanFlow to support the claim of parameterization-agnostic applicability.

The provided excerpt does not include the full tables, so I cannot safely state exact step counts, reward gains, FID changes, or preference improvements. When reading the paper, the numbers to verify are: how many sampling steps are used, how anchor choice affects variance and performance, whether RL post-training degrades perceptual quality, and how stable the likelihood-ratio estimates are. Those details determine whether the method is mainly elegant on paper or genuinely practical.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one with a narrow focus. Start with the section that argues why SDE-based stochasticization does not directly apply to long-range flow maps. That negative result is the foundation of the paper. If that argument is weak, the motivation for ASFMC becomes much less compelling.

Then study the ASFMC construction carefully. The role of the anchor time τ is the conceptual center: it is not just an auxiliary variable, but the mechanism that connects a deterministic endpoint map to a path-preserving stochastic conditional transition. It is worth checking the derivation to see exactly why the marginal probability path is preserved.

Next, compare the two instantiations for sCM and MeanFlow. Many papers claim a unified framework but become awkward when moved across parameterizations. Here, the important question is whether the transition kernel and likelihood-ratio formulation remain clean in both cases.

Finally, inspect the ablations on anchor choice, number of steps, reward improvement, and image-quality trade-offs. For triage, about 30 minutes is enough. If you work on diffusion or flow-model post-training, the method derivation and experimental details are worth a full read.

recommendation.zh: 做扩散/流匹配LM后训练的建议读§3方法部分，其锚定随机化思路可直接迁移到文本非AR生成场景。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on post-training for diffusion/flow matching LM should read §3 methods; the anchored stochasticization approach transfers directly to text non-autoregressive generation.

paper.title: Active-GRPO: Adaptive Imitation and Self-Improving Reasoning for Molecular Optimization
paper.abstract: Scientific reasoning is an increasingly important capability of large language models, yet improving the robustness and efficiency of training such reasoning remains a key open challenge. We study this problem in instruction-based molecular optimization, where answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses multi-step reasoning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) suffers from sparse feedback. Reference-guided Policy Optimization mitigates both by anchoring policy updates

summary.core_problem: 在分子优化指令任务中，answer-only SFT 会压缩推理过程，RLVR 又受稀疏奖励限制；论文试图让模型在模仿参考答案和强化自身发现之间自适应切换。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练算法改进，尤其针对 reference-guided RL 的参考质量瓶颈；由于任务是分子优化，外推到通用推理训练需要谨慎。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 active reasoning，并实例化为 Active-GRPO。核心思想是在每个样本上动态决定何时模仿数据集 reference、何时强化模型自己探索到的更好解，同时持续更新可被模仿的 reference，避免低质量参考把策略上限锁死。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 和提升幅度；应重点检查是否只在分子优化指标上有效，是否比较 answer-only SFT、标准 GRPO、reference-guided policy optimization，以及是否报告 reference 质量分层结果。
summary.authors_note: Rick Stevens 是 Argonne National Laboratory 与 University of Chicago 相关的高性能计算和科学 AI 研究者；Le Cong 团队长期做 AI for science 和生物分子建模。

summary_en.core_problem: For instruction-based molecular optimization, answer-only SFT collapses reasoning while RLVR suffers from sparse rewards; the paper aims to adaptively choose between imitating references and reinforcing the model's own discoveries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training algorithm, especially around the reference-quality bottleneck in reference-guided RL. Because the setting is molecular optimization, generalization to broad reasoning training should be treated cautiously.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes active reasoning and instantiates it as Active-GRPO. The policy decides per instance when to imitate a dataset reference and when to reinforce its own discovered solutions, while continuously upgrading the references it imitates to avoid being capped by weak references.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The key checks are comparisons against answer-only SFT, standard GRPO, reference-guided policy optimization, and analyses stratified by reference quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Rick Stevens is associated with Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Chicago in HPC and scientific AI. Le Cong's group is known for AI-for-science and biomolecular modeling work.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法和 reference-quality ablation；分子任务太窄，但“何时模仿、何时探索”是 RLVR 数据质量问题的好切口。
recommendation.en: Read only the algorithm and reference-quality ablations; the molecular setting is narrow, but the imitate-versus-explore switch is a useful RLVR data-quality lens.

paper.title: Learning User-Aware Recall: Personalized Retrieval in Long-Term Conversational Memory

Existing memory-augmented LLM agents have made progress in building compact memory banks, yet retrieval is still often driven by query-centered similarity or fixed ranking rules, leaving user-conditioned relevance underexplored.To address this gap, we propose Profile-guided Personalized Retrieval Optimization (PPRO), a retrieval-centric fra

summary.core_problem: 长期对话Agent的记忆检索多以查询为中心，未充分考虑用户个性化条件，导致召回记忆与用户需求匹配度不足
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出个性化检索优化框架，首次将用户画像作为显式先验引入记忆排序，并结合RL优化查询重写
summary.technical_approach: 提出PPRO框架，从对话历史构建情景与语义记忆库，累积生成用户画像作为排序先验；采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练查询重写器，联合优化检索质量与下游回答质量
summary.experiments: 未明确给出模型参数量与训练数据规模，对比基线为传统查询相似度检索、固定排序规则的记忆增强Agent，核心指标为记忆召回准确率与回答质量
summary.authors_note: 百度公司与昆士兰大学联合团队，无公开知名核心作者

summary_en.core_problem: Memory retrieval in long-term conversational agents is mostly query-centric, failing to account for user-specific personalized conditions, leading to low matching between recalled memories and user needs
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a personalized retrieval optimization framework that explicitly injects user profiles as ranking priors and combines RL for query rewriting optimization
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PPRO framework, builds episodic and semantic memory banks from dialogue histories, accumulates user profiles as explicit ranking priors; trains a query rewriter via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize retrieval quality and downstream answer quality
summary_en.experiments: No explicit model parameter count or training dataset size reported; baselines include traditional query-similarity retrieval and fixed-rule memory-augmented agents, with core metrics of memory recall accuracy and answer quality
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Baidu Inc and The University of Queensland, no publicly well-known core authors identified

recommendation.zh: 属于Agent侧记忆检索的增量改进，GRPO训练查询重写的思路可参考，无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on agent-side memory retrieval; the GRPO-based query rewriting idea is worth noting, no need for deep reading

paper.title: Predictable GRPO: A Closed-Form Model of Training Dynamics
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, yet its training dynamics are still described empirically: reward trajectories are fit with low-parameter functional forms whose constants carry no mechanistic meaning, and hyperparameter choices remain a matter of trial and error.  We develop a first-principles reduced-order model of these dynamics. The reduction has three consequences. First, it subsumes the empiri

summary.core_problem: Predictable GRPO 解决的是 GRPO 训练动态缺少可解释模型的问题。现有做法通常把 reward curve 拟合成简单指数曲线，但拟合常数没有机制含义，学习率、momentum、group size、reference refresh interval 等超参仍主要靠试错。论文试图从 GRPO 更新式出发，把奖励增长、饱和、波动和不稳定阈值统一到一个闭式动力学模型里。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究员的价值在于，它把 RL post-training 从经验曲线拟合推进到可测量、可诊断的训练动力学分析。它不是提出一个新的 RL 算法，而是给 GRPO recipe 提供一个 reduced-order model。对大模型训练很实用的点有三类：第一，group size 对确定性 reward trajectory 的影响和对噪声方差的影响被分开；第二，refresh lag、momentum、learning rate 的稳定性作用被写成可检验条件；第三，reward curve 之外的诊断可以区分 mean-field 假设失效、advantage degeneracy、policy concentration 和真实动力学不稳定。这些结论对大规模 RL compute 规划、超参扫参和训练中断诊断有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线是从 GRPO 的离散更新式出发，在一个 mean-field 假设下，把策略状态压缩为期望奖励 p(theta)=E[R]。该假设要求高维参数更新在主导方向上可以用 p 的一维 drift g(p) 描述，并且 g(p) 有稳定不动点。随后用 backward-error analysis 对离散优化过程做二阶截断，得到一个带随机驱动的阻尼振子方程。模型中的 effective mass、damping、stiffness 不是自由拟合参数，而由优化器超参和一个可测曲率尺度闭式决定。论文给出的机制解释很清楚：momentum 把一阶梯度流提升成带惯性的二阶系统；off-policy lag 或 reference refresh interval 会引入惯性，同时侵蚀阻尼；group size 主要进入噪声温度，而不改变确定性轨迹；曲率决定回到固定点的刚度。已有经验中的单指数 reward saturation law 被解释为该动力学的过阻尼极限。保留惯性项后，模型可以表达早期 slow-start inflection，这是单指数形式覆盖不了的部分。论文还给出几个可检验预测，包括确定性轨迹对 group size 近似不变、稳态波动随 1/G 缩放、以及由学习率、曲率、refresh interval、momentum 共同决定的稳定性阈值。
summary.experiments: 实验分两层。第一层是在真实 GRPO 训练上验证 reward trajectory。论文报告在三个模型、两个 group size 的设置下，三阶段动力学曲线对 training reward 的拟合达到 R² ≥ 0.91。group-size invariance 的预测也在 mean trajectory 上成立，并进一步在八个 out-of-distribution benchmark 的迁移表现上得到支持：增大 group size 主要降低波动，而不是系统性改变平均训练路径。第二层是 controlled exact-reduction setting。由于 GSM8K 真实训练主要处于过阻尼区，难以直接观察振荡和稳定性边界，作者构造 softmax-bandit reduction，使 mean-field 假设精确成立。在这个环境中，模型复现了从过阻尼到振荡的转变，并用独立测得的 stiffness 定位 refresh-interval stability threshold。这个验证强度比单纯拟合 reward curve 更高，但也留下限制：深度网络中对振荡阈值和不稳定边界的直接验证仍未完成。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Formalism，确认 GRPO 更新、momentum、KL anchoring、sampling policy refresh 的符号定义。然后重点读 Assumption 1，因为所有闭式推导都依赖把高维策略状态压缩到 expected reward p。Theorem 7 是核心，给出随机阻尼振子形式以及 mass、damping、stiffness 的来源。Lemma 4 到 Lemma 6 分别对应 momentum、off-policy lag、group size 的作用，适合和实际训练超参逐项对照。Corollary 13 和 Proposition 14 解释经验 saturation law 与 slow-start inflection，是理解 reward curve 形状的关键。Proposition 9 和 Proposition 10 对应稳定性阈值和 group-size scaling，适合直接转化为实验设计。实验部分优先看 reward fit、group-size sweep、OOD benchmark transfer 和 Section 5.6 的 softmax-bandit exact reduction。深挖时应关注两个问题：曲率尺度如何独立测量；mean-field 假设在复杂推理任务、混合难度数据和 policy concentration 阶段何时失效。

summary_en.core_problem: Predictable GRPO studies why GRPO training curves remain mostly empirical. Current practice often fits reward trajectories with simple exponential laws, but the fitted constants do not explain how learning rate, momentum, group size, KL anchoring, and refresh interval shape reward growth, saturation, variance, and instability. The paper derives a closed-form reduced-order model directly from the GRPO update.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a mechanistic view of RL post-training dynamics. The paper does not introduce a new optimizer; it turns GRPO training into a measurable dynamical system. This is useful for large-scale LLM training because it separates deterministic reward progress from sampling noise, explains why larger group size may reduce fluctuations without changing the mean trajectory, and gives stability predictions tied to optimizer settings and a measured curvature scale. It also provides diagnostics beyond the reward curve, helping distinguish mean-field breakdown, advantage degeneracy, policy concentration, and true dynamical instability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The derivation starts from the GRPO update with group-relative advantages, KL anchoring to a reference policy, momentum, and periodic refresh of the sampling policy. Under a mean-field assumption, the high-dimensional policy state is summarized by the expected reward p(theta)=E[R], whose evolution is governed by a one-dimensional drift g(p) with a stable fixed point. A second-order backward-error expansion of the discrete update then yields a stochastically forced damped oscillator. The effective mass, damping, and stiffness are given in closed form from optimizer hyperparameters plus one measured curvature scale. Momentum supplies inertia. Off-policy lag from delayed refresh adds inertia while reducing damping. Group size enters as a noise temperature rather than as a determinant of the mean trajectory. The familiar single-exponential reward saturation law appears as the overdamped limit of this oscillator. Keeping the inertial term explains an early slow-start inflection that a single exponential cannot represent.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical validation has two parts. On real GRPO runs, across three models and two group sizes, the proposed three-phase law fits training reward with R² ≥ 0.91. The predicted group-size invariance is observed both in the mean reward trajectory and in transfer to eight out-of-distribution benchmarks: changing group size mainly affects fluctuation scale, not the deterministic path. For stability and oscillation predictions, the paper uses a controlled softmax-bandit reduction where the mean-field assumption holds exactly. This setting reproduces the overdamped-to-oscillatory transition and locates the refresh-interval threshold using an independently measured stiffness. The limitation is explicit: the deep-network GSM8K runs are overdamped, so a direct large-model demonstration of the oscillatory transition is left for future work.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the formal GRPO setup to track the roles of momentum, KL anchoring, group sampling, and policy refresh. Then focus on the mean-field assumption, because it is the main modeling compression. Theorem 7 is the central result: it maps GRPO to a forced damped oscillator with closed-form coefficients. Lemmas 4–6 are the most useful for practitioners, since they isolate the effects of momentum, off-policy lag, and group size. Corollary 13 and Proposition 14 explain how the empirical exponential saturation law emerges and why an inertial model captures slow-start behavior. Proposition 9 and Proposition 10 are the most actionable predictions for hyperparameter sweeps. In the experiments, prioritize the reward-curve fits, the group-size comparison, the OOD transfer results, and the softmax-bandit exact reduction in Section 5.6. The main points to audit are how the curvature scale is measured and when the one-dimensional reward-state approximation breaks down.

recommendation.zh: 首次给出GRPO训练动态的闭式机制模型，直接可用于RL阶段的超参数调优和计算分配，应立刻在内部RL消融中验证group size不变性结论
recommendation.en: First closed-form mechanistic model for GRPO training dynamics, directly applicable for RL-stage hyperparameter tuning and compute allocation; immediately validate the group-size invariance conclusion in internal RL ablations

paper.title: ReGRPO: Reflection-Augmented Policy Optimization for Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can solve multimodal, multi-step tasks by calling external tools, yet they remain fragile in practice. Existing works have two common gaps. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is built mostly on successful trajectories and offers little signal for recovery after tool failures, while sparse trajectory-level RL rewards provide limited guidance on which step failed and how to repair it. We introduce ReGRPO (Reflection-augmented Group Relative Policy Optimizatio

summary.core_problem: 现有工具型VLM Agent的训练方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是SFT主要依赖成功轨迹，几乎没有工具失败后的恢复信号，小错误容易级联放大；二是传统RL的稀疏轨迹级奖励无法定位错误步骤，也不能给出修复方向，导致长程任务学习慢、不稳定。
summary.importance: 将“反思-纠错”从测试时的提示技巧转化为可学习的结构化训练信号，为工具型Agent的后训练（尤其是RL阶段）提供了更密集的步骤级监督；结构化反思数据的构造思路，也可迁移到基座模型的推理增强预训练中，例如在预训练语料中引入错误-反思-修正序列以提升通用鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: ReGRPO框架包含三个核心组件：1. 结构化反思数据引擎：对MAT-AGENT的成功轨迹做动作扰动，执行扰动后的动作得到真实的工具失败观察结果，构造包含（错误类型ErrorType、证据Evidence、修复计划FixPlan）的Reflection-of-Thought（RoT）三元组，并搭配对应的修正后动作；2. 训练优化流程：沿用标准GRPO优化器，将反思token与修正token纳入同一条局部轨迹的优化目标，联合优化反思生成与后续纠错动作，提供超越最终成败信号的步骤级监督；3. 推理策略：采用零外部验证器的单路径执行方案，仅当工具调用失败时触发固定的反思-纠错逻辑块，兼顾错误恢复能力与部署效率。
summary.experiments: 在GTA和GAIA两个通用工具型Agent基准上，与MAT-AGENT（基于成功轨迹的SFT训练）、SPORT（基于自探索的偏好学习）使用完全相同的骨干模型与工具集时，ReGRPO的整体准确率持续优于对比方法；全文提供的章节未披露具体性能提升幅度与详细消融实验结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读Introduction部分，理解现有SFT与RL方法在工具型Agent训练中的两个核心缺陷（动机核心）；再重点阅读Method部分的结构化反思数据引擎构造流程、以及将反思信号嵌入GRPO训练的联合优化目标；最后了解推理阶段的零验证器触发设计。预计阅读时间15-25分钟，无需深究GRPO优化器的底层细节，重点关注反思信号的结构化定义与训练集成方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Two critical gaps limit the robustness of tool-using VLM agents: 1) Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies almost exclusively on successful trajectories, providing no recovery signal after tool failures, so minor errors cascade without correction guidance; 2) Standard sparse trajectory-level RL rewards cannot localize faulty steps or indicate repair directions, leading to slow, unstable learning in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: Converts reflection-correction from a test-time prompting heuristic into a learnable, structured training signal, providing denser step-level supervision for the post-training (especially the RL phase) of tool-using agents. The structured reflective data construction pipeline can also transfer to reasoning-augmented pretraining for base models, for example by introducing error-reflection-correction sequences into pretraining corpora to improve general robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReGRPO includes three core components: 1) A Structured Reflective Data Engine: Perturbs successful MAT-AGENT trajectories, executes the perturbed actions to collect real tool-failure observations, then builds grounded Reflection-of-Thought (RoT) triplets (ErrorType, Evidence, FixPlan) paired with corrected actions; 2) Training optimization: Uses the standard GRPO optimizer, but incorporates reflection tokens and correction tokens into the same local trajectory objective, enabling joint optimization of reflection generation and downstream corrective actions, thus providing step-level supervision beyond final success/failure signals; 3) Inference strategy: A verifier-free, single-path execution setup, where a fixed reflection-correction block is triggered only when a tool call fails, balancing error recovery capability and deployment efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: On the GTA and GAIA general tool-agent benchmarks, ReGRPO consistently outperforms MAT-AGENT (SFT trained on successful trajectories) and SPORT (self-exploration-based preference learning) when paired with the same backbone model and tool suite. The provided manuscript sections do not include exact improvement margins or detailed ablation results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to understand the two core limitations of existing SFT and RL pipelines for tool agents. Then focus on the Method section, especially the construction flow of the Structured Reflective Data Engine and the joint optimization objective that integrates reflection signals. Finally review the verifier-free inference trigger design. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes. No need to dive into underlying GRPO details, as the work uses the standard GRPO optimizer without modification.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据引擎和局部 advantage 设计；它像 Agent 版过程监督，结论取决于 near-miss 采样是否干净。
recommendation.en: Read the data engine and local-advantage design; it is process supervision for agents, but the result hinges on clean near-miss sampling.

paper.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework t

summary.core_problem: TRIAGE 处理的是 agentic RL 里的 credit assignment：最终 verifier 只告诉一条轨迹成败，但 GRPO 会把同一个 outcome advantage 均匀分给所有动作 token 或动作片段。这会压制失败轨迹中的有效探索，也会奖励成功轨迹中的冗余动作或退步动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改预训练目标，但对 LLM post-train 的训练信号质量有启发。它把 agent 轨迹中的环境交互动作当作基本决策单元，而不是普通 token span。这个视角对工具调用、搜索、代码编辑、网页导航类 RL 很关键：训练信号不能只按最终结果分配，还要区分动作在局部过程中的角色。贡献更偏方法设计和诊断框架，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是给每个 environment-facing segment 增加一个语义角色轴。TRIAGE 用结构化 LLM judge 对局部上下文中的动作片段分类，角色包括 decisive progress、useful exploration、no-progress infrastructure、regression。分类器不直接替代 verifier，也不输出自由形式 reward；它只做局部语义诊断。随后用固定的 role-conditioned rule 把角色映射为有界的 segment-level process reward：决定性进展继承较强 outcome-aligned credit，有用探索给有限正向 credit，无进展基础操作压到接近 0，退步动作即使出现在成功轨迹中也被抑制。这样保留 GRPO 的最终 outcome advantage 作为主方向，同时用角色标签修正局部 credit。论文还给出一个理论解释：如果只能观测角色标签，role-conditioned correction 是均方误差意义下的最优片段校正；当固定角色常数与该最优校正对齐时，可以降低 advantage estimation error，并对应更低方差的 policy gradient。
