summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、Search-QA、ALFWorld 这类需要搜索、点击、导航、对象交互的 agentic 任务。对比项包括标准 GRPO、使用同一 judge 和上下文窗口的标量 LLM process-reward baseline，以及 outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline。论文声称 TRIAGE 在这些任务上相对上述基线有稳定收益，并用人工标注片段和角色诊断解释收益来源：失败轨迹中的 useful exploration 不再被全量惩罚，成功轨迹中的 regression 不再被 outcome reward 掩盖。给出的材料没有包含具体提升幅度和完整表格数字，因此不宜外推其规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 到 30 分钟泛读。重点看 Introduction 对 outcome-only credit 两个盲点的定义，以及方法部分中四类 role 的边界。理论部分只需抓住 MSE-optimal correction 和 advantage variance 的直觉，不必深究每一步推导。实验部分优先看与 scalar process reward baseline 的对比，因为这个对比回答的是“角色标签是否比普通 dense reward 多提供信息”。如果关注 agent RL recipe，可进一步看人工标注诊断，判断角色分类是否稳定、是否依赖 judge 偏好。

summary_en.core_problem: TRIAGE addresses credit assignment in agentic RL. A final verifier can judge whether a trajectory succeeds, but vanilla GRPO assigns the same outcome advantage to all action tokens or segments. This penalizes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to RL post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality in tool-use and environment-interaction settings. Its main contribution is to treat environment-facing segments, such as searches, clicks, edits, and object interactions, as the credit-assignment unit. This matters because outcome-only supervision is too coarse for long agent trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRIAGE adds a semantic role axis on top of the outcome axis. A structured LLM judge classifies each local segment into one of four roles: decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression. The judge is used as a role classifier, not as an unconstrained reward model. A fixed role-conditioned rule then maps labels to bounded process rewards or penalties. Decisive progress receives strong outcome-aligned credit; useful exploration receives bounded positive credit; infrastructure is damped toward zero; regression is suppressed even when the trajectory eventually succeeds. The final verifier outcome remains the primary optimization direction under GRPO. The paper also gives a theoretical justification: role-conditioned correction is the MSE-optimal segment correction measurable from role labels alone, and aligned role constants can reduce advantage-estimation error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers WebShop, Search-QA, and ALFWorld. Baselines include standard GRPO, a scalar LLM-derived process-reward baseline using the same judge and context window, and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. TRIAGE is reported to improve consistently over these baselines. Manual segment labels and role diagnostics are used to explain where the gains come from: preserving useful exploration in failed trajectories and suppressing regressive actions inside successful ones. The provided text does not include exact improvement numbers, so the magnitude should be read from the full tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes of outcome-only credit, then inspect the method section for the four-role taxonomy and the fixed role-to-reward mapping. The most informative experimental comparison is against the scalar process-reward baseline, because it tests whether role typing adds information beyond dense reward scoring. The theory section is worth a light pass for the MSE-optimal correction argument, but the practical value depends more on judge reliability and role-label stability.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用分配的关键改进，角色分段奖励的思路可直接复现用于R1-style推理RL训练，重点看§3的规则设计和正确性证明
recommendation.en: Key improvement to GRPO credit assignment; role-based segment reward design is directly reproducible for R1-style reasoning RL training, focus on §3 rule design and correctness proof

paper.title: Consistency as Inductive Bias: Learning Cross-View Invariance for Robust Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Inductive biases steer learning toward generalizable solutions by encoding task structure. In this work, we identify a crucial missing bias in MLLMs: cross-view consistency, \textit{i.e.}, semantically invariant views of the same instance should lead to the same answer. Standard reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) objectives do not impose this constraint, but instead assign pointwise rewards to each visual input. Even with data augmentation (DA), transformed views are typically

summary.core_problem: 解决现有MLLM缺乏跨视图一致性归纳偏置，标准RLVR目标仅对单视图分配点式奖励，导致视图变换后推理结果不一致、鲁棒性差的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将跨视图一致性作为归纳偏置注入多模态RLVR训练流程，复用现有组采样机制实现，无需额外模型结构修改
summary.technical_approach: 提出ConsistRoll方法，将原图像与语义不变的变换视图（如裁剪、旋转、光照调整）放入GRPO的同一生成组，仅当配对生成结果均正确且语义一致时分配联合奖励，迫使模型学习跨视图不变的推理能力
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集、对比基线及定量提升幅度，仅说明方法可将一致性约束转化为RL训练信号

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of cross-view consistency inductive bias in MLLMs, where standard RLVR objectives only assign pointwise rewards to single views, leading to inconsistent reasoning and poor robustness after view transformation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first injects cross-view consistency as an inductive bias into multimodal RLVR training pipelines, implemented via reuse of existing group sampling mechanisms without additional model architecture modifications
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ConsistRoll: places original images and semantically invariant transformed views (e.g., crop, rotation, lighting adjustment) into the same GRPO generation group, assigns joint rewards only when paired completions are both correct and semantically consistent, forcing the model to learn cross-view invariant reasoning
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training datasets, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins; it only states that the method converts consistency constraints into RL training signals

recommendation.zh: 把跨视图一致性做成RLVR的组奖励，思路干净但无范式突破，可参考其组采样复用技巧，不用读全文
recommendation.en: Injects cross-view consistency into RLVR via group reward reuse; clean idea but no paradigm shift, only the group sampling trick is worth noting

paper.title: SEVA: Self-Evolving Verification Agent with Process Reward for Fact Attribution
paper.abstract: Hallucination is the reliability bottleneck for LLM-based agents, and fact attribution verifiers are the last line of defense -- yet today's verifiers emit only opaque binary labels, leaving agents unable to self-correct and operators unable to audit. We present SEVA, a structured verification agent that emits evidence alignments, step-by-step reasoning chains, calibrated confidence, and a six-category error diagnosis with actionable fixes. Training such an agent with RL is non-trivial: standard

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是“可审计的事实归因 verifier 怎么训练”这个问题，而不是单纯再做一个 hallucination 分类器。传统 verifier 只给二分类标签，部署时有两个缺口：一是 agent 无法据此自我修正，因为不知道错在证据对齐、实体替换、数值夸大还是限定词捏造；二是人工也无法审计判断过程。作者进一步指出，若把 verifier 输出扩展成结构化对象——证据对齐、推理链、置信度、错误类型和修复建议——那么常规二值 reward 的 RL 会失效：在 GRPO 的组内，大多数样本都拿 0 分，优势几乎没有方差，梯度接近消失。论文真正解决的是这个训练层面的瓶颈：如何让 RL 能在多组件、部分正确的结构化验证输出上产生稳定学习信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不强，它更接近 post-train 阶段的 verifier / reward design 工作；但它有两个值得注意的启发。第一，论文把“binary outcome reward 不适合复杂结构化生成”讲得比较具体，给出了 advantage collapse 的经验现象和分解式 reward 的修复路径，这对 process supervision、reasoning RL、tool-use verifier、judge model 训练都有参考价值。第二，作者展示了结构化输出不仅是可解释性包装，它会反过来改变训练信号的形状：把一个离散成败问题改造成连续、多维、弱相关的 reward 面，训练动态因此从停滞变成可学。这一点对任何想把 RL 用到长链条、多字段生成任务上的人都有现实意义。贡献量级上，它不是基础范式改写，但在“如何训练可审计 verifier”这个窄而重要的问题上做得比较扎实。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。第一层是 verifier 设计。Seva 输出一个结构化验证结果，包含：证据对齐 span、逐步推理、最终支持/不支持判断、校准置信度、六类错误诊断以及可执行修复建议。这样做不是为了多输出字段，而是为了把 verification 过程拆成可单独评分的子任务。第二层是 RL 训练。作者先用 SFT 做初始化，然后用 GRPO 继续优化，但关键不再使用 binary reward，而是定义了一个 process reward R(v, y)，把结构化输出分解成五个独立组件再加一个 calibration term。文中给出的权重是：格式 0.10、证据对齐 0.30、推理链 0.30、标签 0.15、诊断 0.15，外加一个非对称校准项；预测正确时，高置信度有额外奖励，预测错误时，高置信度只受到较轻惩罚。作者强调两个设计点。其一，各组件从输出的不同区域独立计算，相关性较弱，因此组内 reward 不会塌成单点。其二，reward 故意偏向 process signal，70/30 倾向过程而非最终 outcome，使“推理和对齐做对但标签还错”的样本仍能得到中等分数，而不是和乱码输出一起记 0 分。论文还给出一个自演化闭环：Verify → Reflect → Probe → Refine。模型先暴露自己在哪类错误上薄弱，再针对这些类别生成对抗样本，迭代四轮。这里的重点不是数据合成本身，而是用结构化 verifier 的诊断信号来定向扩充训练分布。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三组。第一组是 RL 是否真的被 process reward“解锁”。作者报告，若直接用 binary reward 跑 GRPO，训练 350 steps 基本不前进；G=8 的组内大多数响应得分为 0，advantage spread 收缩到约 ±0.05。换成分解式 process reward 后，alignment quality 提升到 0.997，格式合规率到 100%，最终 F1 达到 69.0，相比 SFT 提升 4.1 个点，并且接近 GPT-4o-mini 的 69.8。第二组是训练动态。论文观察到一个隐式 curriculum：前约 150 steps 先学会“怎么按结构做验证”，后约 200 steps 才主要改善最终 verification outcome。这说明 reward 分解确实把行为学习和结果优化分开了。第三组是 self-evolution。作者在 7B 模型上迭代四轮，Round 4 数据规模到 7,787 条，约为初始的 4 倍。结果不是单调提升的 generalist，而是每轮更像 benchmark specialist：例如 HaluEval 可提升约 15 个点，但 TruthfulQA 同时下降 10 到 14 个点。作者据此认为，自演化会把模型往当前采样分布最密集的错误模式上推，而不是自然得到更稳健的通用 verifier。这个结论比方法本身更值得记住，因为它对 STaR / Self-Refine 一类迭代改进假设提出了约束。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一，看引言和方法里对 binary reward failure 的描述，重点不是公式，而是为什么结构化输出会让“部分正确”样本在二值奖励下全部坍缩成同一类。第二，看 reward 设计和对应的图表，尤其是 reward landscape、组内方差、训练曲线，理解作者如何把不可学的离散目标改造成可优化的连续目标。第三，看 self-evolution 部分，不要只看平均分，要看不同 benchmark 和错误类别的迁移方向。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以把主线读清。若只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，优先看：方法总览、reward 分解表、训练动态图、四轮自演化结果表。对做 RLHF/RLAIF、judge model、process reward 的读者，这篇的价值主要在训练信号设计，而不是 verifier 任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific but important problem: how to train an auditable fact-attribution verifier, not just how to classify hallucinations. Standard verifiers output a binary label, which is too weak for deployment. An agent cannot self-correct because it does not know whether the failure came from wrong evidence grounding, entity substitution, numeric inflation, or fabricated qualifiers. Human operators cannot audit the decision either. Once the verifier output is expanded into a structured object—evidence alignments, reasoning traces, confidence, error category, and suggested fixes—naive RL breaks. With GRPO and a binary reward, most sampled responses in a group receive the same zero score, so within-group variance collapses and the policy gradient nearly vanishes. The core problem is therefore a training-signal problem: how to make RL work on partially correct, multi-field verification outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training, verifier design, and reward modeling. Still, it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model researchers. First, it makes the failure mode of binary outcome rewards on structured generation concrete. The paper does not just claim that process rewards help; it shows why group-relative RL can stall when the task has many partially correct outputs. That matters for reasoning RL, judge models, tool-use verification, and any setting where outputs have multiple coupled components. Second, it shows that structured outputs are not merely an interpretability layer. They reshape the reward geometry. By turning a one-bit success criterion into a continuous, weakly correlated multi-component score, the optimization problem becomes learnable. The contribution is not a broad paradigm shift, but within the narrower problem of training auditable verifiers, it is technically well-motivated and empirically informative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two layers. The first is the verifier interface itself. Seva produces a structured verification record: evidence-alignment spans, step-by-step reasoning, a final support decision, calibrated confidence, a six-way error diagnosis, and actionable fixes. This is not added verbosity for its own sake; it creates separable subproblems that can be scored independently. The second layer is RL training. The model is first initialized with SFT, then optimized with GRPO. The key change is the reward. Instead of a binary correct/incorrect signal, the paper defines a process reward R(v, y) over the structured output. The reward decomposes quality into five components plus a calibration term. The reported weights are 0.10 for format, 0.30 for evidence alignment, 0.30 for reasoning chain, 0.15 for label correctness, and 0.15 for diagnosis, with an asymmetric calibration bonus/penalty. Correct high-confidence predictions are rewarded more than incorrect high-confidence predictions are penalized. Two design choices matter. First, each component is computed from a different region of the output, so the components are only weakly correlated; this preserves reward variance within a GRPO group. Second, the reward is intentionally process-heavy, roughly 70/30 toward process over final outcome. A response with good grounding and reasoning but a wrong final label can still receive a middling score instead of collapsing to zero together with malformed outputs. The paper also adds a self-evolution loop—Verify, Reflect, Probe, Refine—where the model diagnoses its weak error categories and generates targeted adversarial data for those categories over four rounds.
summary_en.experiments: There are three main empirical takeaways. First, the paper shows that process reward is what makes RL trainable in this setting. With binary reward, GRPO makes essentially no progress over 350 steps; with group size G=8, most responses score zero and the advantage spread shrinks to about ±0.05. With the decomposed reward, alignment quality reaches 0.997, format compliance reaches 100%, and final F1 rises to 69.0, which is +4.1 over SFT and close to GPT-4o-mini at 69.8. Second, the training dynamics reveal an implicit curriculum. The model first learns verification behavior and output structure within roughly the first 150 steps, then spends the remaining ~200 steps improving final verification outcomes. That supports the claim that the reward decomposition separates behavioral competence from end-task correctness. Third, the self-evolution study on the 7B model is more interesting than a standard iterative-improvement story. After four rounds, with Round 4 reaching 7,787 training samples, the model does not become a uniformly better generalist. Instead, each round produces a benchmark specialist: for example, about +15 points on HaluEval can coincide with a 10–14 point drop on TruthfulQA. The authors argue that iterative refinement tracks the induced data distribution rather than yielding monotonic general improvement. That is a useful caution for STaR-style and self-refine pipelines.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim-level read, focus on three parts. First, read the motivation for why binary reward fails on structured verification outputs; the important point is not the formal proposition but the optimization pathology. Second, inspect the reward decomposition and the figures on reward landscape, within-group variance, and training curves. That is where the paper earns its main claim. Third, read the self-evolution section with attention to benchmark-specific trade-offs rather than average gains. A 25–35 minute pass should be enough to extract the main ideas. If time is tight, prioritize the method overview, the reward-component table, the training-dynamics figure, and the four-round self-evolution results. The paper is most useful for readers working on process rewards, RLHF/RLAIF, judge models, or structured generation, less so for readers looking for core pretraining advances.

recommendation.zh: RL对齐的实用方法，重点看§3.2的过程奖励拆分公式与优势崩溃成因分析，可直接复用到多组件输出的RL训练场景。
recommendation.en: Practical method for RL alignment; focus on §3.2 for process reward decomposition and advantage collapse analysis, directly reusable for RL training of multi-component outputs.

paper.title: BV-Blend: Uncertainty-Weighted Historical Baselines for Stable Critic-Free RL with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), avoids training a value function (critic) and reduces memory and compute overhead relative to critic-based PPO pipelines for aligning large language models. However, GRPO-style advantage estimation depends on prompt-local (within-prompt-group) reward statistics and can be unstable. In particular, when all rollouts in a prompt group receive identical rewards, the within-gro

summary.core_problem: 无critic的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR，以GRPO为代表）的优势估计存在不稳定性：冷启动阶段搭配二值验证器时，同一prompt组内所有采样轨迹常获得相同奖励（如全部错误），组内奖励方差趋近于0，基于prompt-local的组归一化会输出近零优势，直接消除该组的学习信号，导致训练停滞。
summary.importance: 属于推理增强对齐管线的轻量实用改进，适配当前主流的GRPO类RL训练流程，无需额外训练价值网络（节省大模型对齐阶段的显存与算力开销），解决了二值可验证任务（数学、代码）中普遍存在的冷启动学习信号坍塌问题，对开展RL对齐、推理增强预训练的工程实践有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BV-Blend框架，仅修改优势估计器、不改动PPO裁剪目标、不引入critic训练：将两类奖励统计量混合计算优势——一是当前prompt组的on-policy局部统计量，二是在语义相似prompt聚类上通过EMA聚合的低方差历史统计量。混合权重为不确定性感知的置信权重，由历史统计量的均值标准误（SEM）代理指标推导：历史统计可靠性低时降权，当前组方差坍塌时则更多依赖历史信号。EMA统计量在参数更新前用于计算权重，更新后用当前batch数据迭代，所有奖励统计量均停止梯度。
summary.experiments: 提供的公开内容未包含完整实验章节，摘要与引言部分披露：在可验证推理基准上，相比标准组归一化的GRPO类方法，训练稳定性与最终性能均有提升；在组内零方差导致标准方法训练停滞的场景下，方法保持鲁棒。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1节后半段的零方差失效模式分析，再重点看第2节中SEM置信权重的推导逻辑、两类统计量的混合公式、EMA的更新时序。若后续补充完整实验，可关注语义聚类粒度、权重校准的消融实验。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Advantage estimation in critic-free Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR, exemplified by GRPO) suffers from instability: under binary verifiers in cold-start regimes, all rollouts in a prompt group often receive identical rewards (e.g. all incorrect), so prompt-local group normalization returns near-zero advantages and eliminates the learning signal for that group, leading to training stalls.
summary_en.importance: A lightweight, practical improvement for mainstream reasoning-enhanced alignment pipelines. It is fully compatible with existing GRPO-style RL workflows, and avoids the memory and compute overhead of training a separate value network. The zero-variance fix addresses a ubiquitous pain point in RL alignment for binary-verifiable tasks (math, code), with direct relevance to engineering practice for RL alignment and reasoning-enhanced pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The BV-Blend framework modifies only the advantage estimator, leaving the PPO clipped objective unchanged and requiring no critic training. It blends two sources of reward statistics to compute advantages: (1) on-policy prompt-local moments from the current group; (2) low-variance historical moments aggregated via EMA over semantically clustered prompts. The blending weight is an uncertainty-aware confidence weight derived from a standard-error-of-the-mean (SEM) proxy of historical statistics: unreliable historical estimates are downweighted, while historical signals are prioritized when local variance collapses. EMA statistics are used to compute weights before parameter updates, and refreshed with the current batch after updates; all reward statistics are detached from the computation graph.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental sections are not included in the provided manuscript excerpt. The abstract and introduction report improved training stability and final performance on verifiable reasoning benchmarks, with retained robustness in regimes where standard group-normalized GRPO stalls due to zero within-group reward variance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the zero-variance failure mode analysis in the second half of Section 1 first, then focus on the SEM confidence weight derivation, blending formula for the two statistic sources, and EMA update schedule in Section 2. If full experimental sections become available, prioritize ablations on semantic clustering granularity and weight calibration. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO落地必看的稳定性改进，重点看§3.2的语义聚类与SEM权重设计，可直接复现到内部RL流水线
recommendation.en: A must-check stability improvement for GRPO deployment; focus on Section 3.2 for semantic clustering and SEM weight design, directly reproducible in internal RL pipelines

paper.title: Process Advantage Signal Shaping: A Paradigm-Agnostic Middleware for Process-Supervised RL in LLM Reasoners
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a default recipe for process-supervised reinforcement learning of LLM reasoners, and dense process supervision -- via learned process reward models (PRMs) or on-policy-distillation KL signals -- is a common way to densify its otherwise weak outcome reward. Layering such a step-level signal on top of GRPO's group-standardized advantage, however, exposes three structural pathologies: \emph{channel contamination} between the pooled process, outcome, and

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为LLM推理器过程监督RL的默认方案，在叠加稠密过程信号（PRM或token级KL蒸馏信号）时，会在优势pipeline的聚合、广播、轨迹求和三个阶段分别出现通道污染、分辨率不匹配、累计偏差三类结构性缺陷。
summary.importance: 揭示了GRPO叠加过程监督时的三类通用结构性缺陷，提出的轻量中间件无需修改GRPO核心组件即可适配不同过程信号范式与组标准化算子，为过程监督RL的稳定落地提供了可复用的改造思路，对RL增强推理的预训练-后训练闭环实践有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PASS范式无关中间件，插在任意标量步级过程信号与GRPO裁剪surrogate之间，通过三条规则对应解决三类缺陷：聚合阶段对过程、结果、格式信号分别做组标准化后再融合（AF），广播阶段按过程信号取值切分chunk并在chunk内共享优势（CV），轨迹求和阶段将累计回报改为平均价值密度（DL），还证明了累计优势GRPO的长度坍缩定理以支撑DL设计。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理（PRM信号）、多跳QA（token级KL蒸馏信号，含普通OPD与G-OPD两种变体）两个领域验证，覆盖两种常用组标准化算子（Masked-Norm、Abs-Max Scaling），所有配置下相对对应GRPO基线均获得一致的pass@1提升，理论部分给出了累计优势GRPO的长度坍缩定理证明。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看第1节后半部分对三类结构性缺陷的拆解，第4节中三条PASS规则的定义与长度坍缩定理，以及实验部分跨领域、跨信号范式、跨组标准化算子的增益一致性结果。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When dense process supervision signals (e.g., learned PRMs, token-level KL distillation signals) are added to the group-standardized advantage of GRPO — the default process-supervised RL recipe for LLM reasoners — three structural flaws arise across the aggregation, broadcast, and trajectory-summation stages of the GRPO advantage pipeline: channel contamination, resolution mismatch, and cumulative bias.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three general structural flaws in GRPO-based process supervision, and proposes a lightweight middleware that adapts to different process signal paradigms and group-standardization operators without modifying GRPO's core components, providing reusable practical guidance for stable process-supervised RL in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop for reasoning enhancement.
summary_en.technical_approach: PASS is a paradigm-agnostic middleware inserted between any scalar step-level process signal and GRPO's clipped surrogate, with three rules targeting the three flaws: Advantage Fusion (AF) for separate group-standardization of process/outcome/format signals before fusion, Chunk-by-Value (CV) for trajectory segmentation by process signal values with uniform advantage within chunks, and Divide-Length (DL) for converting cumulative return to average value density. A length-collapse theorem for cumulative-advantage GRPO is proven to justify the DL design.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across two domains: mathematical reasoning with PRM signals, and multi-hop QA with token-level KL distillation signals (vanilla OPD and generalized G-OPD), covering two common group-standardization operators (Masked-Norm, Abs-Max Scaling). Consistent pass@1 improvements over corresponding GRPO baselines are observed across all configurations, with a theoretical proof of the length-collapse theorem for cumulative-advantage GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the latter half of Section 1 for the breakdown of three structural flaws, Section 4 for the definition of three PASS rules and the length-collapse theorem, and the cross-domain/cross-operator consistency of experimental gains. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看信号分解部分；它把 GRPO+过程奖励的几个常见坑说清了，适合放进内部 RLVR ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the signal decomposition parts; it cleanly names several GRPO-plus-process-reward failure modes worth reproducing in internal RLVR ablations.

paper.title: CRAFT: Counterfactual Credit Assignment from Free Sibling Rollouts for Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Self-distilled agentic reinforcement learning augments trajectory-level reward with a token-level distillation loss, using as its teacher the same policy conditioned on privileged context. The prevailing recipe gates this loss by a single scalar, the teacher-student log-probability gap. This signal is doubly limited: it is retrospective, scoring only the realised rollout and never the counterfactual ones, and it is sign-blind, never signalling when a teacher-preferred action would have harmed th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 self-distilled agentic RL 里的 token-level credit assignment 过于粗糙的问题。现有 SDAR 做法把“同一个策略在 privileged context 下的 teacher 分布”和普通 student 分布之间的 log-prob gap Δt，当成一个单标量门控信号去加权蒸馏损失。但这个信号有两个结构性缺陷：第一，它只看已经发生的 rollout，是 retrospective 的，无法回答“如果在第 t 步跟随 teacher 偏好的动作，后续回报会更好还是更差”；第二，它是 sign-blind 的，即便 teacher 偏好的动作其实会伤害整条轨迹，loss 也不会明确告诉模型要远离它。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不额外大幅增加采样成本的前提下，把 sequence-level reward、teacher-student gap 和 token-level counterfactual effect 结合起来，得到更合理的逐 token 信用分配。
summary.importance: 虽然论文场景是 agentic RL，不是传统预训练，但它对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因在于：当前很多 reasoning / tool-use 模型的能力提升越来越依赖 RL 或 self-improvement，而这些方法最终都受限于训练信号的颗粒度和质量。CRAFT 的贡献不是再换一个 PPO 变体，而是把“teacher 更偏好某 token”与“这个偏好是否真的提升最终回报”区分开来。这个区分对任何把 token-level imitation 和 trajectory-level reward 混合训练的系统都重要，包括 reasoning RL、verifier-guided distillation、甚至某些 continual post-training 设定。贡献量级属于较扎实的算法改进：它没有改环境，也没有依赖更强 teacher，而是重新设计 credit signal，并且强调与现有 GRPO 采样预算兼容。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名 CRAFT，包含三个支柱。第一支柱是 Counterfactual Token Importance, CTI。作者观察到 GRPO 本来就会对同一 prompt 采样 G 条 sibling rollouts，这些 rollout 可以被视为近似的 counterfactual 样本。于是他们用 teacher-student gap Δt 对 sibling rollouts 做 importance weighting，估计“如果在第 t 个 token 处更接近 teacher 的选择，group-level advantage 会如何变化”。得到的 per-token credit ct 是有符号的，范围在 (-1,1)，因此既能表达“应当更像 teacher”，也能表达“teacher 在这里会带偏”。文中给出一致性和方差界的命题，说明这个估计器在 G 增大时是可收敛的，且额外代价主要只是 group-wise softmax。第二支柱是双变量控制器。不同于只调一个 KL 系数，CRAFT 同时调节 CTI loss 权重 λ(t) 和 reference-KL 权重 μ(t)，并让两者沿 gate-active EMA 反向变化。直觉上，当 token-level credit 信号活跃且可信时，可以更依赖 CTI；当其不稳定时，则用 reference KL 稳住策略更新。作者还分析了固定点性质。第三支柱是 signed per-token KL penalty。KL 的方向不再固定为单向模仿 teacher，而是由 sign(ct) 决定：当 ct 为正时，采用更 mode-seeking 的方向去靠近 teacher；当 ct 为负时，采用相反方向，避免把有害 teacher 偏好蒸馏进 student。作者强调这与 credit sign 在结构上是一致的，并给出其作为有效 policy-gradient surrogate 的论证。另一个工程上很重要的点是 bit-exact reproducibility：把所有开关关掉后，loss 和 gradient 与 baseline 字节级一致，这样实验增益可以更干净地归因于算法变化，而不是实现漂移。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 agentic environment、四个模型规模、四个 baseline，并包含 OOD 评测和多组消融。给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但能确认几类关键结果。第一，CRAFT 相比单门控 SDAR baseline 在多环境上更稳，说明 signed counterfactual credit 比单纯 Δt 门控更有效。第二，作者设置了一个更强的 Adaptive-CRINGE 对照，它共享第二支柱的控制器，用来隔离“收益到底来自动态系数调节，还是来自 CTI + signed KL 本身”。这类对照设计是合理的，因为它避免把所有改动打包在一起。第三，消融是按三根支柱独立开关做的，便于判断每一部分的边际贡献。第四，论文还强调 OOD evaluation，说明方法不是只在训练分布内靠更强 imitation 获益，而是希望改善真正的决策 credit assignment。由于当前提供的全文片段没有精确数值、模型参数量和环境名称，不能编造具体提升幅度；但从实验组织方式看，作者很重视把“counterfactual credit”与“普通蒸馏门控”严格区分开，并证明收益不是来自额外采样或实现细节。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合按“问题拆解—估计器—控制器—对照实验”四步来读。先看 Introduction，抓住作者对 baseline 的两点批评：retrospective 和 sign-blind。然后直接读 Section 3.1 的 CTI 推导，这是整篇最关键的部分，重点看 sibling rollout 如何被重用为 counterfactual estimator，importance weighting 的形式是什么，命题里的一致性和 O(1/G) 方差界依赖哪些假设。接着看双变量控制器和 signed KL，理解为什么作者没有简单采用 unlikelihood 或 CRINGE，而是让 KL 方向跟着 credit sign 走。实验部分优先看与 SDAR、RLSD、Adaptive-CRINGE 的对比，以及三支柱消融。若时间有限，读完方法主节、理论命题和主结果表，大约 40 分钟能把核心吃透。值得深挖的点有三个：其一，CTI 对 sibling rollout 质量和组内多样性的依赖有多强；其二，importance weighting 在长轨迹上是否会带来高方差或偏差累积；其三，这套 signed token credit 能否迁移到 reasoning RL、verifier-guided SFT 或 offline preference optimization 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in self-distilled agentic RL: token-level credit assignment is too crude. In the standard SDAR recipe, the teacher is the same policy evaluated under privileged context, and the teacher–student log-probability gap Δ_t is used as a single scalar gate on a distillation loss. The authors argue that this signal is structurally inadequate for two reasons. First, it is retrospective: it only scores the realized rollout and says nothing about what would have happened if the policy had followed the teacher’s preference at step t. Second, it is sign-blind: even when the teacher-preferred action would have harmed the trajectory, the loss does not explicitly push the student away from it. The core problem is therefore how to combine sequence-level reward, teacher–student preference, and token-level counterfactual effect into a better per-token credit signal without paying a large extra sampling cost.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Many current gains in reasoning and tool-use systems come from RL or self-improvement loops, and those loops are often bottlenecked by the quality and granularity of the training signal. CRAFT’s main contribution is to separate two notions that are often conflated: the teacher prefers a token, versus following that preference actually improves return. That distinction is relevant beyond agentic environments. It applies to any setup that mixes token-level imitation with trajectory-level reward, including reasoning RL, verifier-guided distillation, and some continual post-training regimes. The contribution is a solid algorithmic refinement rather than a new environment or a stronger teacher: it redesigns the credit signal while staying compatible with the existing GRPO sampling budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: CRAFT has three pillars. Pillar 1 is Counterfactual Token Importance (CTI). The key observation is that GRPO already samples G sibling rollouts for the same prompt, so the G−1 non-realized siblings can be reused as approximate counterfactuals. The method importance-weights these sibling rollouts using the teacher–student gap Δ_t to estimate how the group-level advantage would change if the policy had moved toward the teacher at token t. This yields a signed per-token credit c_t in (-1, 1), which can express both “move toward the teacher here” and “the teacher would be harmful here.” The paper states consistency and variance results for this estimator, with variance scaling as O(1/G), and the extra computational cost is essentially a group-wise softmax rather than new rollouts. Pillar 2 is a bivariate controller. Instead of tuning a single KL coefficient, CRAFT jointly adjusts the CTI weight λ(t) and the reference-KL weight μ(t), driving them in opposite directions according to an EMA over gate activity. Intuitively, when token-level counterfactual credit is active and trustworthy, the update can rely more on CTI; when it is weak or noisy, the KL term provides stabilization. The paper also analyzes the controller’s fixed point. Pillar 3 is a signed per-token KL penalty. The KL direction is no longer fixed as one-way imitation of the teacher. It is chosen according to sign(c_t): when c_t is positive, the update is teacher-seeking; when c_t is negative, the update goes in the opposite direction to avoid distilling harmful teacher preferences. The authors argue that this is structurally aligned with the credit signal and still forms a valid policy-gradient surrogate. An important engineering detail is bit-exact reproducibility: with all switches disabled, the loss and gradients are byte-identical to the baseline, which makes the empirical gains easier to attribute to the algorithm rather than implementation drift.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three agentic environments, four model sizes, four baselines, out-of-distribution tests, and clean ablations. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact numbers should not be fabricated, but several conclusions are clear. First, CRAFT improves over the standard single-gate SDAR baseline across multiple environments, suggesting that signed counterfactual credit is more informative than a plain Δ_t gate. Second, the paper includes a stronger comparator, Adaptive-CRINGE, which shares Pillar 2 with CRAFT. This is a good control because it isolates whether gains come merely from adaptive coefficient tuning or from CTI plus signed KL specifically. Third, the ablations are factorized by the three pillars, allowing the marginal contribution of each component to be inspected cleanly. Fourth, the inclusion of OOD evaluation indicates that the method is not only exploiting in-distribution imitation effects; it is intended to improve actual decision credit assignment. Even without exact metrics in the excerpt, the experimental design is careful and aligned with the paper’s claim: the benefit comes from better counterfactual token credit, not from extra sampling or loose implementation changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this paper in four passes: problem diagnosis, estimator, controller, and controlled comparisons. Start with the introduction and make sure the two criticisms of the baseline are clear: retrospective credit and sign-blind gating. Then go directly to the CTI derivation in Section 3.1, which is the conceptual center of the paper. Focus on how sibling rollouts are reused as a counterfactual estimator, what the importance weights look like, and what assumptions underlie the consistency and O(1/G) variance claims. After that, read the bivariate controller and the signed KL section to understand why the authors did not simply adopt unlikelihood or CRINGE-style penalties. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against SDAR, RLSD, and Adaptive-CRINGE, then inspect the three-pillar ablations. If time is limited, the main method section, the propositions, and the primary result tables should be enough in about 40 minutes. Three follow-up questions are worth probing: how sensitive CTI is to sibling-rollout diversity and quality, whether importance weighting becomes high-variance on long trajectories, and whether the same signed token credit idea can transfer to reasoning RL, verifier-guided SFT, or offline preference optimization.

recommendation.zh: 想法比证据更强：如果你在看 GRPO/RLVR 如何把轨迹奖励压到 token 上，值得读 credit 设计；但在大规模复现前别急着改训练栈。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence: read it if you care about mapping trajectory reward to token updates in GRPO/RLVR, but do not rewrite your stack before seeing cleaner large-scale validation.

paper.title: On the Policy Gradient Foundations of Group Relative Policy Optimization: Credit Assignment, Gradient Sparsity, and Rank Collapse
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) eliminates the learned critic in PPO by using the mean reward of grouped rollouts as a baseline. We provide a rigorous derivation of GRPO from first principles of the policy gradient theorem, revealing a fundamental credit assignment failure: under output-only reward, every token in a rollout receives identical advantage, collapsing token-level credit to a single scalar. We prove this induces gradient sparsity that intensifies over training, and demonstr

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为PPO的无critic替代方案已被广泛用于推理增强类对齐训练（如DeepSeek-R1），但现有工作缺乏对其理论基础、信用分配机制与梯度结构特性的严格第一性原理推导，尤其是分组均值基线引入的结构性影响尚不明确。
summary.importance: 从策略梯度定理出发严格推导了GRPO的形式化表达，揭示了其在输出奖励场景下的固有缺陷：全序列token信用分配均一化导致的梯度稀疏与秩坍缩，为后续RL对齐算法的改进（如token级细粒度信用分配、更优baseline设计）提供了明确的理论依据和实证观测，对RL预训练与后训练的优化设计有直接指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）从策略梯度定理逐步推导，证明GRPO是带分组均值基线的REINFORCE估计器的特例，明确其两个核心假设：仅输出端奖励（ORM）、分组样本均值替代可学习critic；2）证明在仅输出奖励且折扣因子γ=1的条件下，同一条轨迹内所有token的优势函数会坍缩为同一个标量，即关键推理步与填充token会获得完全相同的信用分配；3）证明该均一化特性结合分组内优势的零和约束，会导致梯度矩阵呈现固有秩-2结构，且训练过程中梯度稀疏性会持续加剧；4）进一步解释了GRPO在多轮对话场景下表现受限的理论来源。分析过程刻意排除了裁剪、KL正则等优化步的干扰，仅聚焦梯度信号的本质结构。
summary.experiments: 在Nemotron-4B模型、GSM8K推理任务上开展梯度SVD分析，结果显示无论分组大小R取{2,4,8}中的任意值，GRPO的梯度矩阵有效秩始终稳定在约2，与理论推导结论完全一致，验证了秩坍缩现象的普遍性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第2节GRPO从策略梯度定理的完整推导过程、第3节信用分配坍缩与梯度稀疏的形式化证明、第7节的SVD实证验证结果；从事RL对齐研究的人员可深入阅读核心证明推导。预计阅读时间40-50分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO, a critic-free alternative to PPO widely adopted in reasoning-enhanced alignment training (e.g., DeepSeek-R1), lacks rigorous first-principle derivation of its theoretical foundations, credit assignment mechanism, and gradient structural properties — especially the structural impacts introduced by the group-mean baseline remain underexplored.
summary_en.importance: Provides a formal derivation of GRPO from the policy gradient theorem and reveals its inherent limitations under output-only rewards: uniform cross-token credit assignment leading to gradient sparsity and rank collapse. The findings offer explicit theoretical guidance and empirical observations for improving RL alignment algorithms, such as fine-grained token-level credit assignment and better baseline design, with direct implications for RL pretraining and post-training optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Derives step-by-step from the policy gradient theorem that GRPO is a special case of the REINFORCE estimator with a group-mean baseline, with two explicit core assumptions: output-only reward (ORM), and group sample mean replacing the learnable critic; 2) Proves that under output-only rewards with discount factor γ=1, the advantage function collapses to a single scalar for all tokens within the same trajectory, meaning critical reasoning steps and filler tokens receive identical credit; 3) Proves that this uniform assignment, combined with the zero-sum constraint on within-group advantages, induces an intrinsic rank-2 structure in the gradient matrix, with gradient sparsity intensifying progressively during training; 4) Further explains the theoretical origin of GRPO's limited performance in multi-turn scenarios. The analysis deliberately excludes confounding factors from clipping and KL regularization, focusing solely on the fundamental structure of the gradient signal.
summary_en.experiments: SVD analysis of GRPO gradients conducted on the Nemotron-4B model with the GSM8K reasoning task shows that regardless of group size R ∈ {2,4,8}, the effective rank of the GRPO gradient matrix remains stable at approximately 2, fully consistent with theoretical predictions and validating the universality of the rank collapse phenomenon.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for the complete derivation of GRPO from the policy gradient theorem, Section 3 for the formal proof of credit assignment collapse and gradient sparsity, and Section 7 for the SVD empirical validation. Researchers working on RL alignment may read the core proof derivations in detail. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO 的 rank-2 梯度结论会改变对 RLVR 信号密度的先验，建议复现 SVD 诊断再谈 token credit。
recommendation.en: The rank-2 GRPO gradient result should update priors on RLVR signal density; reproduce the SVD diagnostic before debating token credit.

paper.title: SWE-MeM: Learning Adaptive Memory Management for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon software engineering agents often need to manage lengthy and noisy interaction histories under limited context budgets. Existing memory management methods typically rely on static compression workflows or impose rigid constraints on compression timing and granularity. Moreover, these approaches fail to jointly optimize memory management and issue resolution capabilities to improve performance while reducing token usage. We present SWE-MeM, a training framework for proactive and on-d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长程 coding agent 的上下文管理问题：交互历史又长又噪，固定阈值 summarization 或固定粒度压缩不能判断哪些信息该保留、何时该压缩，也没有和最终解题成功率一起优化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent post-train 和长上下文使用方式有参考价值。关键点是把 memory management 从外部规则变成模型可学习的动作，并把“少用上下文”和“解决 issue”放在同一个训练目标里。对于训练长程工具调用模型，这类设计比单纯扩 context window 更贴近实际瓶颈：很多失败不是窗口不够长，而是模型无法主动维护可用工作记忆。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-MeM 给 agent 一个显式的 compress 工具，让模型自己决定何时压缩、压缩哪一段、如何写摘要。工具参数包括 analysis、start_step_number、end_step_number、content 和 remaining_work。analysis 记录当前进展和未解决子任务；start/end 指定要替换的历史跨度；content 是压缩后的摘要；remaining_work 被追加到轨迹末尾，用来保持任务连续性。压缩后的摘要以后还可以再次被压缩，因此形成渐进式 memory。训练上，作者先合成带 memory-tool 调用的解题轨迹。轨迹中的任务行动由待训练的 base model 生成，专有模型只用于判断是否应主动触发压缩和生成 memory-tool 参数。随后使用 curriculum fine-tuning 学习主动压缩行为，再用 Memory-aware GRPO 做强化学习。Memory-aware GRPO 的重点是按 memory 行为切分轨迹并做 step-level credit assignment，使模型同时优化 issue resolution 和 memory 决策，而不是只压缩 token。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，在 32K context budget 下评估。Qwen3-4B-Instruct 达到 43.4% resolve rate，Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 达到 60.2%。论文声称相对已有 memory management 方法，在解题率和交互轮数上都有优势。更有信息量的实验点是效率比较：已有静态压缩方法可以降低 peak context length，但可能增加总 token 使用和交互步数；SWE-MeM 试图让压缩动作服务于解题路径，而不是只服务于窗口长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分的 memory tool 定义和 Figure 2，理解它如何把历史片段替换为摘要并保留 remaining work。然后看 trajectory synthesis 和 curriculum training，判断数据合成是否会把专有模型的偏好注入 memory 策略。最后看 Memory-aware GRPO 和 SWE-Bench Verified 主表。消融实验若完整呈现，重点关注三项：去掉主动触发、去掉 curriculum、去掉 memory-aware credit assignment 后，resolve rate、token usage、interaction rounds 分别如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: SWE-MeM addresses memory management for long-horizon coding agents. Append-only ReAct-style histories become long and noisy, while fixed summarization rules cannot decide which information remains useful, when compression should happen, or how compression affects final issue resolution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to agent post-training than to base pretraining. Its useful idea is to make memory management a learnable agent action rather than an external heuristic. The work also treats context reduction and task success as a joint optimization problem. This is important because many long-horizon failures are caused not only by limited context length, but also by poor maintenance of working memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method gives the agent a flexible compress tool. The model decides when to call it, which history span to compress, and what summary should replace that span. The tool takes analysis, start_step_number, end_step_number, content, and remaining_work. The analysis records progress and unresolved subtasks; start and end identify the span to replace; content is the compressed memory entry; remaining_work is appended to preserve task continuity. Compressed entries can be compressed again later, enabling progressive memory refinement. Training starts with synthesized trajectories that include proactive memory-tool calls. The base model generates the task-solving actions, while a proprietary model is used only for trigger judgment and memory-tool argument synthesis. The model is then trained with curriculum fine-tuning and Memory-aware GRPO, which uses memory-aware trajectory splitting and step-level credit assignment to optimize both issue resolution and memory decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation is on SWE-Bench Verified under a 32K context budget. SWE-MeM reports a 43.4% resolve rate with Qwen3-4B-Instruct and 60.2% with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. The paper reports better resolve rates and fewer interaction rounds than prior memory-management baselines. The key experimental claim is that static compression can reduce peak context length while still increasing total token use or the number of interaction steps, whereas adaptive compression is trained to support the actual repair trajectory.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the memory-tool formulation and Figure 2 to understand how selected history spans are replaced while remaining work is preserved. Then read the trajectory synthesis and curriculum training sections, especially the role of the proprietary model in generating memory actions. Finish with Memory-aware GRPO and the SWE-Bench Verified results. If ablations are available, the most useful ones are removing proactive triggering, curriculum learning, and memory-aware credit assignment, then checking resolve rate, token usage, and interaction rounds.

recommendation.zh: Memory-aware GRPO的步级信用分配设计有参考价值，做长上下文Agent后训练的重点看§3的训练目标和轨迹切分方法
recommendation.en: The step-level credit assignment design of Memory-aware GRPO is referential; long-context agent post-training researchers should focus on the training objective and trajectory splitting in §3

paper.title: VoiceTTA: Enhancing Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech via Reinforcement Learning-Based Test-Time Adaptation
paper.abstract: Recently, zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) has enabled high-fidelity and expressive speech synthesis, but it often fails to imitate unseen speaking styles from uncommon scenarios (e.g., crosstalk, dialects). Moreover, fine-tuning pretrained models requires large, high-quality datasets, limiting rapid personalization. We propose VoiceTTA, a reinforcement learning-based test-time adaptation (TTA) method that improves voice imitation of pretrained zero-shot TTS models. VoiceTTA introduces two style r

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决零样本 TTS 在罕见说话风格、方言、串话等场景下难以模仿 reference prompt 的问题，并避免为每个新用户做常规参数微调。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的启发主要在 post-train 与 test-time adaptation 接口，而不是文本预训练本身。它把 GRPO 用在语音生成模型的测试时轻量适配中，用可计算的声学 reward 代替人工偏好，优化少量 prefix 参数。这对语音 LM、flow matching 生成模型、以及多模态生成模型的在线个性化有参考意义：在不更新主模型权重的情况下，可以用任务相关 reward 调整条件表示或 prefix，使模型更贴近当前样本分布。
summary.technical_approach:
VoiceTTA 面向预训练零样本 TTS 模型，在推理时只优化 learnable prefixes，不更新主模型参数。底座是 flow matching TTS：从高斯 latent 出发，在文本和语音 prompt 条件下生成 mel-spectrogram，再经 vocoder 合成 waveform。为了产生可用于偏好优化的候选，方法从不同 temperature 采样多个语音输出，使候选在韵律和风格上有足够差异。

reward 由四部分组成。第一，F0 coefficient of variation 差异，用来约束基频起伏，捕捉语调和夸张程度。第二，energy coefficient of variation 差异，用来约束能量动态，捕捉重音和说话力度。第三，speaker similarity，用于保持音色接近 reference。第四，基于 Whisper 的 WER，用来惩罚不可懂或读错文本的候选。训练算法采用 GRPO：对同一 prompt 生成一组候选，根据组内相对 reward 更新 prefix。选择 prefix 而不是全量微调，是为了降低测试时开销，并允许为不同用户保存少量适配参数。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个零样本 TTS 模型和多类 uncommon prompts 上做了客观与主观评测。核心现象是：加入 F0-CV、Energy-CV 和 speaker similarity 后，合成语音更接近 reference 的说话风格；加入 WER reward 后，可在增强模仿能力的同时抑制可懂度下降。给出的正文片段未包含完整实验表和具体数值，因此不应把效果解读为跨模型稳定收益。更稳妥的读法是：这是一套测试时 RL 适配框架，实证重点应检查 reward 组合消融、GRPO 步数与延迟、候选数 k、temperature 采样范围、以及 subjective MOS / similarity test 是否与客观指标一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 reward 设计和 GRPO-prefix 更新流程，尤其是 F0-CV 与 Energy-CV 为什么用变异系数而不是均值差。实验部分建议只看三类内容：reward ablation、不同 uncommon prompt 类型的表现、测试时计算开销。若关注语音 LM 或统一多模态生成，可以把它当作 test-time RL adaptation 案例，而不是语音预训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical failure mode of zero-shot TTS: a pretrained model can preserve speaker timbre but often fails to imitate unusual speaking styles, dialectal patterns, crosstalk, or exaggerated prosody from a short reference prompt.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the interface between pretrained generative models and test-time adaptation. VoiceTTA applies GRPO at inference time with automatically computed speech rewards, while updating only lightweight prefixes. This is useful for audio language modeling and multimodal generation research because it shows a way to adapt a frozen generator to a local input distribution without full fine-tuning or new supervised data.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VoiceTTA uses a pretrained zero-shot TTS model and optimizes learnable prefixes during inference. The discussed backbone is a flow-matching TTS system: a Gaussian latent is transported toward a mel-spectrogram distribution under text and speech-prompt conditioning, then converted to waveform by a vocoder. Candidate utterances are sampled with varying temperatures to create enough diversity for preference optimization.

The reward combines style and intelligibility signals. F0 coefficient-of-variation difference measures whether pitch dynamics match the reference. Energy coefficient-of-variation difference measures whether loudness dynamics and stress patterns are similar. Speaker similarity keeps the generated voice close to the prompt speaker. A Whisper-based WER reward discourages outputs that imitate style at the cost of intelligibility. GRPO is then used over a group of sampled candidates to update only the prefix parameters. This design keeps the adapted state small and avoids modifying the main TTS weights.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports objective and subjective evaluation on several zero-shot TTS models and uncommon prompt types. The stated finding is that F0-CV, Energy-CV, and speaker-similarity rewards improve style imitation, while the WER reward helps preserve intelligibility. The provided text does not expose the full result tables or exact numerical gains, so the empirical strength should be judged from the ablations: reward composition, number of GRPO steps, candidate count, temperature schedule, latency, and agreement between objective metrics and human judgments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. The key material is the reward design and the GRPO-based prefix update loop. Pay attention to why coefficient of variation is used for F0 and energy: it targets dynamic variation rather than absolute pitch or loudness. The experiment section is most useful if it contains reward ablations, uncommon-style breakdowns, and test-time compute measurements. For audio-LM researchers, the paper is best read as a test-time RL adaptation case rather than a pretraining contribution.

recommendation.zh: 将RL（GRPO）用于语音生成的Test-Time Adaptation，设计了针对语音风格的Reward，对多模态生成和RLHF在连续模态的应用有启发。
recommendation.en: Applies RL (GRPO) for Test-Time Adaptation in speech generation with custom style rewards; inspiring for multimodal generation and RLHF in continuous modalities.

paper.title: SpatialFlow-GRPO: Where Spatial Credit Drives Image Editing
paper.abstract: Recent online reinforcement learning has substantially improved image editing quality. However, existing Flow-GRPO-style methods usually rely on a single whole-image reward, which makes fine-grained editing optimization difficult. We observe that a key obstacle in image editing is this spatial uniformity assumption: a whole-image reward cannot distinguish how different spatial regions contribute to image quality. To address this issue, we propose SpatialFlow-GRPO, a training framework that intro

summary.core_problem: 解决图像编辑 RL 中 whole-image reward 过粗，无法给不同空间区域分配准确 credit 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成后训练方法：把 GRPO/Flow-GRPO 类在线 RL 从整图奖励推进到区域级奖励，对理解生成模型中的 reward granularity 和 credit assignment 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpatialFlow-GRPO，将 region-aware rewards 转换为 semantic-region-level 优化信号，并在 policy update 中把区域 advantage 对齐到对应 latent positions。还训练了区域感知 reward model SFReward，构建 SFReward-14K 和 MultiEditBench。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示方法在 OmniGen2 和 FLUX.2-klein-4B 上评估，并与 Flow-GRPO 比较；声称在 GEdit-Bench 和多区域编辑相关评测上优于 Flow-GRPO，但给定信息未包含具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles coarse credit assignment in RL-based image editing, where a single whole-image reward cannot identify which spatial regions caused quality changes.
summary_en.importance: It is a multimodal generation post-training method. The useful signal is the move from image-level rewards to region-level reward and advantage assignment for diffusion or flow-based editing models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatialFlow-GRPO converts region-aware rewards into semantic-region-level optimization signals and aligns regional advantages with corresponding latent positions during policy updates. It also trains SFReward, builds SFReward-14K, and introduces MultiEditBench.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on OmniGen2 and FLUX.2-klein-4B against Flow-GRPO. The abstract claims better performance on GEdit-Bench and multi-region editing evaluation, but exact numbers are not included in the supplied excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 看 reward 到 latent credit 的映射即可；对文本 RLVR 是旁证，不要把图像区域性直接类比成 token credit。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward-to-latent credit mapping; it is a useful analogy for RLVR, but image regions should not be naively equated with token credit.

paper.title: Paved with True Intents: Intent-Aware Training Improves LLM Safety Classification Across Training Regimes
paper.abstract: We argue that safety classifiers should model user intent as an explicit signal between the prompt and the final label. To study this, we introduce AIMS, a human-annotated dataset of 1,724 difficult safety prompts, each paired with an intent description and harm label. We use AIMS to evaluate intent-aware training across supervised fine-tuning, preference learning, reasoning distillation, and reinforcement learning. Despite its size, AIMS enables competitive safety classifiers across training re

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究安全分类器是否应该显式建模用户意图，而不是直接从 prompt 预测 safe / harmful 标签。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练论文，但对 post-train 训练信号设计有参考价值。核心信息是：在安全分类这种标签容易受表面词误导的任务中，把“用户想达到什么目的”作为可监督、可检查的中间变量，可以改善 SFT、DPO、蒸馏和 RL 的训练效果。对基座研究员的启发在于训练信号质量：小规模但高密度的人类标注中间监督，有时比扩大直接标签数据更有效；RL reward 如果只奖励最终标签，可能学到正确标签但错误理由，而显式奖励 intent faithfulness 能减少这种偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了 AIMS，一个面向安全分类的意图标注数据集。数据来自 WildGuardMix，先用 ensemble classifier 在候选集中筛选困难样本，只保留预测 harmful probability 位于 [0.35, 0.65] 的 prompt，因此集中在边界、对抗和伪装场景。标注员根据 prompt 写一句用户意图，并给出四级 harm 标签，之后训练时折叠成二分类。训练部分覆盖四种 regime。SFT 比较直接输出 label 与先输出 intent 再输出 label。DPO 使用模型生成的错误意图作为 rejected completions，包括会翻转安全标签的意图，也包括标签不变但误表征用户目标的意图。reasoning distillation 比较有无 intent supervision 的 teacher traces。GRPO 比较 label-only reward 与验证 intent faithfulness 的 reward。方法重点不在新模型，而在把中间语义变量接入多种 post-training 目标。
summary.experiments: 数据侧有几个值得注意的数字：初筛得到 1,724 个候选 prompt，最终质量过滤后包含 1,275 个 unique prompts；入选样本中 70.1% 在原 WildGuardMix 中标为 adversarial；四级标签折叠成二分类后，人工标注 Cohen’s κ 为 0.55；人工 intent 之间的平均语义相似度为 0.62，而 Llama-3.1-8B 生成 intent 与人工 intent 的相似度为 0.50；人工二分类标签与 WildGuardMix 原标签一致率为 72%，差异主要集中在 adversarial prompts。模型侧在五个外部安全 benchmark 上评估。结论是 intent-aware training 的平均表现最好：带 intent 的 SFT 已经有竞争力；用错误 intent 做 DPO rejected samples 能超过 SFT；intent-conditioned distillation 在多数 teacher-student 组合中优于 reasoning-only distillation；最强平均结果来自直接用 GRPO 奖励 intent faithfulness，而不是单纯蒸馏更大的 teacher。当前可见内容没有提供各 benchmark 的完整分数表，因此重点应放在训练信号设计，而不是某个绝对分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Dataset Construction，尤其是困难样本筛选、人工 intent 标注协议、与 WildGuardMix 原标签的差异。方法部分建议看四种训练 regime 如何使用同一份 intent supervision，特别是 DPO 的 rejected intent 构造和 GRPO 的 intent faithfulness reward。实验部分优先看五个外部安全 benchmark 的平均结果、各 regime 的 ablation，以及错误分析中 adversarial cover story 和 keyword-driven over-refusal 的案例。对预训练研究更相关的问题是：这种“中间变量监督”能否推广到更一般的推理、工具使用或数据过滤任务；以及 reward 是否应该更多验证过程语义，而不是只验证最终答案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether safety classifiers should explicitly model user intent instead of mapping a prompt directly to a safe or harmful label.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and safety-classification paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to training-signal design. The useful lesson is that an inspectable intermediate variable can improve multiple training regimes when labels are easily confounded by surface form. In safety classification, a model can output the right label for the wrong reason, or over-refuse because of unsafe keywords. Intent supervision gives SFT, DPO, distillation, and RL a more precise target. For pretraining-oriented work, the broader implication is about signal quality: a small amount of dense human supervision over intermediate semantics can be more informative than more direct labels, and RL rewards that check only final labels may miss important failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build AIMS, an intent-annotated safety dataset derived from WildGuardMix. They first train an ensemble classifier and select prompts whose predicted harmfulness lies in [0.35, 0.65], concentrating annotation on ambiguous, adversarial, and borderline examples. Annotators write a concise description of the user’s underlying intent and assign a four-level harm label, later collapsed into a binary label for training and evaluation. The same intent signal is then used across four regimes. In SFT, the model either predicts the label directly or generates intent followed by the label. In DPO, rejected completions are model-generated bad intents, including both label-flipping intents and label-preserving but semantically wrong intents. In reasoning distillation, teacher traces with intent supervision are compared against reasoning-only traces. In GRPO, a label-only reward is compared with a reward that verifies intent faithfulness. The contribution is not a new classifier architecture; it is a clean way to inject an intermediate semantic target into several post-training objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset statistics are informative. The selection process yields 1,724 candidate prompts, and after quality filtering the final dataset contains 1,275 unique prompts. Among selected prompts, 70.1% are marked adversarial in the original WildGuardMix metadata. After binarizing the four-level harm labels, annotator agreement reaches Cohen’s κ = 0.55. Human-written intents have a mean pairwise semantic similarity of 0.62, while Llama-3.1-8B generated intents reach only 0.50 similarity against human annotations. Human binary labels match the original WildGuardMix labels for 72% of prompts, with disagreements concentrated in adversarial cases. Models are evaluated on five external safety benchmarks. Intent-aware training gives the best average performance across the evaluated systems: intent SFT is already competitive, DPO over bad intents improves over SFT, intent-conditioned distillation beats reasoning-only distillation in most teacher-student settings, and the best average result comes from GRPO with an intent-faithfulness reward rather than from simply distilling a larger teacher. The visible text does not provide the full score table, so the main takeaway should be the training-signal design rather than any single benchmark number.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the dataset construction section carefully: the uncertainty-based filtering, the intent annotation protocol, and the disagreement with WildGuardMix labels are the most useful parts. In the method section, focus on how the same intent annotations are reused in SFT, DPO, distillation, and GRPO. The DPO construction of rejected intents and the GRPO reward for intent faithfulness are the main technical details. In the experiments, prioritize the five-benchmark average, regime-level ablations, and qualitative errors around adversarial cover stories and keyword-driven over-refusal. The broader question worth carrying forward is whether intermediate semantic supervision can improve reasoning, tool use, data filtering, or reward modeling beyond safety classification.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“显式中间变量监督”这个接口值得记；看 GRPO 和 distillation 对比就够，别把小数据集结果外推太远。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the explicit latent-intent supervision interface is worth noting; read the GRPO and distillation comparisons, and do not overgeneralize from the tiny dataset.

paper.title: RolloutPipe: Overlapping Pipelined Rollout and Training in Disaggregated On-Policy LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) post-training for reasoning increasingly relies on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where models learn from ground-truth feedback on mathematical, logical, and scientific tasks. To enable flexible resource allocation and support heterogeneous training setups, modern RLVR systems adopt disaggregated architectures that decouple rollout generation and policy training across independent GPU pools. However, existing synchronous on-policy GRPO (Group Re

summary.core_problem: 解耦式 on-policy GRPO 强化学习后训练中，rollout 生成与策略训练串行执行，导致训练 GPU 池在整个 rollout 阶段持续空闲；异步流水线虽能重叠两阶段，但会引入旧策略数据，破坏 on-policy 正确性。
summary.importance: 揭示了 GRPO 组级依赖与串行执行范式之间的结构性矛盾，提出无需牺牲 on-policy 正确性的流水线重叠方案，直接降低 RLVR 后训练的端到端时间成本，对规模化 RL 后训练系统设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RolloutPipe，基于 Slime 框架改造，核心有两个机制：1) complete-group pipelining (CGP)：以完整组为边界构建流水线，一旦某个 prompt 对应的 K 个响应全部生成并完成奖励计算、组统计、优势赋值（即组物化完成），立即送入训练侧 FIFO，无需等待全部 R 个组完成；当前轮次 rollout 权重保持固定，因此训练数据仍对应当前策略，不破坏 on-policy 性质。2) frontier-group dispatch (FGD)：rollout 节点的请求准入策略，优先调度构成下一个训练 batch 的 F_w 个前沿组，使可训练组更早、更稳定地到达训练端。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行端到端实验，覆盖 4 类推理与科学任务共 12 种配置。相比原生 Slime：rollout 开始到训练结束的主流程时间缩短 30.7%–42.3%，训练端等待比率下降 37%–76%。样例场景（R=96, K=8, LSAT-AR）中，首个组在 200s 即完成物化，原生 Slime 需等到 400s 全部组完成才提交训练，RolloutPipe 直接回收这 200s 的交错完成窗口空闲。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，约 25 分钟。重点看 §1 动机部分对 GRPO 组级依赖与 PPO 样本级依赖的结构性差异分析，以及图 1 的串行/流水线时序对比；§2 的两个核心机制 CGP 与 FGD 的设计细节；实验部分关注不同任务和 R/K 配置下加速比的波动规律，理解 rollout 资源与训练资源比例对收益的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: In disaggregated on-policy GRPO reinforcement learning post-training, rollout generation and policy training execute serially, leaving the trainer GPU pool idle for the entire rollout phase. Asynchronous pipelines overlap the two stages but introduce stale policy data, breaking on-policy correctness.
summary_en.importance: Identifies the structural mismatch between GRPO's group-level dependency and the serial execution paradigm, and proposes a pipeline overlapping scheme that preserves on-policy correctness. The approach directly reduces end-to-end wall-clock time of RLVR post-training and provides concrete system design insights for scalable RL post-training stacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: RolloutPipe is built on top of the Slime framework with two core mechanisms. First, complete-group pipelining (CGP): constructs a pipeline at complete-group boundaries. As soon as the K responses for a prompt finish generation, reward computation, group-statistics calculation, and advantage assignment (i.e., group materialization), the complete group is pushed into the trainer FIFO immediately, without waiting for all R groups in the round. Rollout weights for the current round stay fixed, so training data still matches the current policy and on-policy property is preserved. Second, frontier-group dispatch (FGD): a rollout-node admission policy that prioritizes requests for the F_w frontier groups forming the next trainer batch, so that trainable groups arrive earlier and more steadily.
summary_en.experiments: End-to-end experiments on Qwen3-1.7B across four reasoning and scientific workloads, covering 12 settings. Compared with native Slime: rollout-to-train-end main time is reduced by 30.7%–42.3%, and trainer waiting ratio drops by 37%–76%. In a representative LSAT-AR configuration (R=96, K=8), the first group materializes at 200s while native Slime submits all groups at 400s; RolloutPipe recovers this staggered-completion window idle time directly.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~25 minutes. Focus on §1 motivation for the structural difference between GRPO (group-level training unit) and PPO (sample-level training unit), and Figure 1's serial vs. pipelined timeline comparison; §2 design details of CGP and FGD; in experiments, trace the variance of speedup across workloads and R/K configurations to understand how the ratio between rollout and training resources affects gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 stale-data 控制即可；它不会改变 RL 算法 prior，但会影响 RLVR 训练集群怎么排程。
recommendation.en: Read the systems design and stale-data control; it will not change RL algorithm priors, but it may change how RLVR clusters are scheduled.

paper.title: Helpfulness Hurts: Domain-Dependent Degradation of Mid-Trained Compassion Values Under Post-Training
paper.abstract: Standard post-training pipelines apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to make language models helpful, but these processes may inadvertently degrade values instilled during pre-training. We investigate whether the domain of post-training data differentially affects the retention of animal compassion values in a Llama 3.1 8B model mid-trained on compassion-oriented synthetic data, using both SFT (helpfulness via Dolly-15k vs. coding via Magicoder-110K) and GRPO (help

summary.core_problem: 研究 SFT 和 RL 这类 post-training 是否会破坏模型在 mid-training 阶段注入的特定价值偏好，尤其是动物关怀相关价值。
summary.importance: 贡献是 pretrain/mid-train 与 post-train 接口上的干扰分析。虽然主题很窄、机构和实验规模有限，但它触及一个实际问题：后训练数据域会覆盖或重写早期训练中形成的偏好与价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以一个经过 compassion-oriented synthetic data mid-training 的 Llama 3.1 8B 为起点，比较两类后训练数据：通用 helpfulness 数据与 coding 数据。SFT 使用 Dolly-15k 与 Magicoder-110K，GRPO 使用 RLHFlow helpfulness 数据与 Magicoder coding 数据，并在动物伤害与道德推理基准上测量价值保留。
summary.experiments: 模型为 Llama 3.1 8B。AHB 2.2 上，helpfulness 训练相对 coding 训练显著降低动物关怀表现：SFT 为 35.7% vs. 65.2%，GRPO 为 18.7% vs. 32.0%。英文 MORU 项上，helpfulness 训练将一般道德推理表现从 71.9% 降至 46.4%，下降 25.5 个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether SFT and RL post-training can erode values injected during mid-training, focusing on animal-compassion preferences.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an interference analysis at the mid-train/post-train interface. The topic is narrow and the lab setting is not a major foundation-model effort, but the question is relevant: downstream post-training domains can overwrite preferences established earlier in training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from a Llama 3.1 8B model mid-trained on compassion-oriented synthetic data, the paper compares helpfulness-oriented post-training with coding-oriented post-training. SFT uses Dolly-15k versus Magicoder-110K, while GRPO uses RLHFlow helpfulness data versus Magicoder coding data. Retention is measured on animal harm and moral reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is Llama 3.1 8B. On AHB 2.2, helpfulness training degrades animal-compassion performance relative to coding training: 35.7% vs. 65.2% for SFT, and 18.7% vs. 32.0% for GRPO. On English MORU items, helpfulness training reduces general moral reasoning from 71.9% to 46.4%, a 25.5-point drop.

recommendation.zh: 当作 post-train 覆盖 mid-train 偏好的弱证据；数字刺眼，但价值域太窄，先看实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence that post-training can overwrite mid-training preferences; the numbers are sharp, but the domain is narrow.

paper.title: ExTra: Exploratory Trajectory Optimization for Language Model Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for language-model reasoning can fail at both extremes of task difficulty: easy prompts often produce all-correct, low-diversity rollout groups with little gradient signal, while hard prompts can produce all-incorrect groups with no positive reward. We introduce ExTra (Exploratory Trajectory Optimization), a GRPO-compatible framework that extracts exploration signals from the model's own rollouts. ExTra combines two mechanisms: (i) a novelty

summary.core_problem: GRPO是当前LLM可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的主流算法，但在任务难度两端存在固有失效模式：简单题采样轨迹全对时，组内奖励方差坍缩，梯度接近零，同时推理轨迹多样性下降，拖累pass@k等基于采样的推理缩放指标；难题采样轨迹全错时，组内无正奖励，优势值全为零，训练批次完全浪费。现有基于难度过滤、过采样的方案会直接丢弃高价值的难题，且从头重采样的探索效率很低。
summary.importance: 该方案解决了GRPO在难度两端的样本效率问题，无需额外奖励模型或外部监督，可直接接入标准GRPO训练流程，同时提升pass@1和pass@k性能，对推理模型RL训练的样本效率提升、推理能力扩展有实际工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出完全兼容GRPO的模块化框架ExTra，包含两个互补机制：1）基于嵌入的新颖度奖励：仅对正确轨迹施加语义多样性奖励，在GRPO组内归一化后加入总奖励，激励生成多样的正确解法，在恢复简单题梯度信号的同时避免鼓励错误的多样性；2）熵引导的前缀再生：针对组内准确率为零的难题，使用模型生成过程中的平均token熵（MTE）作为无监督信号，从已生成的失败轨迹中选择探索潜力最高的中间步作为前缀继续采样，而非从头重采样，有效缩小探索空间。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B模型上，六个数学推理基准（MATH-500、AMC23、Minerva、OlympiadBench、AIME24、AIME25）上相对原生GRPO，pass@1提升约5个百分点，pass@16提升约7个百分点；消融实验显示增益同时来自单条轨迹质量提升和推理轨迹覆盖范围扩大；理论分析验证了有信息的前缀代理可有效降低探索空间复杂度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节两个核心机制的设计逻辑，尤其是新颖度奖励采用正确轨迹门控的原因、平均token熵作为前缀选择指标的实证依据，以及第5节的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), the dominant algorithm for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) in LLM reasoning training, suffers from structural failure modes at both extremes of task difficulty: on easy prompts, all sampled trajectories are correct, leading to collapsed within-group reward variance, near-zero gradients, and reduced trajectory diversity that degrades pass@k and sampling-based inference scaling; on hard prompts, all sampled trajectories are incorrect, leading to zero advantages and complete waste of training batches. Existing mitigation approaches based on difficulty filtering and oversampling discard high-value hard prompts entirely and rely on inefficient resampling from scratch.
summary_en.importance: ExTra addresses GRPO's sample efficiency issues at both difficulty extremes without requiring additional reward models or external supervision, and can be plugged directly into standard GRPO training pipelines. It improves both pass@1 and pass@k performance, providing practical engineering value for scaling reasoning capabilities via RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExTra is a modular, GRPO-compatible framework with two complementary mechanisms: (1) Embedding-based novelty reward: a semantic diversity bonus applied only to correct trajectories, added after GRPO reward normalization, to encourage diverse correct solutions. This restores gradient signal on easy prompts without incentivizing diverse failures; (2) Entropy-guided prefix regeneration: for hard prompts with zero in-group accuracy, the method uses mean token entropy (MTE), an unsupervised signal from the model's own generation process, to select promising intermediate steps from existing failed trajectories as prefixes for further sampling, rather than resampling from scratch, which reduces the effective exploration space.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-1.7B across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC23, Minerva, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25), ExTra improves over vanilla GRPO by ~5 points on pass@1 and ~7 points on pass@16. Ablations show gains come from both improved individual solution quality and broader coverage of reasoning trajectories. Theoretical analysis confirms that informative prefix proxies reduce exploration space complexity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the design rationale for the two core mechanisms in Section 3, particularly the correctness gating for novelty rewards and empirical justification for mean token entropy as a prefix selection metric, plus the ablation results in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它把 GRPO 的零梯度区间处理得更干净，但仍是后训练局部补丁。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; it handles GRPO’s zero-signal regimes cleanly, though it remains a local post-training fix.

paper.title: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: ABACUS is a unified vision-language model that handles object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation without any benchmark-specific training required. Our model is built on existing 3B-parameter unified foundation model and is adapted for object localization tasks using three key innovations: density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for spatial grounding; a boundary-aware count policy via GRPO to eliminate crop-boundary errors; and

summary.core_problem: 解决统一视觉语言模型在图像计数理解和计数一致图像生成之间能力不一致的问题，尤其是物体计数、密集人群计数、指代表达计数和生成图像中数量不守恒。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练和统一理解-生成适配。它不是基座预训练工作，但把 GRPO 用在视觉计数策略和生成自校验上，对理解 VLM 的 RL 信号设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ABACUS 基于已有 3B 参数统一基础模型进行适配，不针对单个 benchmark 训练。方法包含三点：用 objectness map 做 density-aware adaptive zooming，提高空间 grounding；用 boundary-aware count policy 结合 GRPO 减少裁剪边界带来的漏数/重复数；用 cycle-consistent GRPO，让理解分支自我评估生成结果，从而不依赖外部标注来约束生成数量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在七个计数相关 benchmark 上取得领先结果，超过任务专用模型和更大的通用模型；但未提供具体模型底座名称、训练数据规模、GRPO 设置、各 benchmark 数值和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: ABACUS targets the gap between count understanding and count-faithful image generation in unified vision-language models, covering object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and generation with correct object counts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal adaptation and post-training recipe rather than base pretraining. Its useful signal is how GRPO can be shaped around visual counting policies and self-critique between understanding and generation branches.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model adapts an existing 3B unified foundation model without benchmark-specific training. It uses density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for grounding, a boundary-aware count policy optimized with GRPO to reduce crop-boundary errors, and cycle-consistent GRPO where the understanding branch critiques generated outputs without external annotations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports leading results on seven counting benchmarks, outperforming task-specific specialists and larger generalist models. It does not provide the exact backbone, training data scale, GRPO details, or per-benchmark effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 GRPO 计数策略和自循环校验设计；这是 VLM 后训练信号工程，不会改变预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim only the GRPO count-policy and cycle-critique design; it is useful signal engineering for VLM post-training, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: Weight-Space Geometry of Offline Reasoning Training
paper.abstract: Offline reinforcement-learning losses (RFT, RIFT, DFT, Offline GRPO, DPO) are widely used to distill reasoning from large teachers into smaller students, and are typically compared on downstream accuracy alone. We ask whether they are mechanistically distinct or converge to a similar weight update. Training six methods (SFT, RFT, DFT, RIFT, Offline GRPO, DPO) on identical math rollouts from a single base model (Qwen3-4B) with attention-only LoRA, we analyze the resulting deltas via cosine simila

summary.core_problem: 近年涌现出大量用于推理蒸馏的离线训练损失（如RFT、DFT、RIFT、Offline GRPO、DPO等），这些方法通常仅通过下游基准准确率比较优劣，缺乏严格控制变量的验证，无法说明不同损失带来的权重更新是否存在本质机制差异。
summary.importance: 在完全控制训练数据、基座模型、参数初始化、超参的条件下，从权重空间几何的维度揭示了不同离线推理损失的实际更新差异。结论直接服务于后训练方法选型：多个名称、公式各异的奖励加权损失实际产生的权重更新几乎共线，在这类方法间做选型的边际收益极低。同时也为后续推理训练方法的设计提供了可量化的对照基线——新损失需要证明自身能带来有价值的正交权重更新，而非仅通过公式变形实现与SFT等效的效果。
summary.technical_approach: 采用严格的控制变量实验设计：所有方法使用完全相同的数学推理rollout（DeepSeek-V4-Flash生成，每个提示对应4条思维链补全，基于数学验证器给出二值奖励）、相同基座模型（Qwen3-4B-Instruct）、相同的注意力层LoRA初始化、匹配的训练超参（仅DPO按公开实现惯例使用10倍更小的学习率，更高学习率会导致训练发散），训练6种主流离线推理损失。通过四类权重空间分析工具比较各方法产生的LoRA权重增量：全局与逐层余弦相似度、基于SVD的主角度子空间分析、线性模式连通性测试、层隐藏状态的CKA相似度。
summary.experiments: 核心结论包括四点：1）SFT、RFT、RIFT三种损失的权重增量几乎共线，余弦相似度≥0.97，逐层top-1主角度中位数约7度，GSM8K准确率集中在87.3%-88.2%区间，经McNemar检验两两无统计显著差异（p≥0.15）；2）DFT作为SFT的一行修改（对模型高置信度的预测token降权），产生的权重更新方向反而比上述三种奖励加权SFT变体差异更大；3）Offline GRPO引入了可量化的正交更新分量（全局占比67%，网络后层占比升至约80%），但仍与SFT/RIFT处于同一损失盆地，线性权重插值无明显性能陡壁；4）DPO的权重更新处于近正交的子空间，权重有效秩更高，与其他方法间存在明显的线性模式壁垒，在GSM8K上达到93.5%的pass@1（其余离线方法约87%-88%），AIME26上也取得最高得分，但这一精度优势受DPO使用更小学习率、训练数据量仅为其他方法1/40的混淆因素影响，损失设计与优化设置的贡献无法完全分离。上述权重几何规律与DPO的相对精度优势在Llama-3.2-3B上得到复现。补充实验显示，在线RL方法（Online GRPO、DAPO）的权重更新存在正交分量，且GSM8K准确率保持在基座模型的93%-94%水平，未出现离线SFT类方法掉点到87%的现象。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注结果部分的四个核心发现，以及对应的权重相似度、主角度、线性连通性可视化结果。无需深入推导各损失的公式细节，除非正在设计新的后训练目标。预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 公开内容未标注明确机构信息，工作聚焦于大模型微调的权重空间几何机制分析。

summary_en.core_problem: A growing number of offline training objectives for reasoning distillation (e.g., RFT, DFT, RIFT, Offline GRPO, DPO) are typically compared only by downstream benchmark accuracy, with no controlled evidence for whether these losses produce mechanistically distinct weight updates, or merely move the model along similar trajectories despite differing formulations.
summary_en.importance: This work runs a fully controlled comparison of widely used offline reasoning losses, analyzing their effects through the lens of weight-space geometry. The findings carry direct practical implications for post-training method selection: many nominally distinct reward-weighted losses produce nearly identical parameter updates to vanilla SFT, meaning the marginal value of choosing between these methods is very low. The results also establish a quantifiable baseline for future reasoning loss design: new objectives must demonstrate they produce meaningful, useful orthogonal weight updates, rather than replicating SFT-level effects under a modified mathematical form.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a tightly controlled experimental design: all methods are trained on identical math reasoning rollouts (generated by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 4 CoT completions per prompt, binary reward from a math verifier), starting from the same base model (Qwen3-4B-Instruct) and identical attention-only LoRA initialization, with matched hyperparameters (only DPO uses a 10x lower learning rate per standard public implementation conventions, as higher rates cause divergence). Six mainstream offline reasoning losses are compared. The resulting LoRA weight deltas are analyzed with four complementary geometric tools: global and per-layer cosine similarity, principal angle subspace analysis via SVD, linear mode connectivity tests, and CKA similarity of hidden states across layers.
summary_en.experiments: Four core findings emerge: (1) SFT, RFT, and RIFT produce nearly colinear weight deltas (cosine ≥0.97, median per-layer top-1 principal angle of ~7 degrees), with GSM8K accuracies ranging 87.3-88.2% and no statistically significant pairwise differences per exact McNemar’s test (p≥0.15); (2) DFT, a one-line modification of SFT that down-weights high-confidence tokens, produces a more distinct weight update than all three reward-filtered SFT variants; (3) Offline GRPO introduces a measurable orthogonal update component (67% globally, rising to ~80% in late layers), but remains in the same loss basin as SFT/RIFT with no sharp performance drop under linear weight interpolation; (4) DPO occupies a near-orthogonal weight subspace with higher effective rank and sharp linear mode barriers relative to other methods, reaching 93.5% pass@1 on GSM8K (vs. ~87-88% for other offline methods) and top performance on AIME26, though this gap is confounded by DPO’s 10x lower learning rate and ~40x smaller training set size in the protocol, making it impossible to fully separate effects of the loss formulation from optimizer settings. All core geometric patterns and the relative DPO accuracy edge replicate on Llama-3.2-3B. Supplementary experiments show on-policy RL methods (Online GRPO, DAPO) produce orthogonal weight updates and maintain 93-94% GSM8K accuracy (matching the base model), avoiding the ~7 point accuracy drop observed with offline SFT-style methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core takeaways. Focus on the four key empirical results and corresponding weight geometry visualizations (cosine similarity, principal angles, linear mode connectivity curves). There is no need to dive into detailed loss derivations unless actively designing new post-training objectives. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: No explicit institutional affiliation is noted in the available text; the work focuses on weight-space geometric analysis of LLM fine-tuning dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 非常硬核的 post-training 机制分析，揭示了 RFT/SFT 权重更新的高度共线性，以及 GRPO 引入的正交分量，对理解 RLHF 如何改变模型极具价值，建议细读实验部分。
recommendation.en: Hardcore mechanistic analysis of post-training, revealing the high collinearity of RFT/SFT weight updates and the orthogonal component introduced by GRPO. Highly valuable for understanding how RLHF alters models; recommend reading the experiments closely.

paper.title: Scheduling Thoughts: Learning the Order of Thought in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models decode by iteratively unmasking tokens, where the unmasking order defines an "order of thought" that strongly influences generation quality yet is typically chosen heuristically. We derive a tractable upper bound on the sequential decoding mismatch, measured by the Kullback-Leibler divergence and expressed in terms of the model's pathwise log-likelihood, with tightness under sufficient model expressivity. This bound induces a dense self-aware reward over ordered

summary.core_problem: 掩码扩散语言模型（包括LLaDA这类任意顺序LM）的迭代解码过程中，token的去掩码顺序（即所谓“思考顺序”）是影响生成质量的关键自由度，但现有方法几乎全部采用基于局部置信度/熵的启发式规则；这类贪心规则仅优化单步最优，未考虑解码轨迹的全局质量，且往往与模型自身的预测可靠性不匹配，导致复杂推理任务上的性能损失。
