paper.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
paper.abstract: We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open rel

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文 RLVR 中两个具体问题：训练数据过度集中在人工设计的复杂检索路径，导致能力覆盖单一；不同任务使用 EM、F1、NDCG、ROUGE-L 等异质奖励，直接用标准 GRPO 时会带来奖励尺度和难度偏差。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把长上下文后训练从“构造更复杂的 needle/retrieval 任务”转向“按能力组织数据和奖励”。这对预训练研究也有参考意义：长上下文能力不只来自 context window 扩展或中训练，后训练数据的任务覆盖、奖励形式和优势估计方式会显著影响模型是否真正利用长上下文。尤其是 23K 规模的数据能让 30B-A3B 模型接近更大 thinking 模型的长上下文表现，说明数据结构和奖励多样性可能比单纯扩大 RL 数据量更关键。
summary.technical_approach: GoLongRL 包含两部分。第一是 capability-oriented RLVR dataset，共 23K 样本，覆盖 9 类长上下文任务。约 14K 样本来自已有开源长上下文语料的筛选和改造，约 9K 样本由真实源文档合成，来源包括书籍、学术论文和多轮对话。每类任务保留自然评价指标作为奖励，而不是统一压成一个二值正确性信号。第二是 TMN-Reweight。它用 task-level mean normalization 对齐不同任务的奖励尺度，避免 per-prompt normalization 抹掉样本难度信息；再用基于平滑 pass rate 的 difficulty-adaptive weighting，提高有信息量的困难正样本权重，降低过易样本的重复梯度贡献。这个设计针对的是多任务长上下文 RL 中的 advantage estimation，而不是改动模型架构。
summary.experiments: 在相同 vanilla GRPO 设置下，使用 GoLongRL 数据训练 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，长上下文平均分从 53.0 提升到 62.2；加入 TMN-Reweight 后进一步到 63.0。Qwen3-30B-A3B 从 60.1 提升到 69.8，并优于使用 QwenLong-L1.5 数据训练的对应设置。图中 GoLongRL-30B-A3B 在 DocMath、LongBench-V2、Frames、MRCR、CorpusQA、LBV1-QA 上分别为 65.3、55.1、74.5、81.6、73.6、68.7，平均 69.8。论文还报告通用能力没有明显损失，MMLU-Pro、AIME24/25、GPQA 等评测保持或改善，并在 agentic memory、long-term dialogue memory 等未训练场景有迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看任务 taxonomy 和数据构造流程，重点确认 9 类任务是否覆盖真实长上下文使用：多文档 QA、摘要、排序、聚合、结构化推理等能力比单一检索链更有意义。然后看 TMN-Reweight 的公式，尤其是它如何替代 prompt-level 标准化，以及 difficulty weight 如何由 pass rate 得到。实验部分优先看同模型、同 GRPO 设置下与 QwenLong-L1.5 数据的对比，这能隔离数据本身的贡献。消融表比总榜更重要，因为它说明收益来自能力覆盖、奖励多样性，还是优化重加权。
summary.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences；作者姓名在给定内容中未显示。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in long-context RLVR. First, many existing datasets overemphasize synthetic retrieval paths, which narrows capability coverage. Second, heterogeneous rewards such as EM, F1, NDCG, and ROUGE-L interact poorly with standard GRPO, creating reward-scale mismatch and biased advantage estimates across tasks with different difficulty levels.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a post-training recipe, but it has clear implications for foundation-model training. Long-context capability is not only a matter of extending the context window during pretraining or mid-training. Models also need post-training signals that cover the ways long contexts are actually used: aggregation, ranking, summarization, structured reasoning, and multi-document analysis. The results suggest that task coverage and reward diversity can be a primary bottleneck in long-context RL, even at modest data scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: GoLongRL combines a capability-oriented RLVR dataset with a multitask optimization adjustment. The dataset contains 23K samples across 9 long-context task types. Around 14K samples are curated from open long-context corpora, while around 9K synthetic samples are generated from real source documents, including books, academic papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Each task keeps its natural metric as the reward instead of being forced into a single binary format. The optimization method, TMN-Reweight, has two components. Task-level mean normalization aligns reward scales across tasks while preserving prompt-level difficulty information. Difficulty-adaptive reweighting uses a smoothed pass rate to emphasize informative hard positives and reduce redundant gradients from easy prompts. The method keeps the model architecture unchanged and targets the advantage-estimation problem in heterogeneous long-context RL.
summary_en.experiments: Under the same vanilla GRPO setup, training on the GoLongRL dataset improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking from 53.0 to 62.2 average on long-context benchmarks. TMN-Reweight further raises the 4B average to 63.0. For Qwen3-30B-A3B, the average improves from 60.1 to 69.8. The 30B GoLongRL model reports 65.3 on DocMath, 55.1 on LongBench-V2, 74.5 on Frames, 81.6 on MRCR, 73.6 on CorpusQA, and 68.7 on LBV1-QA, with a 69.8 average. It also outperforms the corresponding QwenLong-L1.5 GRPO setting. General capabilities are reported as preserved or improved on evaluations such as MMLU-Pro, AIME24/25, and GPQA, with transfer to agentic memory and long-term dialogue memory benchmarks not used in training.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the task taxonomy and data pipeline, because the main claim depends on whether the 9 task types reflect real long-context usage rather than another retrieval-heavy mixture. Then read the TMN-Reweight formulation carefully: how task-level normalization differs from prompt-level normalization, and how pass-rate-based difficulty weights affect gradient allocation. In the experiments, prioritize controlled comparisons under the same base model and GRPO setup, especially against QwenLong-L1.5 data. The ablation tables are more informative than the aggregate benchmark figure because they identify whether the gains come from data coverage, reward diversity, or the reweighting algorithm.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; author names are not shown in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 long-context 能力到底是算法学出来的还是数据喂出来的，这篇值得看；先看同一 GRPO 下仅换数据的 ablation，那里信息密度最高。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care whether long-context gains come from RL algorithms or simply from better task/reward design; the highest-signal part is the fixed-GRPO, data-only ablation.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
paper.abstract: We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open rel

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 RLVR 训练中过度依赖检索路径设计、任务覆盖单一、奖励定义与真实长上下文能力脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练数据与训练 recipe 工作，价值不在新 RL 算法，而在把长上下文能力拆成可操作的能力 taxonomy，并公开 23K 样本、构造流程和训练代码。对预训练研究员的意义在于：它提供了一个更干净的长上下文能力分解视角，可反过来检验预训练阶段到底缺了哪些能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 capability-oriented 的 RLVR 数据构造，而不是继续堆复杂 retrieval path。作者按长上下文能力分类组织 9 类任务，并为每类任务配自然评测指标；数据由两部分组成：从开源语料筛选的真实样本，以及基于书籍、论文、多轮对话等真实长文档生成的合成 QA。训练上使用 vanilla GRPO，强调在相同 RL 设置下，仅替换数据即可带来收益，并通过 multitask alignment 让不同长上下文能力共同训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要可确认的数据规模为 23K RLVR 样本，覆盖 9 类长上下文任务；实验主张是在相同 vanilla GRPO 设置下，仅靠该数据集就能优于现有长上下文 RL 方法。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此当前更应把它看作数据配方与任务设计信号，而不是已被充分定量验证的范式结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a mismatch in long-context RLVR: existing methods over-index on retrieval-path engineering, cover a narrow task set, and use rewards that poorly reflect real long-context capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data/recipe paper rather than a new RL algorithm. Its value lies in turning long-context ability into an explicit capability taxonomy, with a fully open 23K-sample dataset, construction pipeline, and code. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the cleaner decomposition of what long-context competence actually consists of.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is capability-oriented RLVR data construction instead of increasingly complex retrieval-path design. The dataset spans 9 task types aligned with a taxonomy of long-context capabilities, each paired with a natural evaluation metric. Data comes from curated open-source samples plus synthetic QA built from real long documents such as books, papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Training uses vanilla GRPO, with multitask alignment across capability types.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the dataset contains 23K RLVR samples over 9 long-context task types. The main empirical claim is that under the same vanilla GRPO setup, swapping in this dataset alone outperforms prior long-context RL approaches. The abstract does not expose model size, training budget, or exact gains, so the current signal is stronger on data design than on fully quantified scaling conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 可读，但重点只在数据 taxonomy 和任务配比；如果你关心 long-context 能力到底该怎么拆，这篇比又一个花哨 RL 算法更有用，先看数据构造部分。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the capability taxonomy and task mix, not for the RL algorithm; if you care how long-context ability should be decomposed, read the data construction sections first.

paper.title: Video Models Can Reason with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have made rapid progress in perceptual realism and temporal coherence, but they remain primarily optimized for plausible generation rather than verifiable reasoning. This limitation is especially pronounced in tasks where generated videos must satisfy explicit spatial, temporal, or logical constraints. Inspired by the role of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) in reasoning-oriented language models, we introduce VideoRLVR, a practical recipe for optimizin

summary.core_problem: 当前视频扩散模型主要优化感知真实度与时序一致性，训练目标仅追求生成合理性，而非可验证的逻辑/时空约束正确性。即使经过监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning，SFT），模型也可能模仿解法的视觉模式，却不满足任务底层的规则约束，导致视频推理能力难以稳定引出和验证。
summary.importance: 这是将大语言模型侧的可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards，RLVR）三阶段范式（预训练-监督微调-RLVR）迁移到生成式视频模型的系统性落地，证明生成式视觉模型也可以通过可验证奖励优化推理正确性，打破了此前视觉生成研究仅优先感知质量的路径依赖。提出的早期步聚焦、稠密分解奖励两个设计，解决了视频强化学习训练成本高、奖励稀疏的核心痛点，为多模态模型的对齐与推理优化提供了可复用的方法。该框架还将视频生成的范畴从内容合成拓展到视觉推理轨迹生成，定义了视频推理的新任务范式，对统一多模态推理的预训练-后训练闭环构建有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VideoRLVR是面向流匹配视频扩散模型优化的三组件框架。第一，采用SDE-GRPO优化主干，将扩散模型的逆去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（Markov Decision Process，MDP）的状态转移，把强化学习优化适配到扩散模型的连续去噪轨迹上，而非传统的离散token强化学习。第二，早期步聚焦（Early-Step Focus）策略将探索与反向传播仅集中在决定粗粒度结构和长程规划的早期去噪阶段，后期去噪步固定使用参考模型的输出，不做强化学习更新，大幅降低计算开销。第三，稠密分解奖励将稀疏的任务最终成功信号，拆解为每帧对应的可验证规则组件（如迷宫任务中每一步的移动合法性、向终点的推进程度、无回溯等）。基于规则的规划器生成真值轨迹来对齐帧序列与逻辑约束，即使任务全程失败也能提供有效反馈。完整训练管线对齐大语言模型的三阶段流程：预训练获得通用生成能力，在规则生成的解法轨迹上做监督微调，再通过VideoRLVR做强化学习优化。与此前依赖稀疏人工评分奖励、全去噪步优化的视频强化学习工作不同，该设计明确面向可验证的推理正确性，同时降低了训练开销。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖三个可验证推理任务：迷宫、FlowFree、推箱子。与用于初始化的监督微调检查点相比，VideoRLVR的任务成功率分别提升6.1%（迷宫）、5.5%（FlowFree）、3.2%（推箱子）。与持续监督微调相比，VideoRLVR在难度更高的任务上带来的提升幅度更大，说明可验证奖励能提供模仿学习无法覆盖的优化信号。在VBVR基准的分布外拆分上，VideoRLVR也表现出更优的跨域泛化能力。消融实验证实，稠密分解奖励对低成功率的难任务至关重要；早期步聚焦策略在保持性能几乎不变的前提下，减少约40%的训练时间。VideoRLVR在该可验证推理基准上的表现优于多个闭源与开源商用视频生成模型。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先关注第3章的问题形式化部分，理解如何将逆扩散去噪过程建模为MDP，这是强化学习适配视频扩散的核心基础。然后查看第4章三个核心组件的细节，特别是早期步聚焦策略中去噪阶段划分的依据，以及稠密奖励的具体拆解设计。实验部分重点关注表2的消融结果和VBVR跨域泛化结果，理解各组件的贡献和泛化性的来源。可深挖的方向包括：早期步优化的结论是否可迁移到文本扩散模型或自回归多模态模型的强化学习中，以及如何为无规则求解器的任务自动化设计可验证奖励。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video diffusion models are primarily optimized for perceptual realism and temporal coherence, with training objectives that only target generation plausibility rather than verifiable compliance with logical, spatial, or temporal constraints. Even after supervised fine-tuning (SFT), models may imitate the visual patterns of valid solutions without satisfying underlying task rules, making visual reasoning abilities difficult to reliably elicit and verify.
summary_en.importance: This systematic implementation of the LLM three-stage RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) paradigm (pretrain → SFT → RLVR) for generative video models proves that generative visual models can be optimized for reasoning correctness via verifiable rewards, breaking the prior path dependence of visual generation research that prioritizes only perceptual quality. The proposed Early-Step Focus and dense decomposed reward designs address the core pain points of high training cost and sparse rewards in video RL, providing reusable methods for alignment and reasoning optimization of multimodal models. This framework expands the scope of video generation from content synthesis to visual reasoning trajectory generation, defining a new task paradigm for video reasoning with direct reference value for building the pretrain-posttrain closed loop of unified multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoRLVR is a three-component framework optimized for flow-matching video diffusion models. First, it adopts an SDE-GRPO optimization backbone, which models the reverse denoising process of diffusion as state transitions in a Markov Decision Process (MDP), adapting RL optimization to the continuous denoising trajectory of diffusion models instead of traditional discrete-token RL. Second, the Early-Step Focus strategy concentrates exploration and backpropagation only on the early denoising phase where coarse-grained structure and long-range planning are determined; later denoising steps use fixed reference model outputs without RL updates, drastically reducing computational overhead. Third, dense decomposed rewards break the sparse end-of-task success signal into verifiable rule-based components aligned with each frame (e.g., valid movement, progress toward the goal, no backtracking in maze tasks). Rule-based planners generate ground-truth trajectories to align frame sequences with logical constraints, providing informative feedback even when full task success is rare. The full pipeline aligns with the LLM three-stage workflow: pretraining for general generative competence, SFT on rule-generated solution trajectories, then RL optimization via VideoRLVR. Unlike prior video RL work that relies on sparse human-scored rewards or full denoising step optimization, this design explicitly targets verifiable reasoning correctness while reducing training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover three verifiable reasoning tasks: Maze, FlowFree, and Sokoban. Compared to the SFT checkpoint used for initialization, VideoRLVR improves task success rates by 6.1% (Maze), 5.5% (FlowFree), and 3.2% (Sokoban) respectively. Compared with continued SFT, VideoRLVR delivers larger gains on harder tasks, indicating verifiable rewards provide optimization signals not captured by imitation learning alone. It also shows improved out-of-domain transfer on the out-of-distribution split of the VBVR benchmark. Ablations confirm that dense decomposed rewards are critical for low-success-rate difficult tasks, and the Early-Step Focus strategy reduces training time by ~40% while retaining nearly identical performance. VideoRLVR outperforms multiple closed-source and open-source commercial video generation models on the verifiable reasoning benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, start with Section 3 on problem formulation to understand how the reverse diffusion denoising process is modeled as an MDP, the core foundation for adapting RL to video diffusion. Then review Section 4 for details of the three core components, especially the empirical justification for the denoising phase cutoff in Early-Step Focus, and the specific decomposition design of dense rewards. In experiments, focus on the ablation results in Table 2 and the VBVR out-of-domain generalization results to understand component contributions and generalization drivers. Follow-up exploration directions include verifying whether the early-step optimization conclusion transfers to text diffusion models or autoregressive multimodal model RL, and how to automate verifiable reward design for tasks without rule-based solvers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 SDE-GRPO 和早期去噪优化；它会改变“RLVR 只适合文本推理”的默认边界。
recommendation.en: Read the SDE-GRPO and early-denoising pieces; it weakens the prior that RLVR is mainly a text-reasoning recipe.

paper.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a s

summary.core_problem: 现有用于视频扩散模型对齐的GRPO方法计算成本极高，时间步下采样又会导致训练不稳定、性能下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出单步GRPO训练框架，大幅降低视频扩散对齐的计算成本，同时提升对齐性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flash-GRPO，用等时间分组消除时间步混淆的方差，用时间梯度矫正消除时间依赖的梯度缩放不一致问题，实现单步训练。
summary.experiments: 低计算预算下对齐质量超过全轨迹训练，14B参数模型训练效率大幅提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、清华大学、Joy Future Academy等。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GRPO for video diffusion alignment has extremely high computational cost, while timestep subsampling leads to training instability and performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a single-step GRPO training framework that drastically reduces computational cost for video diffusion alignment while improving alignment quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Flash-GRPO: use iso-temporal grouping to eliminate timestep-confounded variance, use temporal gradient rectification to neutralize time-dependent gradient scaling inconsistency, enabling single-step training.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms full-trajectory training in alignment quality under low compute budget, drastically improves training efficiency for 14B parameter models.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Zhejiang University, Tsinghua University, Joy Future Academy, etc.

recommendation.zh: GRPO单步训练和梯度矫正的思路可参考用于LLM对齐的效率优化，看方法部分摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The ideas of single-step GRPO training and gradient rectification can be referenced for LLM alignment efficiency optimization, only read method summary.

paper.title: VSPO: Vector-Steered Policy Optimization for Behavioral Control
paper.abstract: Modern language models often need to optimize a primary accuracy objective while also accommodating secondary behavioral preferences, such as verbosity, agreeableness, or the level of technical expertise in its response. In practice, a base model may exhibit a desired behavior very rarely or not at all. Thus, endowing the model with a target behavior creates a sparse behavioral reward bottleneck. To address such multi-objective problems, we introduce Vector-Steered Policy Optimization (VSPO) whi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 post-training 里的一个常见但不太好做的问题：模型既要保持主目标上的正确性，又要学会稀疏出现的次级行为偏好，比如更简洁、更有技术深度、更温和或更自信。直接用 GRPO 加行为奖励时，若目标行为在当前策略采样中很少自然出现，就会遇到 sparse behavioral reward bottleneck：大多数 rollout 都缺少可比较的行为差异，导致相对优势信号很弱，训练效率低。作者要解决的核心问题是：在不依赖频繁 teacher 在线重写、也不直接训练在 teacher 的 off-policy 轨迹上的前提下，如何让 RL 过程更稳定地学到可控行为。
summary.importance: 从预训练研究的直接相关性看，这篇更偏 post-train，而不是基座预训练本身。但它有两个值得关注的点。第一，它把 steering vector 从推理时控制手段，推进到 RL 训练过程中的 rollout 分布设计工具，这对理解 latent behavior representation 与 policy optimization 的接口有启发。第二，它讨论的是多目标优化里一个很实际的问题：奖励函数只能给结果打分，却不一定能改变 rollout 分布的探索效率。这个视角对后续研究 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口、行为控制、以及低成本 AI feedback 都有参考意义。贡献量级上属于方法型增量：不是新范式，但在 GRPO/RLAIF/teacher-trace SFT 之间提出了一个折中方案。
summary.technical_approach:
VSPO 的核心做法是：先构造一个与目标行为对应的 steering vector，再在 RL 采样阶段沿着这个向量施加不同强度的 steering，使当前策略生成一组行为强度可控、但仍然来自 student 自身分布的 rollout。之后再用类似 GRPO 的方式做多目标优化，其中行为奖励与 steering 强度成比例。

具体流程分两步。第一步是 steering vector construction。作者先让目标模型对一小批问题生成基础回答，再用更强的 teacher 把这些回答重写成带有目标行为的版本，形成对比 rewrite pairs。基于这些成对样本，在模型激活空间中提取行为方向，得到 steering vector。这里 teacher 只在离线阶段参与一次性向量构造，而不是在每轮 RL 中持续提供重写或打分。

第二步是 vector-steered policy optimization。在训练时，对同一问题按不同 steering intensity 采样多个 rollout，相当于主动扩展当前策略在目标行为轴上的局部探索范围。这样做有两个作用：一是提高行为多样性，让组内比较更有信息量；二是保持 on-policy 属性，因为这些轨迹仍由当前 student 生成，而不是直接模仿 teacher 轨迹。随后作者在 GRPO 框架下定义多目标奖励，主目标通常是任务正确性，次目标是行为偏好；行为项按 steering 强度归一化，使不同强度下的样本可比较。文中还把这一过程解释为一种 latent self-distillation：不是蒸馏 teacher 的文本轨迹，而是在潜在行为方向上引导 student 生成自己的轨迹。

与几类基线相比，区别比较清楚。相对 reward shaping，VSPO 不只是给已有 rollout 打分，而是先改变 rollout 分布，让稀疏行为更容易被采到。相对 teacher-trace SFT，它避免直接在 off-policy teacher 文本上训练。相对 RLAIF/online rewriting，它把 teacher 的使用从在线循环中移到离线向量构造，降低了成本。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 MATH 和 MMLU-Pro，并在四类目标行为上评估。摘要和正文给出的结论是，VSPO 在保持主任务正确性的同时，持续优于 reward shaping、teacher-trace SFT 和 RLAIF 风格基线。作者强调的不是单点分数，而是几个训练性质：
1. 更好的行为控制。通过不同 steering intensity 采样，模型能更稳定地沿目标行为轴移动，而不是偶然出现目标风格。
2. 更小的分布偏移。文中提到 Fig. 6 显示 VSPO 相比替代方案对 base model 的分布扰动更温和，这意味着它在行为控制和能力保持之间的折中更好。
3. 自然课程效应。Fig. 7 展示训练过程中模型会沿行为轴逐步学习，而不是一开始就被强推到高强度行为区间。

理论部分还给出 bandit abstraction 下的迭代复杂度分析，说明在目标行为稀疏时，VSPO 通过上采样这些稀有但有价值的行为模式，可以比单纯 reward-shaped GRPO 更高效。由于当前提供的全文片段没有完整表格数字、模型规模和所有超参数，无法可靠复述具体绝对分数；但从论文结构看，重点不在刷新 benchmark，而在证明 steering 改变 rollout 分布后，RL 信号会更密、更稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看方法动机，不必在 benchmark 表格上停留太久。建议阅读顺序：
1. Introduction，先看作者如何定义 sparse behavioral reward bottleneck，以及为什么 reward shaping、teacher-trace SFT、RLAIF 各自不够理想。
2. Proposed Method，重点看 steering vector 的构造方式，以及训练时如何按不同 intensity 采样 rollout。
3. Section 3.2 的理论分析。如果关心为什么这种方法可能比 reward shaping 更高效，这部分值得看。
4. 实验里的 Fig. 6 和 Fig. 7，分别对应分布偏移和课程效应，是理解方法是否“只是换个技巧”的关键证据。

预计 20 分钟左右可以抓住主要思想。若要判断是否值得复现，重点检查 steering vector 的提取位置、注入层、强度调度，以及行为奖励如何与主任务奖励做归一化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a common post-training problem: optimizing task correctness while also controlling a secondary behavior such as verbosity, agreeableness, confidence, or technical depth. Standard GRPO with an auxiliary behavior reward struggles when the target behavior is rarely expressed by the current policy. In that case, most sampled rollouts look behaviorally similar, relative advantage signals become weak, and learning is inefficient. The core question is how to make behavior learning more sample-efficient and controllable without relying on repeated online teacher rewriting or directly training on off-policy teacher trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training paper than a pretraining one, but it is still relevant for people thinking about the pretrain-posttrain interface. The interesting part is not the benchmark itself; it is the use of steering vectors as a mechanism for shaping the rollout distribution during RL, rather than only as an inference-time control tool. That gives a concrete link between latent behavior representations and policy optimization. It also highlights a useful point for alignment research: reward functions score outcomes, but they do not necessarily improve exploration over rare behaviors. The contribution is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting, but it is a thoughtful middle ground between reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and online AI-feedback methods.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VSPO works in two stages. First, it constructs a steering vector associated with the target behavior. The target model produces base responses for a small set of prompts, and a stronger teacher rewrites those responses to express the desired behavior. These contrastive rewrite pairs are then used to extract a latent direction in activation space, which serves as the steering vector. The teacher is used only in this offline setup stage, not repeatedly inside the RL loop.

Second, during policy optimization, the current policy is rolled out under multiple steering intensities along that vector. This creates a set of student-generated trajectories that vary in behavior strength while remaining anchored to the current policy. The optimization then proceeds in a GRPO-like multi-objective setup, where the primary reward captures task correctness and the behavioral reward is tied to the steering intensity. The paper interprets this as a form of latent self-distillation: instead of training on teacher-written traces, the student generates its own traces under controlled movement in latent behavior space.

The distinction from baselines is clear. Compared with reward shaping, VSPO changes the rollout distribution before scoring it, which helps expose sparse behaviors more often. Compared with teacher-trace SFT, it avoids direct imitation of off-policy teacher outputs. Compared with RLAIF or online rewriting, it removes repeated teacher calls from the training loop and reuses a fixed latent control signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on MATH and MMLU-Pro with four target behavior types. The main empirical claim is that VSPO consistently outperforms reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and RLAIF-style baselines while preserving correctness on the primary task. The paper emphasizes several qualitative properties rather than only endpoint scores.

First, behavior control is more reliable because rollouts are explicitly sampled at different steering intensities, rather than waiting for the desired behavior to appear naturally. Second, the method induces milder distributional shift from the base model; the paper points to Figure 6 for this comparison. Third, it creates a natural curriculum along the behavior axis during training, illustrated in Figure 7, instead of forcing the model immediately into a high-intensity behavior regime.

There is also a theoretical component under a bandit abstraction. The authors argue that when the target behavior is sparse, VSPO improves iteration complexity over reward-shaped GRPO by effectively upsampling rare but useful behavioral patterns. The full text fragment provided here does not include the complete result tables, model sizes, or all absolute numbers, so it would be unsafe to invent exact metrics. The main takeaway is that steering-assisted rollout diversification appears to make RL signals denser and more stable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the motivation and the mechanism, not on squeezing every benchmark detail. Read the introduction first to understand the sparse behavioral reward bottleneck and why reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and RLAIF each leave something unresolved. Then read the method section carefully, especially how the steering vector is built and how multiple steering intensities are used during rollout generation. If you care about the efficiency argument, read the theory section around the iteration-complexity propositions. In the experiments, Figures 6 and 7 are the most informative because they speak to distribution shift and curriculum effects rather than just final scores.

Roughly 20 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. If you are considering reproduction, inspect where the steering vector is extracted, how it is injected, how intensity is scheduled, and how the behavioral reward is normalized against the task reward.

recommendation.zh: GRPO的多偏好改进版本，可直接用于多维度对齐的 ablation 实验，仅需阅读第4节的理论证明部分
recommendation.en: This multi-preference GRPO variant can be directly used for multi-dimensional alignment ablation experiments, only read §4 for theoretical proof

paper.title: Learn Where Outcomes Diverge: Efficient VLA RL via Probabilistic Chunk Masking
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) allows vision-language-action (VLA) policies to generalize beyond their training distribution by optimizing directly for task success, but post-training is computationally expensive. A natural response has been to speed rollout collection through faster simulators and world models. In GRPO-based VLA RL, we find that the dominant cost lies elsewhere: gradient computation accounts for approximately 78% of wall-clock time per step in our runs, while rollout collection ac

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决的是 VLA 的 GRPO 强化学习后训练效率问题。关键观察是，瓶颈不一定在 rollout 采样，而在 actor 更新的前后向计算。作者在自己的运行中测到，单步 wall-clock 中约 78% 花在梯度计算，约 21% 花在 rollout collection。问题因此变成：一条轨迹里的哪些 action chunk 值得参与反向传播，而不是默认对所有 chunk 都算梯度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不强，但对大模型后训练的 compute allocation 有启发。它把 RL 训练中的样本效率问题转成了梯度预算分配问题：不是只改 advantage 或 reward，而是减少无信息阶段的反向传播。这个视角对语言模型 RL、长轨迹 agent RL、tool-use RL 也有可迁移性，尤其是当奖励是 trajectory-level、有效 credit 只集中在少数决策点时。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Probabilistic Chunk Masking，作为 GRPO 的插拔式改造。轨迹先被切成 action chunks，并用确定性规则分到若干 semantic phases。普通 GRPO 会给同一条轨迹里的所有 chunk 分配同一个 group-relative advantage，并对所有 chunk 做反向传播。PCM 只保留固定预算内的 chunk 参与 actor update，未选中的 chunk 被物理移出 backward path，从而同时省计算和 activation memory。保留概率不是均匀采样，而是按 phase 的 outcome divergence 来分配。理论上，作者把每个 phase 的有效学习信号定义为 per-phase gradient variance V_c，并给出类似 Neyman allocation 的预算分配，比例为 N_c sqrt(V_c)。由于 V_c 不能直接低成本获得，作者用成功 rollout 与失败 rollout 在该 phase 上的 action variance C_c 作为代理，并证明 C_c 可作为 V_c 的可测 lower-bound proxy。这个设计区别于 PPO critic 或 per-step credit assignment：后者主要改变学习信号，PCM 改变哪些位置获得梯度计算。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 LIBERO VLA 任务上。作者报告 PCM 使用每条轨迹少于 20% 的 chunks，达到 98% convergence 的 wall-clock 时间加速 2.38 倍，梯度步骤本身加速 4.8 倍，peak activation memory 降低 60%。这些数字支持一个核心结论：在该设置里，减少 backward 覆盖范围比继续优化 rollout 采样更有效。消融重点应是 phase-level variance 是否真的集中、C_c 与真实梯度方差 V_c 的相关性、固定预算下按 C_c 分配是否优于 uniform masking 或随机 chunk masking。给出的正文片段表明作者强调 outcome-critical semantic phases 的稀疏性，但完整实验表中的任务级成功率、不同 chunk budget、不同 phase labeling 规则的鲁棒性需要进一步核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 里的 cost breakdown，确认 78% 梯度计算占比是否来自目标运行设置；再看 Methodology 中 V_c、C_c 和 Neyman allocation 的定义，重点理解为什么 action variance 能作为 gradient variance 的代理；最后看 LIBERO 实验中的 chunk budget、收敛曲线、memory 曲线和 masking 消融。若关心 LLM RL，可重点抽象出一个问题：长轨迹中哪些 token 或 action step 应该进入 backward，而不仅是如何给所有 token 分配 advantage。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the training cost of GRPO-based reinforcement learning for vision-language-action policies. Its main observation is that rollout collection is not the dominant bottleneck in the authors’ setup. Gradient computation accounts for about 78% of per-step wall-clock time, while rollout collection accounts for about 21%. The practical question is therefore which chunks inside a trajectory should receive backpropagation, rather than assuming that every chunk deserves gradient compute.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining contribution, but it gives a useful compute-allocation view for large-model RL. It treats gradient computation as a scarce resource and allocates it to trajectory segments where success and failure actually diverge. This is relevant beyond robotics: long-horizon language-agent RL, tool-use training, and trajectory-level reward optimization often have sparse decision points, while standard policy-gradient implementations still backpropagate through many low-signal tokens or steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Probabilistic Chunk Masking, is a drop-in modification to chunk-level GRPO. A trajectory is divided into action chunks, and chunks are assigned to deterministic semantic phases. Standard GRPO applies the same group-relative advantage across all chunks in a trajectory and computes gradients everywhere. PCM instead keeps only a fixed budget of chunks and physically removes the rest from the backward pass. The keep probability is phase-dependent. The paper defines the useful signal of a phase as its per-phase gradient variance V_c and derives a Neyman-style allocation proportional to N_c sqrt(V_c). Since V_c is expensive to measure directly, PCM uses the action variance between successful and failed rollouts, C_c, as a measurable proxy. The authors argue and prove that C_c lower-bounds the relevant gradient-variance signal under their assumptions. The key distinction from critic-based credit assignment is that PCM changes compute placement, not only the scalar learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported evaluation is on LIBERO. PCM uses less than 20% of trajectory chunks, reaches 98% convergence with a 2.38x wall-clock speedup, makes gradient steps 4.8x faster, and reduces peak activation memory by 60%. These results support the claim that, in this VLA RL regime, actor-update compute is the right target for optimization. The most informative ablations are the concentration of phase-level variance, the quality of C_c as a proxy for V_c, and comparisons against uniform or random chunk masking under the same chunk budget. The supplied text does not expose all task-level tables, so final confidence should depend on how robust the gains are across tasks, budgets, and phase-labeling rules.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the cost breakdown in the introduction, because the method is only compelling if gradient computation is indeed the dominant cost. Then read the definitions of V_c, C_c, and the Neyman allocation in the methodology. Finally inspect the LIBERO convergence curves, memory measurements, and masking ablations. For LLM RL readers, the transferable idea is selective backpropagation over long trajectories, rather than another variant of advantage normalization.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 profiling 和 masking 规则：78% 梯度开销这个数会改变 VLA RL 优化优先级，但需警惕任务规模是否偏小。
recommendation.en: Read the profiling and masking rule: the 78% gradient-cost number changes VLA RL optimization priorities, though task scale may be the weak point.

paper.title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective
paper.abstract: Production machine translation relies overwhelmingly on encoder-decoder Seq2Seq models, yet reinforcement learning approaches to MT fine-tuning have largely targeted decoder-only LLMs at $\geq$7B parameters, with limited systematic study of encoder-decoder architectures. We apply Group Relative Policy Optimization to NLLB-200 (600M and 1.3B) using a hybrid reference-free reward (LaBSE and COMET-Kiwi) that requires no parallel data at fine-tuning time, evaluating across 13 typologically diverse l

summary.core_problem: 研究无参考奖励的强化学习微调是否能有效提升生产环境常用的 encoder-decoder 机器翻译模型，而不是只用于 decoder-only LLM。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法迁移和经验规律：将 GRPO 应用于 NLLB-200 600M/1.3B，并用无需平行数据的混合奖励做多语言 MT 微调；对 RL 信号质量和低资源语言适配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 微调 Seq2Seq NLLB-200，奖励由 LaBSE 和 COMET-Kiwi 组成，训练时不需要参考译文；从 seq2seq 角度分析 reward discriminability、baseline 强弱和收益之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 在 13 种类型差异较大的语言上评测，GRPO 全部语言均有提升，繁体中文最高提升 +5.03 chrF++；在没有目标语言数据的情况下，部分形态复杂语言可接近 3 epoch 监督微调效果。摘要称该规律在英译多语方向复现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether reference-free RL fine-tuning can improve production-style encoder-decoder MT models, rather than being limited to decoder-only LLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training transfer study and empirical pattern: GRPO is applied to 600M and 1.3B NLLB-200 models using reference-free hybrid rewards, offering some signal for reward quality and low-resource adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It fine-tunes Seq2Seq NLLB-200 with Group Relative Policy Optimization. The reward combines LaBSE and COMET-Kiwi and does not require parallel references during fine-tuning. The analysis links gains to reward discriminability and baseline weakness.
summary_en.experiments: Across 13 typologically diverse languages, GRPO improves all languages, with up to +5.03 chrF++ for Traditional Chinese. Without target-language data, it competes with 3-epoch supervised fine-tuning on some morphologically complex languages, and the gain pattern is replicated in English-to-many settings.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 主线，但 reward discriminability 与弱基线收益关系值得记；看结果分组即可，不必深读方法。
recommendation.en: Not on the main LLM track, but the reward-discriminability versus weak-baseline pattern is worth noting; read the grouped results, not the full method.

paper.title: Resolving Action Bottleneck: Agentic Reinforcement Learning Informed by Token-Level Energy
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning trains large language models using multi-turn trajectories that interleave long reasoning traces with short environment-facing actions. Common policy-gradient methods, such as PPO and GRPO, treat each token in a trajectory equally, leading to uniform credit assignment. In this paper, we critically demonstrate that such uniform credit assignment largely misallocates token-level training signals. From an energy-based modeling perspective, we show that token-level tra

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 agentic RL 中的 token 级 credit assignment 错配问题。多轮轨迹通常由大量推理 token 和少量环境动作 token 组成，但 PPO、GRPO 这类方法把同一个轨迹级 advantage 近似均匀地施加到所有生成 token 上。论文指出，这会把梯度主要花在占比最高的推理 token 上，而真正决定环境状态转移和最终回报差异的动作 token 反而被稀释。作者把这个现象称为 Action Bottleneck。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口的启发在于：长链推理和工具调用场景下，训练信号并不随 token 数量均匀分布。若继续沿用 next-token loss 或 policy-gradient loss 的均匀 token 权重，模型会在长 trace 上消耗大量优化预算，却没有把更新集中到控制环境结果的关键位置。贡献类型更接近 RL objective 和训练动态分析，而不是新模型架构。量级上，论文报告在四个多轮环境、多个 Qwen2.5-Instruct 规模、PPO 和 GRPO 两套优化器上都有一致收益，最高 final success rate 增益达到 65.2 和 63.7 个百分点；这说明问题不是单个环境的偶然现象。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法 ActFocus 有两层。第一层是区分 reasoning tokens 和 action tokens，对 reasoning tokens 降权，把梯度质量从长推理段转移到短动作段。第二层是在 action tokens 内部再按 token-level energy 分配权重，使高不确定性的动作 token 获得更大的更新。这里的 energy 来自冻结参考模型的 next-token predictive distribution，可理解为参考模型对某个 token 预测分布的自由能指标。作者选择 energy，而不是直接用 entropy 或 log-likelihood，是因为它需要稳定、便宜，并且能够反映 outcome uncertainty 集中的位置。论文用同一 prompt 下多次 rollout 的 episodic reward variance 衡量结果不确定性，发现 action-token mean energy 与 reward variance 的相关系数为 ρ = +0.537，而 reasoning tokens 或整条轨迹的平均 energy 与 reward variance 近似无关。方法上，ActFocus 不改变 PPO/GRPO 的主框架，也不引入额外 critic 或复杂的 dense reward model，而是在 token loss/gradient 乘上权重，因此容易接到现有 RL 训练管线里。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的代表性观察是：在 Sokoban 轨迹中，action tokens 只占生成输出约 4%，reasoning tokens 占约 96%；均匀 credit assignment 会让梯度质量按 token 数量流向 reasoning tokens，但 energy-reward variance 分析显示有效训练信号集中在 action tokens。实验覆盖四个多轮 agentic environments，使用 Qwen2.5-Instruct 多个模型规模，并分别在 PPO 与 GRPO 上训练。ActFocus 相比 PPO 的平均成功率增益为 17.0 个百分点，相比 GRPO 的平均增益为 34.6 个百分点；final-step 最大增益分别达到 65.2 和 63.7 个百分点。稳定性方面，ActFocus 明显缓解了 GRPO 在训练后期的 peak-to-final degradation，即训练曲线达到较高点后又退化的问题。论文还比较了 energy、entropy、log-likelihood 等 token 信号，重点是证明 action-token energy 更能解释不同 rollout 的回报方差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，Figure 1 和引言中的 Action Bottleneck 证据，重点看 action token 占比、梯度质量分布、energy 与 reward variance 的相关性，这决定了问题是否成立。第二，方法部分的 token reweighting 公式，重点确认权重如何归一化、reasoning/action 如何切分、是否改变 PPO/GRPO 的 advantage 估计和 KL 约束。第三，实验章节中的训练曲线、环境拆分、模型规模拆分和 Sec. 5.6 的信号指标消融。最值得深挖的是：energy 使用冻结参考模型是否在不同策略分布漂移下仍稳定；动作边界依赖环境格式时是否容易泛化到自由形式 tool use；降权 reasoning tokens 是否会在需要长程推理学习的任务上产生副作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies token-level credit assignment in agentic RL. Multi-turn trajectories contain long reasoning traces but only a small number of environment-facing action tokens. Standard PPO and GRPO-style training effectively applies the trajectory-level learning signal across all generated tokens, so most gradient mass goes to reasoning tokens simply because they dominate the sequence length. The paper argues that this is misaligned with where outcome-relevant uncertainty actually lies, and names the phenomenon the Action Bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and post-training research is the evidence that long trajectory optimization should not treat all tokens as equally trainable units. In tool-use and agentic settings, the tokens that change the environment can be sparse, yet they carry most of the signal about success or failure. This has direct implications for RL pretraining, reasoning mid-training, and any objective that mixes long rationales with short executable actions. The contribution is an objective and training-dynamics contribution rather than an architecture change. The reported effect size is large: across four environments, multiple Qwen2.5-Instruct scales, and both PPO and GRPO, the method improves final success rates by as much as 65.2 and 63.7 percentage points.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActFocus reweights policy-gradient updates at the token level. It first downweights reasoning tokens, which shifts gradient mass toward the sparse action span. It then redistributes the action-token weights using token-level energy computed from a frozen reference model’s next-token predictive distribution. The intended role of energy is to identify action tokens where predictive uncertainty is high and where learning signal is more likely to matter. The empirical anchor is reward variance across multiple rollouts sampled from the same prompt. Action-token mean energy correlates with this variance at ρ = +0.537, while reasoning-token energy and full-trajectory averages are close to uninformative. Compared with learning a dense critic or adding token-level reward supervision, this is a lightweight modification: the policy-gradient framework remains PPO/GRPO-compatible, and the change is mainly a token-wise multiplier on the loss or gradient.
summary_en.experiments: A representative Sokoban example shows the structural imbalance: action tokens are about 4% of the generated output, while reasoning tokens are about 96%. Under uniform credit assignment, most updates are therefore spent on reasoning text. The broader evaluation uses four multi-turn agentic environments, Qwen2.5-Instruct models at several scales, and both PPO and GRPO. ActFocus reports average success-rate gains of 17.0 percentage points over PPO and 34.6 percentage points over GRPO, with maximum final-step gains of 65.2 and 63.7 points respectively. The training curves also suggest better stability for GRPO, especially by reducing peak-to-final degradation. The paper further compares energy with alternatives such as entropy and log-likelihood, with the central finding that action-token energy is the useful signal for explaining outcome variability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem analysis first, especially Figure 1 and the correlation study between token energy and reward variance. That section establishes whether the proposed reweighting is justified. Then read the method equations carefully: how reasoning and action spans are identified, how token weights are normalized, and how the reweighting interacts with PPO/GRPO objectives and KL control. The most useful experimental material is the environment-by-environment training curves, the model-scale breakdown, and the ablation comparing energy with entropy and log-likelihood. Points worth checking closely are the robustness of a frozen-reference energy signal under policy drift, the dependence on clean action-token boundaries, and whether suppressing reasoning-token gradients hurts tasks where the reasoning trace itself must be improved.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现 token reweighting 消融；若结论稳，长 CoT RL 里“所有 token 同权”这个默认设定要改。
recommendation.en: Replicate the token-reweighting ablation immediately; if stable, the default equal-weight treatment of all tokens in long-CoT RL should change.

paper.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), processing a massive number of visual tokens incurs prohibitive computational overhead. While recent training-aware pruning methods attempt to selectively discard redundant tokens, they largely rely on continuous-gradient relaxations. However, visual token pruning is inherently a discrete, non-convex combinatorial problem; consequently, these continuous approximations frequently trap the optimization in sub-optimal local minima, especially under aggressive compr

summary.core_problem: GRIP-VLM 解决 VLM 视觉 token 过多导致推理开销高的问题，重点是训练一个能在不同预算下动态选择保留 token 的 pruning 策略。论文认为视觉 token pruning 是离散子集选择问题，用 Gumbel-Softmax 或可微 top-k 这类连续松弛方法容易在高压缩率下落入差的局部解。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近高效 VLM 推理研究，不属于预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发在于：高分辨率图像和视频会把视觉 token 数从早期约 576 推到上万级，统一多模态模型的训练和推理都会受这个瓶颈限制。论文把 token selection 看成非平滑决策问题，并用 RL 处理 hard samples，这对设计可学习的视觉 token routing、动态计算和多模态 MoE 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM 是两阶段动态 pruning 框架。系统层面，它在 Transformer 层中加入轻量 scoring module，可用于视觉编码器阶段，也可用于 LLM decoder 阶段，并且可以和启发式 pruning 方法叠加。token 层面，它设计 budget-aware scorer，让打分器显式感知当前压缩预算；训练时用 curriculum learning，从接近无损的预算逐步过渡到高压缩预算，以减少直接训练高压缩策略的不稳定。优化层面，先用 supervised distillation 得到一个稳定初始策略，再用 GRPO 风格的 reinforcement learning 在离散选择空间中探索。这个设计针对的是连续松弛的局限：当正确性随 keep ratio 呈现非单调波动时，平滑 surrogate 很难找到好的 token 子集。
summary.experiments: 论文在 6 个多模态 benchmark 上报告结果，并以 192 个视觉 token 预算作为关键比较点。GRIP-VLM 在该预算下整体表现优于启发式和监督学习 pruning 基线。在等精度约束下，推理速度比竞争方法快 15%。论文还把样本按 pruning 难度分成 LV1、LV2、LV3：LV1 对 pruning 稳定，启发式方法已足够；LV2 随 keep ratio 大致单调退化，监督学习有明显收益；LV3 呈现非单调振荡，RL 收益最大。在 hard samples 上，GRIP-VLM 相比已有 pruning baseline 平均成功率提升 33%，在部分 LV3 设置中比启发式和监督学习方法高最多约 20 个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Motivation 里对 pruning landscape heterogeneity 的实验设计，尤其是用 keep ratio 扫描正确/错误交替次数来定义 LV1–LV3。这部分比方法命名更有信息量。然后看 budget-aware scorer、curriculum learning、SFT-anchored RL/GRPO 的训练流程。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体 benchmark 细节，关注它如何把视觉 token 裁剪建模为离散策略优化，以及 hard samples 为什么需要探索而不只是可微打分。

summary_en.core_problem: GRIP-VLM targets the inference cost caused by excessive visual tokens in VLMs. The core claim is that visual token pruning is a discrete subset-selection problem. Continuous relaxations such as Gumbel-Softmax or differentiable top-k can be fragile, especially when the compression budget is tight.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an efficient VLM inference paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the scaling pressure of visual tokens: modern VLMs may process hundreds to tens of thousands of visual tokens for high-resolution images or video. The paper’s framing of token selection as a non-smooth decision problem is useful for thinking about dynamic visual token routing, adaptive compute, and multimodal sparse computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM uses a two-stage dynamic pruning framework. It inserts lightweight scoring modules into Transformer layers and supports pruning in both the visual encoder and LLM decoder stages. The scorer is budget-aware: it conditions token importance on the current token budget, which lets one model operate across different compression levels. Training starts with curriculum learning, moving from mild pruning to aggressive pruning, and uses supervised distillation to create a stable initial policy. It then applies GRPO-style reinforcement learning to explore discrete pruning decisions. This is intended to handle cases where correctness is not a smooth monotonic function of the keep ratio.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on six multimodal benchmarks, with 192 visual tokens as a key budget setting. GRIP-VLM outperforms heuristic and supervised pruning baselines at that budget. Under an equal-accuracy constraint, it gives 15% faster inference than competing methods. The paper also analyzes pruning difficulty by sweeping keep ratios and counting correct/incorrect transitions. Easy samples are stable under pruning, medium samples degrade roughly monotonically, and hard samples show oscillatory behavior. On hard samples, GRIP-VLM improves success rate by 33% on average over existing pruning baselines, and in some LV3 cases gains up to about 20 points over heuristic and supervised methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. The most useful part is the motivation section on heterogeneous pruning landscapes, especially the LV1–LV3 definition based on keep-ratio sweeps. Then read the budget-aware scorer, curriculum training, and SFT-anchored GRPO procedure. For pretraining-oriented readers, benchmark details are less important than the modeling choice: treating visual token reduction as discrete policy optimization rather than differentiable scoring alone.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和高压缩 ablation；把 GRPO 用在离散 token pruning 上是有味道的，但别把它误读成预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Read the method and aggressive-compression ablations; using GRPO for discrete token pruning is interesting, but do not read it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards from a Contrastive Perspective
paper.abstract: RLVR has become a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLMs' reasoning capabilities, and GRPO is one of its most representative algorithms. In this paper, we first show that GRPO admits an equivalent discriminative reformulation as a weighted positive-negative score difference. Under this view, GRPO increases sequence-level scores of verified positive rollouts and decreases those of negative rollouts, where the scores are averages of clipped token-level importance sampling ratios. This reformul

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的核心算法，存在两个结构性优化缺陷：一是优化的截断重要性采样替代分数与生成阶段使用的似然不匹配，二是信用分配仅依赖采样组的正负样本通过率，对组内不同样本间的分数差距不敏感。
summary.importance: 首次明确GRPO的判别式目标等价形式，为RLVR算法优化提供了对比学习的新视角；提出的ConSPO算法可直接落地到推理类任务的RL训练流程，提升训练效率和最终模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将GRPO重写为加权正负样本判别目标的等价形式，明确其两项核心缺陷。提出的ConSPO用长度归一化的序列对数概率替换截断重要性采样分数，对齐训练目标与推理阶段的序列排序依据；再引入组级InfoNCE对比目标，让梯度依赖组内样本的相对分数，同时加入课程调度的间隔项防止梯度过早衰减。
summary.experiments: 在多个不同参数量的骨干模型、不同训练数据集上测试，ConSPO在7个数学推理基准上均取得一致的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Proposition 1的GRPO等价推导、图1的梯度对比，以及ConSPO目标函数的定义部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: As the core algorithm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), GRPO has two structural optimization flaws: first, the optimized clipped importance sampling surrogate score is misaligned with the likelihood used in the generation phase; second, credit assignment only relies on the positive/negative sample pass rate of the sampling group, and is insensitive to the score gap between different samples in the group.
summary_en.importance: It explicitly derives the equivalent discriminative objective form of GRPO for the first time, providing a new contrastive learning perspective for RLVR algorithm optimization. The proposed ConSPO algorithm can be directly applied to RL training pipelines for reasoning tasks, improving training efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, GRPO is rewritten into the equivalent form of a weighted positive-negative sample discrimination objective to clarify its two core flaws. The proposed ConSPO replaces clipped importance sampling scores with length-normalized sequence log-probabilities, aligning the training objective with the sequence ranking basis in the inference phase; then a group-level InfoNCE contrastive objective is introduced to make gradients depend on the relative scores of samples within the group, and a curriculum-scheduled margin is added to prevent premature gradient attenuation.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple backbone models with different parameter sizes and different training datasets, ConSPO achieves consistent performance improvements on 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the equivalent derivation of GRPO in Proposition 1, the gradient comparison in Figure 1, and the definition of ConSPO's objective function. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO的本质重构和缺陷分析，做RL后训练的研究员可直接参考ConSPO的损失设计，重点看§2的等价推导
recommendation.en: Essential reformulation and defect analysis of GRPO, RL post-training researchers can directly reference ConSPO loss design, focus on §2 equivalence derivation

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Combining On-Policy Optimization and Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to long-context tasks requires post-training methods that remain accurate and coherent over thousands of tokens. Existing approaches are limited in several ways: 1) off-policy methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and knowledge distillation (KD) suffer from exposure bias and limited recovery from model-generated errors over long horizons; 2) on-policy reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) better align trainin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 post-training 里的一个老问题：离线监督方法稳定，但一旦模型进入自己生成的轨迹，误差会沿着很长的生成链条累积；纯 on-policy RL 又能对齐真实 rollout 分布，但奖励稀疏、方差大、训练不稳，尤其在长上下文推理里更明显。作者要解决的不是单点算法改进，而是给出一个更完整的长上下文对齐配方：怎样把 on-policy 的分布匹配能力、token 级蒸馏的稠密监督、以及 reward-driven 优化结合起来，让模型在几千到上万 token 的推理和生成中既能保持正确性，也能保持结构和连贯性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是新基座架构或新预训练目标，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有直接价值。原因有两点。第一，长上下文能力并不只由 RoPE 外推或继续预训练决定，后训练阶段是否在模型自己的长轨迹上学习，影响很大。第二，这篇工作把“稀疏奖励 RL”和“稠密 teacher guidance”放到同一个 on-policy 框架里，给出了一个比单独 GRPO 或单独蒸馏更实用的折中。这个思路对 reasoning model、continual post-train、甚至后续 mid-training 都有参考意义：如果训练目标需要覆盖长 horizon，单靠离线 imitation 往往不够，单靠 RL 又太贵且不稳，混合信号可能是更现实的路线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 dGRPO，名字上看是把 GRPO 和 on-policy distillation 叠加，真正关键在于三件事如何配合。第一，训练数据不是固定 teacher traces，而是当前 student policy 在长上下文任务上的 on-policy rollout，因此训练分布与推理分布一致，能减轻 exposure bias。第二，在这些 rollout 上同时施加两类学习信号：一类是 GRPO 风格的组相对优势信号，用于直接优化任务奖励；另一类是 token-level 的 teacher distillation，用 teacher 在相同 prefix 下的分布给出稠密监督，帮助模型在长轨迹中维持局部决策质量。第三，作者在实现上去掉了常见 RLHF 里的 reference KL，设 β_ref=0，不再显式约束到初始策略，理由是 reasoning/long-context 场景下策略自然偏离初始模型未必有害，而且省显存和算力。

从方法定位看，SFT/KD 是 off-policy + dense signal，但没有 reward objective；GRPO 是 on-policy + reward objective，但 token 级监督稀疏；OPD 是 on-policy + dense signal，但不能直接优化任意 reward。dGRPO 试图同时拿到这三者的优点。文中还配套提出 LONG-BLOCKS 合成数据集，覆盖 multi-hop reasoning、contextual grounding、long-form generation，作用不是单纯扩充样本量，而是给长上下文 on-policy 对齐提供更丰富的任务分布。若从训练机制理解，dGRPO 的价值主要在 credit assignment：reward 负责全局方向，distillation 负责局部稳定，两者都发生在模型自己采样到的状态上，因此比离线 KD 更贴近真实误差传播链条。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，作者做的重点不是追求单一 benchmark 的高分，而是系统比较几种长上下文后训练策略：SFT/KD、OPD、GRPO、dGRPO。实验结论很明确：单独的离线方法在短程结构学习上有效，但随着上下文和输出长度增加，恢复模型自生成错误的能力不足；单独 GRPO 能提升 reward 对齐，但训练波动更大，样本效率更差；dGRPO 在长上下文任务上更稳定，且通常能同时保住短上下文能力。文中反复强调“preserving short-context capabilities of the starting model”，说明他们把能力保持当作主要评估维度之一，而不是只看长上下文分数。

就可见内容而言，论文给出了方法比较表、训练 recipe 图，以及 LONG-BLOCKS 数据构成，但你提供的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、参数规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 分数和提升幅度，因此没法负责任地填入精确数字。可以确认的是：实验设计围绕 Qwen3-based setup 展开，且比较对象覆盖 off-policy、on-policy RL、on-policy distillation 以及混合方法。若后续拿到完整附录，最该核对的是三类数字：一是不同 context length 下的性能曲线；二是训练稳定性指标，如 reward variance、loss/advantage 波动；三是短上下文通用能力是否出现回退，以及回退幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Table 1 和方法总览图，先把四类训练范式的差别吃透：采样分布、学习信号稠密度、是否直接优化 reward、是否缓解 exposure bias。然后重点看方法章节里 dGRPO 的目标函数定义，确认蒸馏项和 GRPO 项是如何加权、在什么 rollout 上计算、teacher 是否只提供 logits 还是还参与筛选。接着看实验部分的主表和训练曲线，尤其关注三件事：长上下文收益是否随长度增加而扩大；dGRPO 相比纯 GRPO 的稳定性改善是否显著；短上下文能力保持是否真实而非口头描述。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议额外看 LONG-BLOCKS 的数据生成细节，因为这会影响你对方法收益来源的判断：提升到底来自更好的算法，还是来自更合适的长上下文训练任务分布。另外，作者把 β_ref 设为 0，这个决定值得单独审视，尤其要看是否在某些任务上带来风格漂移或安全性退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in long-context post-training: off-policy methods such as SFT and KD are stable and dense, but they train on teacher trajectories rather than the model’s own long rollouts, so exposure bias compounds over long horizons; pure on-policy RL methods better match inference-time states, but become noisy, sparse, and sample-inefficient when rewards arrive late. The paper asks a recipe-level question rather than a narrow algorithmic one: how to combine on-policy learning, dense token supervision, and reward optimization so that an LLM can reason coherently over very long contexts without sacrificing its existing short-context behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Long-context capability is not determined only by positional extrapolation or continued pretraining; the distribution on which the model is aligned after pretraining also matters. The paper is useful because it treats long-horizon alignment as a signal-design problem: sparse reward gives global direction, dense teacher guidance stabilizes local token decisions, and on-policy sampling makes both signals land on the states the model will actually visit. That framing is relevant to reasoning models, continual post-training, and possibly mid-training recipes where long-horizon behavior is a target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method, dGRPO, combines Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation. The key idea is not merely adding two losses together, but aligning them on the same on-policy trajectories. First, the student samples its own long-context rollouts, so training happens on the model-induced state distribution rather than on fixed expert traces. Second, each rollout receives two learning signals: a GRPO-style relative reward signal for direct task optimization, and a token-level teacher distillation signal that provides dense next-token guidance under the same prefixes. Third, the implementation removes the usual reference-policy KL term by setting beta_ref to zero, following recent reasoning-model practice, which reduces memory/compute overhead and allows the policy to move farther from initialization when that helps reasoning.

The paper positions the method against three alternatives. SFT/KD gives dense supervision but is off-policy and does not optimize arbitrary rewards. GRPO is on-policy and reward-driven but sparse. On-policy distillation is on-policy and dense but not reward-optimizing. dGRPO is meant to inherit all three desirable properties at once: on-policy sampling, dense token guidance, and direct reward optimization. The accompanying LONG-BLOCKS synthetic dataset is also part of the recipe. It covers multi-hop reasoning, contextual grounding, and long-form generation, so the method is evaluated and trained on a broader long-context task mix rather than a narrow retrieval-style setup.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mainly comparative and recipe-oriented. The paper contrasts SFT/KD, OPD, GRPO, and dGRPO in a Qwen3-based setup for long-context reasoning. The qualitative conclusion is consistent throughout the text: off-policy methods help with structure and imitation but struggle to recover from self-generated errors over long horizons; pure GRPO can improve reward alignment but is less stable and less sample-efficient; dGRPO improves long-context performance more consistently while better preserving the base model’s short-context capability.

However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, appendix numbers, model sizes, token budgets, or exact benchmark gains. So it would be unsafe to invent precise figures. What should be checked in the full paper is clear: performance as a function of context length, stability metrics during training, and retention of short-context general abilities after long-context alignment. Those three axes determine whether the gains come from a genuinely better training signal or simply from task/data specialization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Table 1 and the overview figure. They clarify the design space better than the prose: trajectory source, signal density, reward optimization, and exposure-bias behavior. Then read the method section closely to see how the GRPO term and the distillation term are combined, how trajectories are sampled, and what exactly the teacher provides. After that, go straight to the main comparison tables and training curves. The most important questions are: does the advantage of dGRPO grow with longer contexts, does it materially stabilize training relative to pure GRPO, and does short-context performance remain intact rather than merely degrade less.

For a quick pass, 25 to 35 minutes should be enough. For a deeper read, inspect the LONG-BLOCKS construction details and the decision to set beta_ref to zero. Those two choices are likely to explain a large fraction of the observed behavior.

recommendation.zh: Cohere提出的dGRPO结合RL和蒸馏提升长上下文能力，可参考其数据合成逻辑优化内部长上下文后训练流程
recommendation.en: dGRPO proposed by Cohere combines RL and distillation for long context improvement, reference its data synthesis logic to optimize internal long context post-training pipeline

paper.title: GEAR: Granularity-Adaptive Advantage Reweighting for LLM Agents via Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used post-training approach for LLM agents, where training commonly relies on outcome-level rewards that provide only coarse supervision. While finer-grained credit assignment is promising for effective policy updates, obtaining reliable local credit and assigning it to the right parts of the long-horizon trajectory remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose Granularity-adaptivE Advantage Reweighting (GEAR), an adaptive-granularity credit assi

summary.core_problem: GEAR 处理的是长轨迹 LLM Agent 强化学习中的信用分配问题。GRPO 这类方法通常只有最终 outcome reward，整条轨迹共享同一个 advantage，容易把成功轨迹中的局部坏动作一起强化，也会把失败轨迹中的局部好动作一起惩罚。问题不只是信号太粗，还包括信用应该分配到什么粒度：token、turn、tool call 或人工 segment 都可能和真实行为单元不匹配。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于，它没有直接训练 process reward model，也没有要求人工标注中间步骤，而是尝试把 trajectory-level advantage 改造成局部加权信号。对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近 post-training/RL for agents；但它对“如何从粗粒度可验证奖励中抽取更密的训练信号”有参考意义。这个问题也会影响 RL pretrain、长上下文任务训练、tool-use 数据构造和 verifier-guided learning。
summary.technical_approach: GEAR 的核心做法是用自蒸馏构造一个任务相关的局部偏差信号，再用这个信号重加权 GRPO 的 advantage。具体来说，论文用同一个模型构造 ground-truth-conditioned teacher，也就是在可见正确答案或正确条件的情况下生成参考分布；on-policy student 则按当前策略生成轨迹。二者之间的 reverse KL 被用来衡量学生在某个位置是否偏离了“更接近任务正确延续”的行为。KL 较大的位置通常对应推理路径发生转向或承诺的地方。论文进一步用 token entropy 作为边界信号，因为高熵位置常对应不确定性或语义转折，从而把单点 KL spike 扩展成更合理的行为片段。最后，GEAR 不引入显式 step reward，而是把 token-level aligned region 和 segment-level divergent region 转换成局部权重，对原始 trajectory-level advantage 做重新分布。重加权是 advantage-aware 的：成功轨迹中，高 divergence 区域被降权，避免强化不稳定偏离；失败轨迹中，高 divergence 区域受到更强惩罚。
summary.experiments: 当前可见内容主要给出问题设定、方法动机和框架设计，没有提供可核验的完整实验表格、任务列表、模型规模、训练 token 数、性能提升幅度或消融结果。文中提到一个经验观察：reverse KL spike 常出现在“so”“but”“therefore”等转折标记附近，说明这些位置可能是推理路径改变或决策承诺的边界。真正需要核对的实验包括：GEAR 相比 vanilla GRPO 的成功率提升；KL 信号、entropy 边界、segment reweighting 各自的消融；在成功轨迹降权和失败轨迹加罚这两个方向上的贡献；以及额外 teacher forward 带来的训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 teacher/student 分布如何构造、reverse KL 如何计算、entropy 如何确定 segment 边界、local weight 如何进入 GRPO loss。实验部分若完整可得，应优先看 credit assignment 可视化、消融表和训练稳定性曲线。需要特别留意两个风险点：第一，ground-truth-conditioned teacher 是否泄露了过强的答案条件，导致训练信号和真实推理过程不一致；第二，KL divergence 衡量的是分布偏离，不一定等价于任务贡献，尤其在多条正确路径并存的 agent 任务中。

summary_en.core_problem: GEAR targets credit assignment in long-horizon RL for LLM agents. Methods such as GRPO usually optimize full trajectories with outcome-only rewards, so every token or action receives the same trajectory-level advantage. This can reinforce locally harmful behaviors in successful trajectories and penalize useful intermediate behaviors in failed ones. The difficult part is not only the lack of dense supervision, but also the choice of granularity: tokens, turns, tool calls, and heuristic segments often do not match the actual behavioral unit that should receive credit.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in post-training and agent RL rather than base pretraining. Still, it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it studies how to extract denser learning signals from coarse verifiable rewards. That question also appears in RL-style pretraining, long-context curriculum design, tool-use data generation, and verifier-guided training. The contribution is a credit-reshaping mechanism that avoids training a separate process reward model or requiring step-level human annotations.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEAR reshapes the trajectory-level GRPO advantage using local weights derived from self-distillation. It constructs a task-grounded teacher by conditioning the same model on ground-truth information, and compares this teacher distribution with the on-policy student distribution. The reverse KL between the two distributions is used as a reference-guided deviation signal. Large reverse KL values indicate positions where the student starts to depart from a task-correct continuation. The method then uses token entropy as a boundary signal, since entropy spikes often mark uncertainty or semantic transitions, and expands pointwise divergence into adaptive behavioral segments. The resulting token-level aligned regions and segment-level divergent regions are converted into local credit weights. The reweighting depends on the sign of the trajectory advantage: in successful trajectories, highly divergent regions are down-weighted to avoid reinforcing unstable deviations; in failed trajectories, they receive stronger penalties.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content contains the motivation and method design but does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, training scale, benchmark details, or numerical gains. One reported qualitative observation is that reverse-KL spikes often occur around transition markers such as “so,” “but,” and “therefore,” which supports the use of divergence as a signal for reasoning-path shifts. The key empirical checks are the improvement over vanilla GRPO, ablations for the KL signal, entropy-based boundary detection, and segment-level reweighting, as well as the extra compute cost from the teacher forward pass.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the construction of the teacher and student distributions, the reverse-KL computation, the entropy-based segmentation rule, and how the local weights enter the GRPO objective. If the full experimental section is available, prioritize the ablation table, credit-assignment visualizations, and training stability curves. Two points deserve scrutiny: whether the ground-truth-conditioned teacher introduces a mismatch with test-time reasoning, and whether distributional deviation is a reliable proxy for task contribution when multiple valid solution paths exist.

recommendation.zh: 这是后训练里少数值得看的 credit assignment 论文：先看 divergence spike 是否真对齐语义偏离点；若成立，很多长轨迹 RL 的 reward shaping 可以重写。
recommendation.en: This is one of the few credit-assignment papers in post-training worth reading: first check whether divergence spikes truly align with semantic deviation onsets; if they do, a lot of long-horizon RL reward shaping should be rewritten.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: AlphaGRPO: Unlocking Self-Reflective Multimodal Generation in UMMs via Decompositional Verifiable Reward
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose AlphaGRPO, a novel framework that applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to AR-Diffusion Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) to enhance multimodal generation capabilities without an additional cold-start stage. Our approach unlocks the model's intrinsic potential to perform advanced reasoning tasks: Reasoning Text-to-Image Generation, where the model actively infers implicit user intents, and Self-Reflective Refinement, where it autonomously diagnoses and correc

summary.core_problem: 现有AR-Diffusion统一多模态模型（UMM）的能力增强依赖额外的冷启动SFT阶段和强教师模型蒸馏，未能激活模型预训练获得的原生推理潜力；同时多模态生成的RL训练缺乏稳定、通用的奖励信号，容易出现奖励过拟合，无法保证在多样化下游任务上的一致提升。
summary.importance: 首次将GRPO算法拓展到AR-Diffusion统一多模态模型的训练中，验证了无需冷启动阶段即可激活预训练UMM的自反射细化、推理式文生图等高级认知能力的可行性，为统一多模态模型的后训练对齐提供了新的RL范式；提出的可分解验证奖励机制为通用MLLM作为奖励模型的使用方式提供了可落地的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AlphaGRPO框架，将GRPO直接应用于预训练UMM，无需额外冷启动SFT阶段，将多模态生成为“先生成文本、再生成图像”的统一轨迹，支持自反射细化（自主诊断初始生成的偏差并执行修正）和推理式文生图两类复杂任务；设计DVReward（可分解验证奖励），使用LLM将复杂用户请求拆解为原子化的可验证问题，再通过通用MLLM的置信度分数结合生成内容逐一验证，提供稳定、可解释的奖励信号，同时加入假阳性修正机制消除训练中的虚假提升信号。
summary.experiments: 在推理式文生图和自反射细化任务上训练的AlphaGRPO，在多个文生图和图像编辑基准上取得一致提升；自反射细化设置下，无需编辑数据训练即可在GEdit编辑基准上获得0.52的提升；推理时结合自反射细化后，在TIIF-Bench上达到83.9%的准确率，超过Bagel 5.8个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中关于统一多模态模型RL训练现有问题的分析和DVReward的设计思路，实验部分的跨任务泛化结果可快速验证方法的有效性，全文预计阅读时间20-30分钟；对RL实现细节感兴趣可进一步阅读方法部分的GRPO适配和假阳性修正机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Capability enhancement for existing AR-Diffusion Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) relies on additional cold-start SFT stages and distillation from strong teacher models, failing to activate the native reasoning potential acquired during UMM pretraining. Meanwhile, RL training for multimodal generation lacks stable, general reward signals and is prone to reward overfitting, failing to guarantee consistent improvements across diverse downstream tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work extends the GRPO algorithm to AR-Diffusion UMM training for the first time, verifying that advanced cognitive capabilities such as self-reflective refinement and reasoning text-to-image generation can be activated in pretrained UMMs without a cold-start stage, providing a new RL paradigm for post-training alignment of unified multimodal models. The proposed Decompositional Verifiable Reward mechanism also delivers a practical solution for using general MLLMs as reward models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The AlphaGRPO framework directly applies GRPO to pretrained UMMs without an additional cold-start SFT stage, formulating multimodal generation as a unified trajectory of "generate text first, then generate image", supporting two complex tasks: self-reflective refinement (autonomously diagnosing biases in initial generation and executing corrections) and reasoning text-to-image generation. DVReward (Decompositional Verifiable Reward) is designed to decompose complex user requests into atomic verifiable questions using an LLM, then verify each question against generated content via confidence scores from a general MLLM, providing stable and interpretable reward signals. A false-positive rectification mechanism is also added to eliminate spurious improvement signals during training.
summary_en.experiments: AlphaGRPO trained on both reasoning text-to-image generation and self-reflective refinement achieves consistent improvements across multiple text-to-image and image editing benchmarks. Under the self-reflective refinement setting, AlphaGRPO obtains a 0.52 improvement on the GEdit editing benchmark without training on editing data. When combined with inference-time self-reflective refinement, it reaches 83.9% accuracy on TIIF-Bench, outperforming Bagel by 5.8 percentage points.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of existing problems in RL training for unified multimodal models in the introduction and the design idea of DVReward. Cross-task generalization results in the experiment section can quickly verify the effectiveness of the method, with an estimated full reading time of 20-30 minutes. For those interested in RL implementation details, the GRPO adaptation and false-positive rectification mechanism in the methodology section are recommended.

recommendation.zh: 多模态RL对齐的奖励设计有参考价值，重点看DVReward的拆解逻辑即可，GRPO适配部分可复用至多模态对齐实验
recommendation.en: The reward design for multimodal RL alignment has reference value, only read the DVReward decomposition logic, GRPO adaptation part can be reused in multimodal alignment experiments.

paper.title: Nice Fold or Hero Call: Learning Budget-Efficient Thinking for Adaptive Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve problem solving through extended reasoning, but often misallocate test-time compute. Existing efficiency methods reduce cost by compressing reasoning traces or conditioning budget on perceived difficulty, yet largely overlook solvability. As a result, they may spend large budgets on queries beyond the model's capability while compressing hard-but-solvable queries that require deeper reasoning. In this work, we formulate adaptive reasoning as a computational

summary.core_problem: 现有大推理模型的推理效率优化方法仅基于感知难度分配计算资源，未区分当前策略下的可解性，导致在不可解问题上浪费大量计算资源，同时压缩了可解的高难度问题所需的推理深度，损害推理正确性。
summary.importance: 将推理资源分配建模为不确定性下的计算投资问题，提出的可解性感知分配思路可以直接应用于o1、R1类推理模型的推理成本优化，也可适配到训练阶段的计算资源分配策略设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两阶段预算高效推理（Bet）框架，第一阶段做行为冷启动SFT，第二阶段基于投资成本感知的GRPO优化，奖励函数结合当前策略rollout得到的经验可解性，自适应施加效率约束，引导模型三类行为：对简单问题快速作答（short solve）、对当前策略不可解的问题提前放弃（nice fold）、对难但可解的问题投入足够计算资源（hero call）。
summary.experiments: 跨7个基准、3个基础模型测试，在推理性能提升的同时降低约55%的token消耗；对不可解问题的token消耗降低90%以上，同时保留可解问题的推理深度；迁移到科学QA和逻辑推理任务仍能实现53%-59%的token节省。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction中关于难度与可解性差异的分析、Method部分的投资回报奖励函数设计，以及实验部分的Pareto效率对比，预计阅读时间18分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reasoning efficiency optimization methods for large reasoning models allocate compute resources only based on perceived difficulty, without distinguishing solvability under the current policy. This leads to massive compute waste on unsolvable queries, while compressing the required reasoning depth for hard-but-solvable queries and hurting reasoning correctness.
summary_en.importance: It models reasoning resource allocation as a computational investment problem under uncertainty. The proposed solvability-aware allocation idea can be directly applied to inference cost optimization of o1, R1-like reasoning models, and can also be adapted to the design of compute resource allocation strategies in the training phase.
summary_en.technical_approach: The two-stage Budget-Efficient Thinking (Bet) framework is proposed. The first stage conducts behavioral cold-start SFT, and the second stage optimizes via investment-cost-aware GRPO. The reward function is combined with empirical solvability derived from rollouts of the current policy, applies adaptive efficiency constraints, and guides three types of model behaviors: short solve for easy queries, nice fold (early abstain) for queries unsolvable under current policy, and hero call (allocate sufficient compute) for hard-but-solvable queries.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across 7 benchmarks and 3 base models, it reduces token consumption by ~55% while improving inference performance. It cuts token consumption on unsolvable queries by over 90% while preserving reasoning depth for solvable queries. It also generalizes to scientific QA and logical reasoning tasks with 53-59% token savings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of difference between difficulty and solvability in Introduction, the design of investment return reward function in Method section, and the Pareto efficiency comparison in experiments. Expected reading time is 18 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 Test-Time Compute 分配建模为投资决策（考虑 solvability 而非仅 difficulty），'nice fold' 的设定很有意思，值得看其 Reward 设计（§3.2）。
recommendation.en: Modeling Test-Time Compute allocation as an investment decision (considering solvability rather than just difficulty) is intriguing. The 'nice fold' concept is interesting; worth checking its Reward design (§3.2).
